problem: Can degraded LiFePO4 cathodes be directly regenerated with a single multifunctional organic lithium salt?
mechanism_or_method: Dilithium organic salt refills Li vacancies, cyano groups suppress Fe(III), and pyrolysis leaves a conductive carbon coat.
limitation: Lab-scale coin-cell validation; techno-economic analysis is an estimate.

object: high entropy alloy hydrogen evolution catalysts
problem: Can a spread of hydrogen adsorption energies on HEA surfaces beat the Sabatier optimum for hydrogen evolution?
mechanism_or_method: DFT shows Gaussian-distributed adsorption free energy; larger variance at mean zero raises activity; PtFeCoNiCu HEA synthesized as proof.
limitation: Descriptor tested on few alloy systems; extension to other reactions only computed.

problem: Can target uniaxial compressive stress-strain curves be inverse designed rapidly while accounting for printing errors?
mechanism_or_method: Generative machine learning trained with desktop additive manufacturing data, including process-dependent error compensation, to produce architectures matching prescribed curves.
limitation: Limited to uniaxial quasi-static compression and one printing process; about 90% fidelity.
decision_relevance: Lets designers skip iterative print-test cycles for target stress-strain response.

problem: Can hydrogels achieve high toughness and low hysteresis simultaneously without sacrificial energy dissipation structures?
mechanism_or_method: Sliding physical entanglements as primary crosslinks in first network enable oriented stretching and entropy-based reversible energy storage.
limitation: Lab-scale specimens; long-term fatigue and scalability not shown in abstract.

object: high entropy spinel oxide OER catalysts
problem: How do mixing and local strain control oxygen evolution activity in high entropy spinel oxides?
mechanism_or_method: DFT of mixed-site adsorption energies and strain combined with sol-flame synthesis of five-cation spinel and electrochemical testing.
limitation: Model-experiment link rests on alkaline lab tests of a single composition family.

problem: What multi-cation synergy explains the cocktail effect and reversibility in a conversion-type HEO anode?
mechanism_or_method: Atomic and nanoscale characterization during cycling reveals metallic nano-network plus inert-cation-stabilized oxide nanophase accommodating Li.
limitation: Single HEO composition; mechanism inferred from one material system.

problem: Can multiscale toughening motifs of natural materials be translated into strong, tough biomimetic hydrogels?
mechanism_or_method: Freeze-casting-assisted solution substitution builds honeycomb fiber walls, nanocrystalline hydrogen-bonded fibers and ionically crosslinked chains.
limitation: Mechanism attribution is qualitative; lab-scale samples only.

problem: Can controlling interfacial polymerization yield fast permeation and precise Cl-/SO4 separation?
mechanism_or_method: g-C3N4 nanosheets tile the water-hexane interface, slowing piperazine diffusion and forming ordered hollow nanostructures; MD and CFD explain transport.
limitation: Bench-scale membrane coupons; long-term fouling and scale-up not evaluated.

problem: Can a new membrane-forming process give a narrow pore-size distribution for precise ionic sieving?
mechanism_or_method: Anhydrous interfacial polymerization at a solid-liquid interface between sublimated amine layer and acyl chloride in alkane.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; water flux modest and scalability unproven.

object: polymer-based phase change composites for wearable thermal management
problem: Can leakage-free, ultraflexible phase change composites be made by a scalable chemical cross-linking route?
mechanism_or_method: Peroxide-initiated dual 3D crosslinked OBC-SEBS network holds paraffin wax, improving mechanical, thermal and leakage-proof properties.
limitation: Demonstrated only in a small thermotherapy module; long-term cycling not detailed.

object: global green hydrogen-based steel production sites
problem: Where is renewables-based hydrogen direct reduction steel economically competitive worldwide?
mechanism_or_method: Optimization plus machine learning over more than 300 locations combining renewable resources, iron ore quality, wages and coal prices.
limitation: Relies on assumed future prices and technology; excludes detailed supply chain and resource constraints.
decision_relevance: Guides siting of fossil-free steel plants.

problem: How can HEAs activate the lattice oxygen mechanism to raise oxygen evolution activity?
mechanism_or_method: Multi-path electron transfer enhances Ni oxidation with weaker Co-O bonds enabling Ni-Co dual-site LOM; NiFeCoCrW0.2 designed.
limitation: Lab electrolyzer half-cell tests; industrial conditions not demonstrated.

problem: Can membranes combine chlorine resistance and high permeance for Mg/Li separation?
mechanism_or_method: Quaternized-spiro piperazine monomer polymerized with trimesoyl chloride gives charge and free volume with no N-H bonds; scaled to 1x2 m membranes.
limitation: Tested in hypochlorite immersion and modules, not in real brine over long durations.

problem: What are the true Young's modulus and tensile strength of monolayer Ti3C2Tx measured directly?
mechanism_or_method: In situ tensile tests on cut and transferred monolayer nanosheets using nanomechanical push-to-pull device inside an SEM.
limitation: Few monolayer specimens and demanding sample preparation; effective modulus depends on assumed thickness.
decision_relevance: Corrects stiffness values used when designing MXene devices and membranes.

object: retired EV lithium-ion battery reuse and recycling pathways
problem: Which reuse and recycling pathways for retired EV batteries are best economically and environmentally?
mechanism_or_method: Process-based life cycle assessment with economic optimization across reuse scenarios and hydrometallurgical, pyrometallurgical and direct recycling.
limitation: Depends on assumed prices, residual values and process inventories that vary by region.
decision_relevance: Chooses reuse-then-recycle routes for LFP versus NMC batteries.

object: liquid crystal elastomer soft crawling robot
problem: Can distributed programmable thermal actuation give a soft robot multiple crawling modes?
mechanism_or_method: Patterned silver nanowire joule heaters in LCE thermal bimorph create programmable curvature distribution and friction asymmetry for bidirectional crawling.
limitation: Slow thermal actuation and tethered power; demonstrated only on lab surfaces.

object: lithium and zinc supply for batteries
problem: Is zinc a more available and resilient material than lithium for batteries?
mechanism_or_method: Commentary comparing global supply chain resilience, material cost and mass requirement of aqueous zinc versus lithium-ion batteries.
limitation: Opinion piece without new quantitative analysis in abstract.

problem: How can recrystallization be programmed in AM metals without mechanical deformation?
mechanism_or_method: Control solidification structure to tune dislocation density and thermal stability so site-specific heat treatment yields recrystallized and non-recrystallized regions.
limitation: Shown for one steel alloy and laboratory-scale parts.
decision_relevance: Enables site-specific heat treatment to tailor properties in printed metal parts.

object: water transport in reverse osmosis membranes
problem: Is water transport in RO membranes governed by pore flow rather than solution-diffusion?
mechanism_or_method: Nonequilibrium molecular dynamics plus permeation experiments with water and solvents support a pressure-driven solution-friction model.
limitation: Tested on polyamide and cellulose triacetate membranes with limited solvents; MD force-field dependent.
decision_relevance: Changes the transport model used to design RO membranes.

object: Ni-CaO composite catalyst for integrated CO2 capture and conversion
problem: What molecular synergy links CO2 capture and in-situ conversion in calcium looping with dry reforming?
mechanism_or_method: Experiments and DFT show intermediates interactively facilitate carbonate reduction and CH4 dehydrogenation at tuned Ni/CaO interfaces.
limitation: Lab-scale reactor tests at one temperature regime; durability not stated.

object: machine-learned interatomic potential for 16 metals and alloys
problem: Can one general-purpose machine-learned potential cover many elemental metals and their alloys accurately and cheaply?
mechanism_or_method: Neuroevolution potential trained on 16 one-component and 120 two-component systems, with multicomponent systems as interpolation; GPU-accelerated MD.
limitation: Covers only 16 metals; training requires many quantum reference calculations and large GPU resources for scale.

object: MoZn-based high entropy alloy OER catalysts
problem: Can one HEA activate both adsorbate and lattice oxygen mechanisms while staying stable in alkaline OER?
mechanism_or_method: MoZnFeCoNi HEA pairs AEM-promoting Mo with LOM-active Zn; DFT and chemical probes confirm dual-mechanism sites.
limitation: Lab half-cell testing; industrial electrolyzer performance unverified.

problem: Can deep learning forecast rainfall-triggered shallow landslides over large areas better than thresholds?
mechanism_or_method: Deep learning model linking rainfall records to 20 years of landslide occurrence data across Italy.
limitation: Landslide inventories are incomplete and rainfall-only; no validation under quantitative weather forecasts shown.
decision_relevance: Supports operational landslide early warning based on rainfall.

problem: How do dynamic active-site changes under working conditions boost peroxymonosulfate activation for wastewater treatment?
mechanism_or_method: In situ Raman and X-ray absorption plus DFT reveal reversible bond stretching that tunes eg orbitals and electron transfer.
limitation: Model pollutants in lab; synchrotron characterization needed, real wastewater not tested.

problem: How can a strong glassy polymer self-heal at subzero temperatures?
mechanism_or_method: Polyphenol nano-assemblies with many end groups in deep eutectic solvent elastomers provide multiple dynamic bonds and low-barrier secondary relaxations.
limitation: Healing efficiency 85.7% at -20 C; extreme cold and long-term durability untested.

problem: Can hierarchically aligned strong, tough hydrogels be made simply and scalably?
mechanism_or_method: Flow-induced alignment of nanofibrils under ambient conditions yields aligned fibrous, densified anisotropic hydrogels.
limitation: Lab-scale fabrication; scalability asserted rather than demonstrated at large size.

object: lithium-ion battery recycling versus mining supply chains
problem: How do environmental impacts of industrial-scale LIB recycling compare with conventional mining supply chains?
mechanism_or_method: Life cycle assessment of greenhouse gas, water and energy for recycled versus mined battery-grade cathode materials.
limitation: Depends on industrial inventory data and assumed electricity mix.
decision_relevance: Prioritizes clean electricity and mixed-metal products in recycling plants.

problem: Can a unified continuous design space and generative model optimize linear and nonlinear truss metamaterials?
mechanism_or_method: Graph-based variational autoencoder with property predictor gives a latent space for generation and inverse design with customized mechanical properties.
limitation: Designs validated by simulation only in the abstract; manufacturability not experimentally confirmed.
decision_relevance: Automates lattice selection for target stiffness or nonlinear response.

problem: How does cathode chemistry affect supply chain disruption vulnerability for critical minerals?
mechanism_or_method: Mapping supply chains for Li, Co, Ni, Mn, computing vulnerability indices per country and bounding uncertainty with network flow optimization.
limitation: Static supply chain snapshot with uncertain trade data.
decision_relevance: Informs sourcing risk for NMC versus LFP battery strategy.

problem: Can a transparent self-cleaning metamaterial give radiative cooling and diffuse light for roofs?
mechanism_or_method: Polymer micro-photonic structure diffuses sunlight, high mid-IR emissivity gives cooling, and superhydrophobic surface yields self-cleaning.
limitation: Cooling and photosynthesis gains partly estimated; limited outdoor testing and durability data.

problem: How can hydrogel fibers reach silk-like toughness with anti-freezing and water retention?
mechanism_or_method: Ionic crosslinking and crystalline domains built in a salt/glycerol/water ternary solvent mimic ion-adjusted silk structure.
limitation: Lab-scale fibers; long-term environmental stability under real use not shown.

object: rapid solidification in laser powder bed fusion
problem: How does melt convection drive solute trapping and microstructure transitions in AM solidification?
mechanism_or_method: Fully coupled fluid dynamics and microstructure modelling of solute transport during melting and solidification.
limitation: Model-only evidence in abstract; experimental validation not stated.
decision_relevance: Guides process and alloy choices to reduce cracking in printed superalloys.

problem: Can sensing, control and actuation be embodied in materials for autonomous soft robots without electronics?
mechanism_or_method: Modular control units regulated by liquid crystal elastomers respond to light, heat and solvents and combine into logic functions.
limitation: Demonstrated only on lab prototypes with simple stimuli and slow responses.

problem: Can thick-panel origami be printed in one step with self-locking and high load capacity?
mechanism_or_method: Wrapping-based multimaterial FDM printing of rigid panels with stretchable hinges, stacked into a self-locking structure and optimized with a theoretical model.
limitation: Polymer FDM prototypes; scaling and long-term cyclic performance beyond 100 cycles untested.
decision_relevance: Enables printed foldable load-bearing and energy-absorbing structures.

problem: Can scaffolds be delivered minimally invasively and then deform and stiffen in the body?
mechanism_or_method: Amphiphilic dynamic thermoset polyurethanes enable body-temperature shape memory, swelling-induced morphing and water-driven microphase-separation stiffening.
limitation: In vivo implantation performance not shown in abstract.

object: fluorinated anion-embedded MOF for ethylene purification
problem: Can one MOF purify ethylene from C2H2/CO2/C2H4 mixtures in a single step?
mechanism_or_method: GeF6 anion-embedded ZNU-6 with customized pore chemistry; DFT and in situ single-crystal structures reveal host-guest binding.
limitation: Lab breakthrough tests only; scale-up and shaping of MOF not addressed.

object: biochar negative emission deployment in China
problem: What are biochar's negative emission potential, cost and priority deployment sites in China?
mechanism_or_method: Spatially explicit techno-economic and emission analysis across multiple feedstocks.
limitation: Relies on feedstock availability and cost assumptions with national-scale uncertainty.
decision_relevance: Prioritizes regions and feedstocks for biochar carbon removal.

object: bioderived polyester nanofilm membranes for antibiotic desalination
problem: Can a plant-derived monomer tune free volume for selective antibiotic desalination by nanofiltration?
mechanism_or_method: Stevioside as aqueous monomer in interfacial polymerization gives an 18 nm selective layer with interconnected microporosity.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes tested with model antibiotic streams.

problem: Can a nanofluidic catalytic membrane overcome the permeability-selectivity trade-off in water purification?
mechanism_or_method: 2D Co@VMT membrane combines filtration with nanoconfined peroxymonosulfate activation to degrade pollutants without brine.
limitation: Stability shown for about 107 hours; needs oxidant dosing and scale-up evidence.

object: pore formation in directed energy deposition
problem: How do pores form, move and get removed or trapped during DED additive manufacturing?
mechanism_or_method: In situ X-ray imaging combined with multi-physics modelling quantifies five bubble evolution mechanisms in the melt pool.
limitation: Synchrotron imaging on limited materials and conditions; generality to other DED setups uncertain.
decision_relevance: Guides powder quality and process settings to minimize DED porosity.

problem: Can a multilayer strategy with topology optimization produce ultrastiff lattice metamaterials?
mechanism_or_method: Multilayer parameterization enlarges design space; topology optimization yields beam-plate-shell combined architectures.
limitation: Abstract reports computational designs; fabrication and experimental verification not stated.
decision_relevance: Sets lattice topology choices for maximum stiffness and energy absorption.

problem: Can an elastomer be both mechanically robust and self-healing through supramolecular interactions?
mechanism_or_method: Coordination and hydrogen bonds give phased energy dissipation; shape memory recovery force closes damage for healing; clustering-triggered emission.
limitation: Healing conditions and long-term durability not quantified in abstract.

problem: Can ceramic aerogels be both flexible and strong for thermal insulation?
mechanism_or_method: Laminated SiC-SiOx nanowire architecture gives reversible compressibility, ductile tension and order-of-magnitude higher strength.
limitation: Small lab samples; scalable production and long-term thermal cycling not shown.

problem: Can Tesla valves with capillary structures rectify two-phase flow and boost heat transfer?
mechanism_or_method: Tesla valves eliminate vapor backflow while capillary structures wick liquid along sidewalls, giving a switchable high-performance regulator.
limitation: Bench-scale device tests; integration with real power electronics not demonstrated.
decision_relevance: Informs switchable two-phase cooling design for power electronics.

object: mixed spent cathodes upcycled to LiFe0.5Mn0.5PO4
problem: Can mixed spent LiFePO4 and Mn-rich cathodes be upcycled into a high-voltage polyanionic cathode?
mechanism_or_method: Deep eutectic solvent regeneration with transition metal replacement and structural design recycles all elements into LiFe0.5Mn0.5PO4.
limitation: Gram-scale only; techno-economic benefits are projections.

problem: Can a bioinspired patch give firm wet adhesion and active injection drug delivery?
mechanism_or_method: Teeth and venom-inspired thermo-responsive microneedles with on-demand release, plus bionic suction cups for wet adhesion.
limitation: Animal-level efficacy only; clinical translation untested.

object: skin-inspired sensory soft robots for implants
problem: Can electronic skin and artificial muscle be integrated into soft robots for sensing and actuation on tissues?
mechanism_or_method: In-situ solution-based integration of e-skin and artificial muscle with battery-free wireless module; cuff, gripper, ingestible and patch demos.
limitation: Short-term demonstrations; chronic biocompatibility and reliability not established.

problem: Can a dielectric elastomer give large strain and high energy density at low driving field?
mechanism_or_method: Polar fluorinated groups and long-alkyl-chain nanodomains raise dielectric constant while keeping low modulus.
limitation: Lifetime, breakdown reliability and tethered high-voltage operation not discussed.

object: loosely cross-linked slightly dehydrated polyacrylamide hydrogel
problem: Can a single-network hydrogel be tough, fatigue-resistant and stiff simultaneously?
mechanism_or_method: Loose cross-linking with long chains plus slight dehydration creates dense entanglements.
limitation: Demonstrated on polyacrylamide; stability of dehydrated state against humidity not addressed.

problem: How do ion affinity and dehydration in MOF channels control high-precision monovalent/divalent cation separation?
mechanism_or_method: Functionalized UiO-66-(X)2 membranes tune group and channel size to widen transport activation energy differences between ions.
limitation: Small-area lab membranes with defined salt solutions.

problem: What defines high entropy in battery materials and what challenges remain?
mechanism_or_method: Commentary reviewing definitions, benefits and open synthesis, characterization and modelling challenges.
limitation: Perspective piece with no new data.

problem: Which equimolar quinary alloys form single-phase solid solutions?
mechanism_or_method: High-throughput DFT with a binary regular solid-solution model over 658,000 alloys; two predicted alloys synthesized.
limitation: Model neglects some competing phases; only two predictions experimentally verified.
decision_relevance: Narrows alloy compositions worth synthesizing for high-entropy alloy design.

problem: Can data-efficient machine learning design multi-property architected materials for bone implants?
mechanism_or_method: ML cycle of FEM and 3D neural networks optimizes heterogeneous microarchitectures, adapted with machine-human synergy to a bone defect.
limitation: Animal bone defect model tested mechanically only; in vivo outcomes unknown.
decision_relevance: Guides implant architecture choice for matching bone modulus and strength.

problem: Can solar vapor generation collect salt passively with zero brine discharge?
mechanism_or_method: Mangrove-mimicking titanium mesh stem and leaves wick water; edge-precipitated salt peels off by gravity at night.
limitation: Outdoor yield about 2.2 L per square meter per day; long-term durability unreported.

object: monoatomic V-based SCR catalyst with weak current
problem: Can weak current assistance enable low-temperature NH3-SCR NOx reduction on a low-V catalyst?
mechanism_or_method: Weak current concentrates electrons around V single atoms, weakening V-O bonds (electron scissors effect) and accelerating oxygen cycling.
limitation: Lab reactor tests; applicability to flue gas with poisons not shown.

problem: Can robust, crack-resistant, self-healable hydrogel fibers be spun in water at ambient conditions?
mechanism_or_method: Spider-inspired aqueous pultrusion spinning creates hydrogen-bond clusters nanoconfined in an ionically complexed hygroscopic matrix.
limitation: Lab-scale spinning; moisture-driven healing depends on humidity conditions.

object: anionic high-entropy doped graphite electromagnetic absorbers
problem: Can anionic high-entropy doping tailor electromagnetic wave absorption in thin graphite frameworks?
mechanism_or_method: In situ pyrolysis and three-stage solvent thermal doping induces anion multibody interactions and localized charge imbalance for dielectric loss.
limitation: Lab powders measured at low filling; mechanism inferred qualitatively.

problem: Can dynamic water gating reduce latent heat and heat loss in interfacial solar evaporation?
mechanism_or_method: Bilayer foam with porous PDA photothermal layer and thermo-responsive sporopollenin gating layer controls thin-water-layer supply.
limitation: Lab one-sun tests; outdoor long-term performance and fouling not reported.

problem: How can switch-based energy management circuits raise TENG energy conversion efficiency and give stable output?
mechanism_or_method: Energy transfer analysis of voltage and charge losses at switches, co-optimizing TENG and switch configuration with storage and regularization circuit.
limitation: Bench demos with small electronics; long-term and large-scale harvesting performance untested.
decision_relevance: Guides power-management circuit design for TENG-powered devices.

object: electrochemical direct air capture with neutral red
problem: Can neutral red redox chemistry capture CO2 from air electrochemically at lower work than thermal methods?
mechanism_or_method: Aqueous neutral red solubilized by nicotinamide hydrotrope in a continuous flow cell, giving high electron utilization.
limitation: Lower electron utilization (0.38) from ambient air; work values estimated, oxygen sensitivity.

problem: Can a nanocrystalline refractory high-entropy alloy resist extreme irradiation and helium implantation?
mechanism_or_method: Combined simulation-guided alloy design and in situ electron microscopy under heavy-ion, dual-beam irradiation and helium implantation.
limitation: Lab-scale irradiation tests; reactor-relevant neutron conditions and mechanical performance not shown in abstract.
decision_relevance: Candidate selection of plasma-facing and reactor structural alloys

problem: Can a scalable membrane switch wettability reversibly for separating diverse oil/water systems with self-cleaning?
mechanism_or_method: Capillary force-driven confinement self-assembly coating CO2-responsive copolymer uniformly onto membrane, up to 3600 cm2.
limitation: Lab-scale separation tests; long-term fouling and industrial operation not demonstrated.

object: global road transport electrification metal demand and emissions
problem: What is the trade-off between critical metal demand and GHG reduction from vehicle electrification across 48 countries?
mechanism_or_method: Demand-side scenario modeling of EV penetration, critical metal requirements and fuel-cycle emissions to 2050.
limitation: Results depend on scenario assumptions about penetration, recycling and energy transition; uncertainty not detailed.
decision_relevance: Informs EV penetration policy and critical-metal supply planning

problem: Can one robot repurpose its appendages as wheels, thrusters and legs to traverse varied terrain and fly?
mechanism_or_method: Bio-inspired appendage repurposing with multifunctional limbs combining wheels, propeller thrusters and leg joints, with onboard autonomy.
limitation: Demonstrated in limited test terrains; energy efficiency and robustness in field conditions not quantified.
decision_relevance: Design of multi-modal mobile robots for unstructured terrain

problem: Can retired batteries be sorted by cathode chemistry without operating history while preserving data privacy among recyclers?
mechanism_or_method: Federated machine learning on end-of-life charge-discharge features with Wasserstein-distance voting strategy.
limitation: Only 130 batteries; generalization to more chemistries and real recycling settings unproven.
decision_relevance: Battery recycling sorting and data-sharing strategy

object: mixed-matrix membranes with PIM-1 and hollow MOFs for CO2 capture
problem: How to break the permeability-selectivity trade-off in MOF/polymer mixed-matrix membranes for gas separation?
mechanism_or_method: Polyphenol molecular soldering of PIM-1 chains with hollow MOFs giving defect-free interfaces and rigidified chains.
limitation: Lab-scale films; long-term aging and large-area manufacturing not addressed in abstract.

object: porous organic polycarbene adsorbent for gold recovery
problem: Can carbene sites in a porous polymer capture gold selectively from electronic waste solutions?
mechanism_or_method: Poly(ionic liquid)-derived porous polycarbene with metal-carbene bonding and Au reduction, supported by DFT and life cycle assessment.
limitation: Tested on lab-prepared e-waste leachate; real industrial streams and scale-up unverified.

problem: Can dandelion-like soft actuator structures enable controllable light-driven falling and upward flight?
mechanism_or_method: Ultralight tubular bimorph soft actuator pappus whose deformation under light controls drag, with programmable autorotation direction.
limitation: Flight is brief (~8.9 s) and only above a light source in lab; no free outdoor flight.
decision_relevance: Design of untethered light-powered micro aerial devices

problem: Can a recyclable sorbent selectively recover silver from complex wastewater?
mechanism_or_method: Mo(V)/Mo(VI) oxide reducing Ag+ to metallic Ag, with lowered reduction barrier shown by DFT.
limitation: Only five recycling cycles and simulated wastewater; real effluent performance not shown.

problem: What is the origin and structure of defects in MOF-74 and how do they affect adsorption?
mechanism_or_method: Multi-dimensional solid-state NMR with DFT and molecular simulation identifying formate from decomposed DMF substituting ligands.
limitation: Specific to MOF-74 synthesized in DMF; generality to other frameworks not established.

object: EU vehicle-to-grid and second-life batteries stationary storage
problem: How much can V2G and second-life batteries displace new stationary storage and primary material demand in the EU?
mechanism_or_method: Dynamic material flow analysis of EV battery stocks under V2G and second-life scenarios to 2050.
limitation: Scenario-based; depends on assumed participation rates and battery degradation behavior.
decision_relevance: Prioritizing V2G versus battery reuse in grid storage policy

object: laminated metastable titanium alloy with nanoprecipitates
problem: How to raise yield strength of a TRIP titanium alloy without losing uniform elongation and toughness?
mechanism_or_method: Heterogeneous submicron-laminated structure with alpha nanoprecipitates that strengthen, trigger TRIP and promote delamination toughening.
limitation: Single model alloy composition; processing scalability and fatigue behavior not reported.
decision_relevance: Microstructure design of strong ductile titanium alloys

problem: Can generative learning overcome data scarcity for SOH estimation of retired batteries under random SOC conditions?
mechanism_or_method: Generative model extends measured pulse-injection data space; regressor trained on generated data estimates SOH at unseen SOC.
limitation: Requires initial pulse data from 2700 samples; economic savings are projected under uniform deployment assumption.
decision_relevance: Battery reuse and recycling pretreatment testing protocol

problem: How to make radiative cooling films both mechanically strong and durable while keeping high solar reflectivity?
mechanism_or_method: Solvent exchange-reprotonation processing forming lamellar aramid nanofiber network anchoring core-shell TiO2-coated mica scatterers.
limitation: Outdoor tests short-term; long-term weathering and large-area production not shown.
decision_relevance: Material choice for durable passive cooling surfaces

object: laser powder bed fusion copper with LaB6 nanoparticles
problem: How to 3D print copper with both high strength and high conductivity?
mechanism_or_method: Uniform dispersion of trace LaB6 nanoparticles in pure Cu improves L-PBF processability, strength and thermal stability.
limitation: Single reinforcement system; fatigue and complex-part performance not reported in abstract.
decision_relevance: Feedstock choice for additively manufactured copper components

problem: How does accident occurrence differ between autonomous and human-driven vehicles in similar scenarios?
mechanism_or_method: Matched case-control analysis of 2100 ADS/ADAS and 35113 human-driven vehicle accident records.
limitation: Scarce AV accident data, reporting bias and unknown exposure limit causal interpretation.
decision_relevance: Targets AV safety development for dawn/dusk and turning

object: wearable magnetoelastic sensing-actuation system for speech
problem: Can a wearable system enable speaking without vocal fold vibration?
mechanism_or_method: Soft magnetoelastic sensor reads laryngeal muscle movement, ML translates to speech, and actuator generates voice signals.
limitation: Small user testing; patients with real voice disorders and vocabulary breadth not demonstrated.

problem: Can a self-powered monitoring node harvest ultra-low-frequency wave energy at high density?
mechanism_or_method: Point-defect metamaterial concentrating vibration energy at a defect, with integrated wireless monitoring node.
limitation: Field operation tested over about 24 h only; long-term survivability in marine conditions unproven.
decision_relevance: Design of self-powered ocean monitoring nodes

problem: How can an intermetallic alloy be both strong and plastic from room to high temperature?
mechanism_or_method: Highly distorted lattice with complex chemical order enabling multiple slip systems and dislocation-glide-triggered dynamic hardening.
limitation: Single alloy composition; creep, oxidation and processing scalability not addressed.
decision_relevance: Alloy design of ductile intermetallics for high temperature

problem: Can fallen leaves with hygroscopic iron hydrogel coating generate continuous power from ambient moisture?
mechanism_or_method: Asymmetric hygroscopic iron hydrogel coating forms water gradient and electrical double layers on carbon-coated leaf veins.
limitation: Low power output; leaf variability and long-term stability not shown.

problem: Why do hydrogels show concurrent stiffening and softening during dehydration, contrary to Flory-based theory?
mechanism_or_method: Experiments plus coarse-grained molecular dynamics and a new theoretical model of scaling of mechanics with water content.
limitation: Model validated for specific hydrogel systems; generality across polymer networks unclear.
decision_relevance: Predicting hydrogel stiffness in drying soft devices

problem: Can fabric harvest sustained electricity from moisture absorption-evaporation cycles at scale?
mechanism_or_method: Unidirectional moisture conduction in fabric with negative charge channels inducing charge separation and constant voltage output.
limitation: Output depends on humidity and temperature; durability of large integrated arrays not shown.

object: magnetic multi-layer soft robot for targeted adhesion
problem: Can multi-layer magnetic soft film robots locomote and separate to adhere to targets in the stomach?
mechanism_or_method: Modeled and tailored magnetic interaction between film layers with distinct in-plane structures plus adhesive films.
limitation: Simulation only qualitatively agrees with experiments; limited in vivo scale and duration.
decision_relevance: Design of magnetic soft robots for targeted drug adhesion

object: Ti(OH)PO4 ion-pair sites for electrochemical uranium extraction
problem: How to extract uranium efficiently from fluoride-containing nuclear wastewater electrochemically?
mechanism_or_method: Ti-PO4 ion pair sites binding UO2Fx via Ti-F and O-U-O bonds, with crystalline transition during extraction.
limitation: Tested on wastewater samples at lab scale; electrode durability and scale-up unclear.

problem: How to print soft stretchable and stiff regions in one layer with a single vat and single cure?
mechanism_or_method: Resin design where light intensity locally controls monomer conversion, yielding organogel-to-thermoset modulus contrast.
limitation: Demonstrated for specific resin chemistry; resolution limits and long-term stability not given.
decision_relevance: Process choice for multimaterial soft-stiff printed structures

problem: How to achieve rapid, universal, robust hydrogel adhesion to solids and tissues without surface pretreatment?
mechanism_or_method: Modulating hydrogel mechanics and surface chemical activation of nanoparticles to form nanohesives.
limitation: Adhesion durability under long-term dynamic loading and in vivo duration not detailed.
decision_relevance: Choosing adhesives for hydrogel-sensor integration on tissues

problem: Why does porous polymer coating lose cooling ability at high drying humidity and how to fix it?
mechanism_or_method: Identified humidity vulnerability during drying and added small polymer reinforcement to maintain solar reflectance up to 60% RH.
limitation: Coverage estimate is modeled; outdoor long-term performance of reinforced paint not demonstrated.
decision_relevance: Application humidity limits for radiative cooling paint

problem: Can anisotropic self-healing pH-responsive hydrogels be programmed into soft robots?
mechanism_or_method: Shear-aligned cellulose nanocrystals in zwitterionic network give anisotropic swelling; cut-and-paste self-healing programs deformation.
limitation: Only proof-of-concept light cargo transport; response speed and force output not quantified.

problem: How to stabilize nano-precipitates in aluminum alloys against coarsening at elevated temperatures?
mechanism_or_method: Multiple interface structures including Sc segregation layers, C and L phases and new chi-AgMg phase covering theta-prime precipitates.
limitation: Contains scandium, which is costly; creep and fatigue under service conditions not reported.
decision_relevance: Alloy design for elevated-temperature aluminum components

object: ionic-conductive silk fibroin hydrogel fiber textiles
problem: Can strong ionic-conductive fibers make textiles that sense danger and pinpoint touch?
mechanism_or_method: Oriented silk fibroin ionic hydrogel fibers woven into protective and touch-sensing textiles for robots.
limitation: Ionic hydrogel fibers sensitive to humidity and drying; long-term durability not reported.

problem: Can combining molecular crystals and polymers give fast temperature- and humidity-responsive soft actuators?
mechanism_or_method: Hybrid organic crystal-polymer elements with polymer-added hygro- and thermoresponse, actuating within milliseconds.
limitation: Small-scale demonstrators; force output and cycle lifetime not specified.

object: bimodal softness and texture haptic sensor
problem: How to quantify softness and texture simultaneously for adaptive robotic gripping?
mechanism_or_method: Bimodal haptic sensor measuring elastic and frictional coefficients from static and dynamic stimuli to set grip force.
limitation: Tested on porcine mucosa and strawberries; broad object variety and clinical use unproven.
decision_relevance: Grip force strategy for delicate object handling robots

object: rolling-mode triboelectric nanogenerator for wave energy
problem: How to raise current and durability of TENGs for powering marine sensing nodes?
mechanism_or_method: Rolling-mode TENG with multi-tunnel grating electrodes and opposite-charge-enhancement, plus power management module and wireless link.
limitation: In-situ ocean tests appear short; long-term wear and biofouling not reported.
decision_relevance: Power source selection for remote marine sensing nodes

problem: Can a robust scalable MOF purify ethylene from C2 ternary mixtures in one step?
mechanism_or_method: Multiple supramolecular binding sites in low-polarity pores, visualized by single-crystal X-ray diffraction, preferentially binding C2H2 and C2H6.
limitation: Breakthrough tests at lab scale; performance under humid industrial streams not shown.

problem: Can a non-Pt/Pd catalyst oxidize soot as well as commercial Pt catalysts?
mechanism_or_method: Single-atom Ru at CeO2 surface lattice sites made by bubbling-assisted membrane deposition, boosting NO oxidation.
limitation: Model soot tests; real engine exhaust, sulfur poisoning and aging not covered.

object: ionic liquid@MOF photocatalyst for diluted CO2 reduction
problem: Can a photocatalyst capture and convert diluted flue-gas CO2 in gas-solid phase?
mechanism_or_method: Host-guest integration of CO2-enriching ionic liquid in PCN-250-Fe2M MOFs lowering rate-determining Gibbs barrier.
limitation: Gram-scale tests only; stability over long operation with real flue gas impurities unclear.

object: iodine single-atom catalyst for Fenton-like reactions
problem: Can non-metallic iodine single atoms activate peroxymonosulfate efficiently for pollutant degradation?
mechanism_or_method: C-I coordination in N-doped carbon tuning electronic structure, lowering barrier for SO5 radical and singlet oxygen generation.
limitation: Lab degradation of model pollutants; real wastewater matrices and catalyst lifetime not shown.

problem: Can textile gloves record, reproduce and transfer tactile interactions adaptively across users?
mechanism_or_method: Digital embroidery embeds piezoresistive sensors and vibrotactile actuators; ML pipeline personalizes haptic feedback parameters.
limitation: User studies appear small; long-term wearability and washability not reported.

problem: Can mechanochromic photonic crystals record and erase multicolor patterns for rewritable paper?
mechanism_or_method: Non-close-packed photonic crystals combined with phase-change materials; color fixed on cooling and erased by heating.
limitation: Rewrite cycle lifetime and large-area uniformity not specified.

problem: Can a green moisture-electric generator deliver milliamp-scale continuous current for practical devices?
mechanism_or_method: PVA-sodium alginate supramolecular hydrogel with enhanced moisture absorption and sustained water gradient driving ion transport.
limitation: Performance relies on ambient humidity; long-term hydrogel stability only demonstrated for about a month.

object: amino acid and peptide biomolecular glasses
problem: Can biodegradable glasses be made from amino acids and peptides by heating-quenching?
mechanism_or_method: End-modified amino acids or peptides form supercooled liquid before decomposition and vitrify on quenching; castable and 3D printable.
limitation: Mechanical strength and thermal stability relative to commercial glass not reported in abstract.

object: tungsten refractory high-entropy alloy with coherent nanoprecipitates
problem: How to raise strength of tungsten refractory alloys without sacrificing tensile ductility?
mechanism_or_method: Stepwise controllable coherent nanoprecipitations whose coherent interfaces ease dislocation transmission and stress concentration.
limitation: Single alloy system; irradiation, creep and fabrication scalability not reported.
decision_relevance: Alloy design for plasma-facing high-temperature structures

problem: How to fabricate highly stretchable porous conductive elastomers with low or negative Poisson's ratio?
mechanism_or_method: Uniaxial, biaxial and triaxial hot-pressing of rGO/polymer nanocomposites to create folded or reentrant porous structures.
limitation: Cyclic durability and scalability of hot-pressing process not stated.

object: polyamide reverse osmosis membrane via surfactant-assisted interfacial polymerization
problem: How does self-assembled surfactant micelle at the interface produce crumpled ultrapermeable polyamide layers?
mechanism_or_method: Surfactant micellar system in interfacial polymerization; multiscale simulations reveal monolayer disruption and interfacial instability forming crumples.
limitation: Lab membrane coupons; long-term fouling and chlorine stability not addressed.

object: flash Joule heating battery black mass recycling
problem: Can ultrafast heating enable efficient low-impact recovery of battery metals with dilute acid?
mechanism_or_method: Pulsed dc flash Joule heating to above 2100 K decomposes SEI and reduces metal valence, boosting leaching kinetics roughly 1000-fold.
limitation: Lab-scale batch processing; industrial scale throughput and energy cost uncertain.
decision_relevance: Selection of battery recycling pretreatment process

problem: How to get large workspace and high payload from soft pneumatic actuators?
mechanism_or_method: Less stretchable soft fabric actuators with programmable, combinable, predictable motion modes at low pressure.
limitation: Demonstrated in a gripper prototype; cycle life and wear of fabric not discussed.
decision_relevance: Choosing fabric versus elastomer for high-payload soft grippers

problem: Can a MOF-polymer composite extract gold from water within seconds with high capacity?
mechanism_or_method: Highly porous MOF combined with poly(p-phenylenediamine) enabling rapid redox adsorption of Au3+.
limitation: Lab matrices only; scale-up and MOF production cost not addressed.

problem: How large is Earth's subsurface natural hydrogen endowment?
mechanism_or_method: Stochastic mass balance model using knowledge of natural hydrogen occurrence and geologic analogs.
limitation: Uncertainty spans seven orders of magnitude; recoverable fraction unknown.
decision_relevance: Justifies exploration investment in geologic hydrogen

object: lignin alkali regulated polyamide nanofiltration membrane
problem: Can a waste-derived additive give a nanofiltration membrane both high permeance and high ion selectivity?
mechanism_or_method: Lignin alkali additive promotes piperazine diffusion in interfacial polymerization, forming ultrathin crumpled highly cross-linked polyamide.
limitation: Lab-scale membrane tests; long-term fouling and module-scale performance not shown.

problem: How can force generate ions in a mobile-ion-free zwitterionic hydrogel for sensitive pressure sensing?
mechanism_or_method: Pressure reduces zwitterion spacing, dissociating water, while zwitterionic channels transport ions; used in throat-worn silent-speech system.
limitation: Water dissociation mechanism inferred; hydrogel dehydration stability and recognition vocabulary not reported.

problem: Can a low-toxicity Al-based MOF adsorb trace benzene with high capacity and separate it from cyclohexane?
mechanism_or_method: Double-walled Al MOF with helical AlO6 chains and large microporous surface area; GCMC identifies two benzene sites.
limitation: Lab vapor adsorption only; humidity effects and regeneration over many cycles not reported.

problem: Can fully biodegradable electrohydraulic actuators match performance of non-biodegradable ones?
mechanism_or_method: Compatible biodegradable polymer films, ester-based liquid dielectric and NaCl-gelatin hydrogel electrodes operated up to 200 V/um.
limitation: Requires high voltage; biodegradation behavior under operating conditions and shelf life unclear.
decision_relevance: Material selection for sustainable soft robotic actuators

problem: Can gradient nanostructure improve both yield strength and tensile plasticity of nanostructured steel?
mechanism_or_method: Gradient structure whose outer nanolaminate grains undergo grain reorientation co-deformation, altering post-necking rupture mode.
limitation: Single steel grade and processing route; fatigue and scalability not reported.
decision_relevance: Structural steel design for strength-ductility synergy

problem: How to jointly optimize wearer comfort and output power of wearable thermoelectric generators?
mechanism_or_method: Sandwiched thermoelectric model coupling skin temperature, pressure, thermal environment, bending and materials; built with Mg-based thermoelectrics.
limitation: Power density is low in absolute terms; long-term wearing trials not reported.
decision_relevance: Design of wearable thermoelectric devices balancing comfort and power

problem: Can one origami module deliver all basic deformation modes and their combinations for soft robots?
mechanism_or_method: Pneumatic origami unit with decoupled bending, twisting and extension, seven modes via pressurization schemes, plug-and-play assembly.
limitation: Tethered pneumatic control; load capacity and fatigue life of origami modules not specified.

problem: Can cardiac motion energy power a battery-free transcatheter pacemaker in large animals?
mechanism_or_method: Capsule device using triboelectrification and electrostatic induction to convert heartbeat motion into pacing pulses.
limitation: Three-week swine follow-up with very low current; long-term reliability and human translation uncertain.

object: ultraflexible organic photovoltaic and zinc-ion battery system
problem: Can ultraflexible harvesters and storage be integrated into a thin autonomous wearable power system?
mechanism_or_method: 90 um-thick integration of high-efficiency organic photovoltaics with zinc-ion batteries in a compliant configuration.
limitation: Long-term cycling and environmental stability under wearing conditions not described.

object: few-atom-layer metal on high-entropy alloy nitrate reduction catalyst
problem: Can exsolved few-atom-layer metal on HEAs break linear scaling relations for nitrate-to-ammonia reduction?
mechanism_or_method: Surface entropy reduction exsolves a weakly bound component into few-atom-layer metal giving geometrically separated tandem active sites.
limitation: Lab electrolysis cell tests; industrial current density and stability beyond 200 h unknown.

object: CrCoNi medium-entropy alloy under laser shock
problem: How does CrCoNi deform and fail under extreme shock loading and release?
mechanism_or_method: Laser-driven shock experiments with multiscale characterization and molecular dynamics showing planar defect networks and void growth control.
limitation: Microsecond-scale laser shock on small samples; relevance to macroscopic impact conditions uncertain.
decision_relevance: Material selection for impact and extreme-load structures

problem: Can a millimeter-scale continuum robot extend at its tip and navigate lumina without relying on wall contact?
mechanism_or_method: Phase-transition components alternate solid-like backbone and liquid-like advancement, steered by programmable magnetic fields, morphing into 3D tools.
limitation: Demonstrated in phantoms and limited models; clinical safety and speed of advancement not established.
decision_relevance: Design of magnetically steered robots for transluminal surgery

problem: How to achieve fast, selective monovalent ion transport through membranes via complete ion dehydration.
mechanism_or_method: In situ growth of UiO-66 with confined dibenzo crown ethers combining size sieving and interaction screening.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; simulations only presumably explain dehydration; long-term stability not described.

object: China EV lithium-ion battery recycling system
problem: Can closed-loop battery recycling relieve critical material scarcity under China's EV targets, and at what collection rate?
mechanism_or_method: Integrated scenario framework combining material flow, environmental, geospatial optimization and cost analysis through 2060.
limitation: Results depend on scenario assumptions about deployment, technology and prices through 2060.
decision_relevance: Sets minimum battery collection rate and recycling siting for supply stability.

object: liquid metal nanoparticle polymer composites for 4D printing
problem: How to 3D print liquid metal-polymer composites that show NIR-triggered shape memory for soft robots.
mechanism_or_method: RAFT agents grafted on liquid metal nanoparticles formed in situ in stereolithography resin enabling photothermal shape recovery.
limitation: Only lab demonstrations; mechanical properties are reduced and long-term cycling is not reported.

object: ultrasonic contact-electro-catalysis for precious metal reduction
problem: Can water-solid contact electrification drive reduction and extraction of precious metal ions from solution?
mechanism_or_method: Ultrasound-driven contact electrification at water-solid interfaces produces electrons reducing metal ions, supported by EPR and ab initio simulation.
limitation: Mostly synthetic solutions; real e-waste leachate performance and scaling are only briefly shown.

problem: How to make epoxy thermosets that are both tough and closed-loop recyclable at room temperature.
mechanism_or_method: Vanillin-based hyperbranched epoxy with hydrogen bonds, dynamic imine bonds and cavities dissipating energy and enabling depolymerization.
limitation: Lab-scale samples; durability under service conditions and cost are not addressed.

object: bilayer polymer moisture-electric generator with radiative cooling
problem: How to sustain moisture-electric power output despite daytime evaporation and environmental fluctuations.
mechanism_or_method: Hydrophobic radiative-cooling top layer over LiCl hygroscopic ionic hydrogel creating stable internal water and ion flow.
limitation: Low power density (about 51 microwatt per cm2) and only six days of outdoor operation.

object: solar-wind driven sorption atmospheric water harvesting device
problem: How to raise water productivity of sorption-based atmospheric water harvesting with continuous operation.
mechanism_or_method: Hygroscopic interconnected porous gel plus concentrated sunlight and natural wind coupling for desorption, condensation and sorption kinetics.
limitation: Outdoor yields much lower than indoor record; depends on solar concentration and local weather.
decision_relevance: Informs design of off-grid passive water harvesting devices.

problem: What is the distribution of carbon footprints of NMC811 and LFP batteries given material sourcing variation?
mechanism_or_method: Cost-based emission curves for lithium, nickel and cobalt from mining cost data combined with regionalised production announcements.
limitation: Cost-to-emission proxy relies on assumptions and announced rather than realised production.
decision_relevance: Prioritises material sourcing over plant location in battery decarbonisation policy.

problem: How to reconcile fast degradation and toxicity in porous Zn scaffolds while promoting immunomodulatory bone ingrowth.
mechanism_or_method: Multiscale design: Zn-0.8Li eutectoid lamellar microstructure, nano-rough surface and isotropic minimal-surface G lattice.
limitation: Animal model only; long-term degradation and clinical translation are untested.

object: nanoconfined water in vertically aligned carbon nanotube solar evaporators
problem: Why does solar evaporation rate rise as nanochannel diameter shrinks, exceeding the theoretical limit?
mechanism_or_method: Janus CNT@AAO evaporators with experiments, theory and molecular simulation showing fewer hydrogen bonds and lower energy barrier.
limitation: Mechanism described as a possible reason only; scalability of CNT arrays unaddressed.

object: heterocyclic aramid fibers with SWNT additions
problem: How to raise strength and toughness of aramid fibers simultaneously despite their intrinsic trade-off.
mechanism_or_method: In situ polymerization with 0.05 wt% short aminated SWNTs improving crystallinity, orientation and interfacial stress transfer.
limitation: Lab-scale spinning; impact protection performance not tested at component level.

problem: How to decouple mechanical strength, mass transport and catalytic efficiency in high-throughput water purification catalysts.
mechanism_or_method: Overlapping microlattices with bimodal pores made by metal 3D printing and electrochemical Co decoration, plus simulation.
limitation: Lab-scale reactor tests; long-term catalytic stability and cost of metal printing not addressed.

problem: What governs freezing dynamics and morphology of small saline droplets compared with pure water?
mechanism_or_method: Observation of brine films and ice sprouting controlled by condensation at the brine free interface, validated by molecular dynamics.
limitation: Single-droplet lab conditions; applicability to sea spray and desalination systems not tested.
decision_relevance: Guides anti-icing and droplet freeze desalination design.

object: electrothermal active origami from 4D-printed continuous carbon fiber composites
problem: How to realize precisely controlled, load-bearing, reconfigurable active origami.
mechanism_or_method: 4D printing continuous carbon fibers in shape memory composite with Joule heating and multiphysics modeling for actuation control.
limitation: Lab demonstrators; energy use, speed and fatigue life of repeated actuation not reported.

problem: How to enable cold-programmed shape morphing in printed shape memory polymers with freer reconfigurability.
mechanism_or_method: Grayscale digital light processing printing heterogeneous hinge modules that are cold-programmed by stretching at room temperature.
limitation: Material-specific requirements and lab demonstrations only; load capacity not quantified in abstract.

object: FCC high-entropy alloy with interstitial-driven local chemical order
problem: How to obtain FCC alloys with ultrahigh strength and ductility at ambient and cryogenic temperatures.
mechanism_or_method: Dynamic development of interstitial-driven local chemical order domains from planar-slip bands, promoting cross-slip, transformation and twinning.
limitation: Small lab samples; fatigue, fracture and scale-up behavior at cryogenic temperature not addressed.

problem: Is fitting capacity and resistance fade sufficient to parameterise degradation models, or are degradation modes needed?
mechanism_or_method: Compare three models with up to five coupled degradation mechanisms against capacity, resistance and degradation modes at three temperatures.
limitation: Validated on one cell type at three temperatures; generalisation to other chemistries untested.
decision_relevance: Requires degradation mode analysis when parameterising battery lifetime models.

object: nanoporous graphene membrane for organic solvent nanofiltration
problem: How to get ultrafast, switchable-cutoff organic solvent permeation through layered graphene membranes.
mechanism_or_method: Thermal pore activation of graphene oxide followed by microwave-assisted reduction giving smooth sp2 domains and dense nanopores.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; long-term fouling and scale-up beyond cross-flow tests not shown.

object: transparent ultrasound transducer for ultrasound and photoacoustic imaging
problem: How to overcome acoustic impedance mismatch so transparent transducers match opaque ones in sensitivity and bandwidth.
mechanism_or_method: Transparent silicon dioxide-epoxy composite matching and backing layers with tuned acoustic impedances.
limitation: Small-scale devices; imaging demonstrated in few animals and humans only.

object: high-entropy alloy electrocatalyst surfaces for oxygen reduction
problem: How to quantitatively predict local reactivity of high-entropy alloy surface sites for oxygen reduction.
mechanism_or_method: Descriptor combining active-center d-band filling and neighborhood electronegativity, validated with external DFT calculations and activity maps.
limitation: Computational predictions without experimental validation of proposed Pd-rich and Ir-rich alloys.

object: woven liquid crystal elastomer fiber soft actuators
problem: How to overcome limited deformation and complex manufacturing in fiber soft actuators for multifunctional soft robots.
mechanism_or_method: Rope-weaving of electro-driven LCE fibers into twisting, four-strand, orthogonal and diagonal weaving actuators.
limitation: Lab demonstrations of locomotion and pumping; durability and power efficiency not quantified.

object: high-entropy alloy nanocrystals of platinum-group metals
problem: How to synthesize HEA nanocrystals in a controllable and predictable manner rather than by trial and error.
mechanism_or_method: Predict structure from precursor reduction kinetics and mixing entropy under dropwise addition of mixed precursor solution.
limitation: Demonstrated for one quinary platinum-group system; generality to other compositions unproven.

object: CALF-20 metal-organic framework for CO2 capture
problem: How do water interactions and framework flexibility govern CO2 and water adsorption in CALF-20?
mechanism_or_method: Combine adsorption isotherm experiments with atomistic simulations, DFT and machine-learned potential molecular dynamics.
limitation: Single material; simulation accuracy of water adsorption depends on force field and potential quality.

object: wearable bioadhesive ultrasound shear wave elastography patch
problem: How to continuously monitor liver stiffness without a handheld probe during rapidly changing acute liver failure.
mechanism_or_method: 128-channel compact bioadhesive transducer array generating acoustic radiation force impulses to induce shear waves.
limitation: Rat model over 48 hours only; human validation and long-term skin adhesion not shown.

object: ionic diode films for hybrid electromagnetic and moisture energy harvesting
problem: How to couple electromagnetic absorption with moisture-enabled generation for wireless energy harvesting and signaling.
mechanism_or_method: Polyelectrolyte/conjugated polymer bilayer ionic diode films whose ion gradients rectify moist-energy and electromagnetic-energy interaction.
limitation: Low-power lab demonstrations; stability under real ambient conditions is not shown.

object: pangolin-inspired untethered magnetic soft robot with localized heating
problem: How to give soft magnetic miniature robots efficient on-demand localized heating without losing compliance.
mechanism_or_method: Bi-layered pangolin-like scale design integrating metallic heating elements with soft magnetic body, driven by external magnetic fields.
limitation: Tested on tissue phantoms and ex vivo tissue only; no in vivo validation.

object: polyMOF/PIM-1 mixed matrix membranes for CO2 separation
problem: How to build MOF nanoparticles that disperse well in polymers and give membranes beyond CO2 permselectivity upper bounds.
mechanism_or_method: Carboxylated PIM-1 ligand coordinated with metals forming approximately 100 nm polyMOF nanoparticles, cast into mixed matrix and thin-film membranes.
limitation: Gas tests on lab membranes; long-term aging and mixed-gas industrial conditions unaddressed.

object: Co single-atom catalyst on hydroxylated ZnO for Fenton-like oxidation
problem: How to selectively generate different active species across different oxidant systems with one single-atom catalyst.
mechanism_or_method: Isolated asymmetric Co-O-Zn sites with surface hydroxyls modulating oxidant adsorption, supported by DFT.
limitation: Pilot-scale tests limited to benzoic acid wastewater; broader matrix and catalyst lifetime unclear.

problem: Can high initial dislocation density increase rather than reduce ductility in work-hardened alloys?
mechanism_or_method: Segregation-dislocation self-organized structures act as dislocation sources and form Lomer-Cottrell locks and jogs for dislocation storage.
limitation: Shown for one additively manufactured alloy; fatigue and scale-up behavior not addressed.

object: hygroscopic gel self-powered energy harvesting and sensing interface
problem: How to extend transient moisture-induced voltage into continuous power with integrated sensing for flexible electronics.
mechanism_or_method: Hygroscopic polymeric gel confines and locks moisture on metal oxide substrate, giving sustained voltage and capacitive sensing.
limitation: Low voltage output (0.32 V); stability beyond four days and real-use durability not shown.

object: refractory high-entropy alloys TiZrHfNbTa and VNbMoTaW
problem: What intrinsic factors make one BCC refractory HEA ductile at low temperature and another brittle?
mechanism_or_method: Experiments, theory and modeling relating HCP-to-BCC element ratio to dislocation core structure, lattice distortion and slip planes.
limitation: Only two prototypical alloys compared; generalisation across the refractory HEA space is untested.
decision_relevance: Guides HCP/BCC element ratio choice for ductile refractory alloys.

object: short-range order in CoCrNi-based multi-principal element alloys
problem: How does processing and cooling rate affect short-range order formation in FCC multi-principal element alloys?
mechanism_or_method: Additive manufacturing across wide cooling rates, semi-quantitative electron microscopy and atomistic simulation of the solidification front.
limitation: Three CoCrNi-based FCC alloys only; the SRO measurement is semi-quantitative.

problem: How to achieve hydrogels with both high strength and low hysteresis for load-bearing uses.
mechanism_or_method: Interpenetrating hydrophilic and hydrophobic networks arrested at microscale phase separation, linked by entanglements.
limitation: Only one polymer pair demonstrated; fatigue and long-term hydration behavior not reported.

object: phase change material aerogels for thermal shock protection
problem: How to get low-cost insulation that also resists transient high-temperature loads.
mechanism_or_method: Encapsulate phase change materials in a micron-porous framework so heat absorption delays heat propagation.
limitation: Thermal conductivity only on par with conventional insulation; stable only up to 300 C.

problem: How to convert impure, mixed waste polyolefins into liquid alkanes without pretreatment or noble metals.
mechanism_or_method: Bifunctional noble metal-free MoSx on Hbeta zeolite for hydroconversion at 180-250 C and 20-30 bar H2.
limitation: Batch-scale reactor tests; hydrogen demand and continuous-process lifetime not demonstrated.

object: spent LiCoO2 as photothermal catalyst for polyester upcycling
problem: Can spent battery cathodes be reused to catalyse solar upcycling of waste polyesters into monomers?
mechanism_or_method: Li deficiency contracts Co-O6 units in spent LCO, boosting photothermal depolymerization yield, with life-cycle assessment.
limitation: Lab-scale reactions; economic and emissions figures rely on extrapolated assumptions.

object: PVC-based dielectric elastomer with cyanoethyl cellulose
problem: How to get dielectric elastomers with high permittivity and low viscoelasticity for actuation and sensing.
mechanism_or_method: Add cyanoethyl cellulose to plasticized PVC gel, raising permittivity and reducing mechanical loss.
limitation: Lab samples; long-term cycling life and environmental stability not described.

object: hydrated La3+ ion layers in aqueous superlubrication
problem: How does hydration layer structure, set by ion surface coverage, control friction under subnanometer confinement?
mechanism_or_method: Characterize hydration layers on surfaces lubricated by trivalent electrolytes, linking structure to two superlubric regimes and dissipation pathways.
limitation: Molecular-scale model system with trivalent La3+ only; macroscopic lubricant relevance unproven.
decision_relevance: Informs ion choice and coverage for water-based lubricants.

object: crack-array strain sensors for soft robots
problem: How to make predictable, durable compliant strain sensors for soft robot perception.
mechanism_or_method: Programmed crack array within micro-crumples with physical models, plus machine learning for trajectory and altitude prediction.
limitation: Demonstrated on one origami robot; performance in uncontrolled environments untested.

object: triboelectric self-powered abyssal ocean current meter
problem: How to measure deep-sea currents with a self-powered, pressure-resistant, wide-range sensor.
mechanism_or_method: Triboelectric nanogenerator with magnetic coupling structure and variable-spacing design harvesting current energy for sensing.
limitation: Single deep-sea deployment; long-duration reliability and biofouling effects not reported.
decision_relevance: Enables self-powered deep-sea current monitoring without batteries.

object: laser powder-bed fusion Al0.5CrCoFeNi high-entropy alloy
problem: How to raise strength without sacrificing fracture resistance in alloys.
mechanism_or_method: Printed nano-bridged honeycomb microstructure of fcc cells and B2 net, with dislocation channels shielding crack tips.
limitation: One alloy and processing route; fatigue and large-component behavior not covered.

object: atomically strained In2S3 photocatalyst for CO2 reduction
problem: Can atomic-scale strain in In2S3 enable visible-light CO2 photoreduction in ambient air?
mechanism_or_method: Oxygen coordination and sulfur vacancies introduce strain, modifying band structure and carrier separation, shown by in situ spectroscopy and theory.
limitation: Low CO production rate (5.16 micromol per g per h); stability and selectivity in air not detailed.

object: patterned liquid crystal elastomer snap-through elements
problem: How to overcome the slow actuation rate of LCEs to produce rapid, powerful snap-through leaping.
mechanism_or_method: Locally patterned director orientation and through-thickness modulus gradients create stimuli-induced mechanical instability, with validated computational model.
limitation: Lab-scale elements; repeatability over many cycles and untethered stimulation not addressed.

problem: How to overcome diffusion-limited actuation speed of hydrogels for high-speed programmable underwater motion.
mechanism_or_method: Photo-activated disulfide exchange programs network anisotropy so thermally driven chain conformation change replaces mass diffusion; photothermal fillers add light actuation.
limitation: Small lab swimmers; payload, efficiency and untethered control are not shown.

problem: How to realize shape-changing 4D printing of ceramics despite their weak deformability.
mechanism_or_method: Multimaterial DLP printing of hydrogel-ceramic laminates that bend on dehydration then sinter, with a curvature model for design.
limitation: Shrinkage and sintering defects limit accuracy; mechanical properties of final ceramics not detailed.

problem: How to efficiently design material distributions that achieve target 3D shape changes in active composites.
mechanism_or_method: Residual network forward shape prediction combined with gradient descent and evolutionary algorithms for inverse material-distribution design.
limitation: Validated on numerically generated target shapes; no printed experimental verification stated.

object: Ti-Zr-Nb medium-entropy alloys with ordered oxygen complexes
problem: Can ordered oxygen complexes raise strength and ductility in other alloys, and how are they tailored?
mechanism_or_method: Tune Nb and oxygen content to reduce phase stability, enhance chemical short-range order and favor ordered oxygen complex formation.
limitation: Limited to bcc Ti-Zr-Nb alloys; excessive oxygen causes grain boundary segregation.

object: wireless miniature magnetic soft robots for tissue sensing
problem: Can wireless soft robots sense physiological tissue properties in situ with minimal invasion?
mechanism_or_method: Magnetic field control of robot-tissue interaction, recovering adhesion, pH and viscoelasticity from robot shape and fields tracked by imaging.
limitation: Ex vivo porcine and mouse tissue only; in vivo validity untested.

object: isotropic ceramic nanofiber aerogels via ice templating
problem: How to scale up isotropic nanofiber aerogels with thermal insulation and mechanical robustness under extreme conditions.
mechanism_or_method: Rotating cryogenic drum freezing, crushing and re-casting decouple ice nucleation and growth, inducing columnar-equiaxed crystal transition.
limitation: Battery module protection shown at lab scale; manufacturing cost and throughput not quantified.
decision_relevance: Supports thin aerogel layers to block battery thermal runaway propagation.

object: electrochemical lithium extraction from geothermal brine
problem: Can lithium be selectively extracted from geothermal brine and converted to battery-grade LiOH economically?
mechanism_or_method: Intercalation-based selective extraction, LiCl purification and bipolar membrane electrodialysis, with parametric techno-economic assessment.
limitation: Cost estimate assumes 0.5-year electrode lifespan; tested on lab scale with Salton Sea brine.

object: millimeter-scale soft robot for intracardiac interventions
problem: How to give catheter tools dexterity, stability and force inside the beating heart.
mechanism_or_method: Soft robotic platform that deploys and self-stabilizes at heart entrance and guides existing interventional tools.
limitation: Two exemplar right-atrium procedures; clinical-scale safety and durability not established.

object: DNA hydrogels for solar desalination and uranium extraction
problem: Can solar evaporation hydrogels simultaneously desalinate seawater and selectively extract uranium?
mechanism_or_method: Uranyl-specific DNA hydrogel whose solar interfacial evaporation drives ion transport to selective binding sites.
limitation: Modest uranium capacity (5.7 mg per g); DNA cost and stability in seawater are unaddressed.

problem: How to exceed catheter and access-port size limits with reconfigurable continuum soft robot tools.
mechanism_or_method: Magnetic soft-robotic chains self-fold into large assemblies via combined elastic and magnetic energies when pushed from catheter sheath.
limitation: Benchtop demonstrations; in vivo performance and reliability of repeated assembly not shown.

object: polyurethane foam with catalytic CO2-releasing potassium salts
problem: How to make flammable polymers fire safe without conventional flame-retardant elements.
mechanism_or_method: Potassium formate or malate triggers polymer auto-pyrolysis rearrangement that releases CO2 before combustion to extinguish fire.
limitation: Small-scale flammability tests on polyurethane foam; effect on mechanical properties and aging not stated.

problem: Is there a unifying criterion that predicts the boiling crisis across surfaces, regimes and fluids?
mechanism_or_method: Percolation-based near-wall bubble interaction instability set by nucleation site density, bubble footprint radius and growth-time-frequency product.
limitation: Needs measurement of three boiling parameters; tested only on water and liquid nitrogen.
decision_relevance: Guides boiling surface design to maximize critical heat flux.

problem: How to build soft devices combining magnetic actuation, sensing and energy transfer without delamination or leakage.
mechanism_or_method: Coaxial printing of core-sheath fiber with magnetoactive and conductive phases into 2D/3D hybrid structures.
limitation: Lab demonstrators; biomedical use not validated in vivo and durability limited to demos.

object: spent lithium-ion cathode Al foil and active layer separation
problem: How to separate Al foil from cathode active material quickly without damaging the active material.
mechanism_or_method: Phytic acid forms an in situ passivating aluminum complex layer, enabling reaction-passivation driven separation.
limitation: Demonstrated on one cell chemistry at single-cell scale; economics and continuous processing not shown.

problem: How to achieve autonomous solar heating at low temperature and radiative cooling at high temperature in one textile.
mechanism_or_method: Fibers coated with thermochromic microcapsules in graphene and barium sulfate giving about 80% visible optical modulation.
limitation: Comfort gain limited to 8.5 C; wash durability and wear comfort are unreported.

problem: How to reprogram geometry and mechanical properties of 3D-printed polymers after printing.
mechanism_or_method: Photo-printable network with hindered urea bonds and hydroxyls enabling two independent exchange reactions for reshaping and property tuning.
limitation: Lab demonstrations; reprogramming conditions and long-term network stability are unreported.

object: naturalistic driving environment simulation for autonomous vehicle testing
problem: How can a simulator reproduce real-world driving statistics, including rare safety-critical events, with statistical realism?
mechanism_or_method: NeuralNDE deep learning of multi-agent interaction from trajectory data with a conflict critic model and safety mapping network.
limitation: Validated on urban driving trajectories only; rare long-tail event coverage depends on available data.
decision_relevance: Enables statistically realistic simulation for autonomous vehicle safety testing.

object: anion-pillared MOF sorbent for C2H2/C2H4 separation
problem: How to maximize trace C2H2 binding affinity and selectivity over C2H4 in a physisorbent.
mechanism_or_method: Programmed multi-site fluorine binding in anion-pillared MOF ZJU-300a, confirmed by gas-loaded structures and breakthrough tests.
limitation: Lab-scale synthesis and breakthrough tests only; scale-up and long-term stability not addressed in abstract.

problem: How to make amine-functionalized adsorbents efficient and cyclically stable for CO2 capture.
mechanism_or_method: Atom-level design placing each PEI molecule in MIL-101 cages coordinated to Cr sites, preventing carbamate dehydration.
limitation: Lab-scale cycling only; performance under humid flue gas and at scale not shown.

problem: How to 3D print dense piezoceramic elements with near-pristine properties for miniaturized cavitation transducers.
mechanism_or_method: Optimized piezoceramic printing and processing plus integrated printed packaging producing complex-geometry transducers with d33 of 583 pC/N.
limitation: Cavitation shown only in millimeter channels; in vivo intravascular delivery not demonstrated.
decision_relevance: Enables printed free-form piezoelectric transducers instead of machined flat elements.

problem: How to get high charge generation with low surface wear in solid-solid triboelectric interfaces.
mechanism_or_method: Use metallic glass as a triboelectric layer, whose low atomic density and lack of grain boundaries raise triboelectrification efficiency and wear resistance.
limitation: Lab devices; long-term durability and real-use conditions not reported in abstract.
decision_relevance: Suggests metallic glass as wear-resistant contact material for TENG design.

problem: How to make hydrogels whose thermal deformation and mechanics can be trained in either direction and do active work.
mechanism_or_method: Dual network of two thermoresponsive polymers whose volumetric response is enhanced or reduced by training above a threshold temperature.
limitation: Thermal training is slow and demonstrated only on small lab actuators.

object: hierarchical conductive MOF films for ammonia sensing
problem: How to speed up interfacial gas mass transfer on porous solid films despite the no-slip boundary condition.
mechanism_or_method: In-situ transformation of MOF films into hierarchical c-MOF films with hollow inner voids that raise gas permeability.
limitation: Sensor tested at room temperature in lab; selectivity and long-term drift not stated.

object: polynorbornene and polyimide dielectrics for capacitors
problem: How to find polymer dielectrics with both high energy density and high thermal stability at 85-200 C.
mechanism_or_method: AI-driven chemical structure generation and property prediction combined with polymer chemistry, followed by synthesis and capacitor testing.
limitation: Lab-scale films; manufacturability and long-term reliability at temperature need validation.

object: wrinkled MXene metamaterial coated LCE fiber actuators
problem: How to maximize light-to-heat conversion in densely stacked MXene for photo-driven actuators.
mechanism_or_method: Superlattice of alternating MXene and organic layers lowers refractive index; coated on LCE fibers via dip-coating for light actuation.
limitation: Lab demonstrations; durability over many cycles and in ambient light not detailed.

object: single-crystal high-entropy alloy surfaces for ORR electrocatalysis
problem: How to relate atomic-level surface structure of high-entropy alloys to oxygen reduction activity.
mechanism_or_method: Vacuum synthesis of epitaxial Pt/Cantor alloy layers on single-crystal Pt as a model platform with catalytic evaluation.
limitation: Model single-crystal surfaces may not represent practical nanoparticle catalysts.

problem: How to get fast autonomous self-healing and pressure sensing simultaneously in aquatic environments.
mechanism_or_method: Molecular engineering with hydrophobic C-F groups, hydrolytic boronate ester bonds and ions inspired by cephalopod suckers.
limitation: Demonstrated on small lab devices; long-term underwater durability not reported.

object: 316L stainless steel in powder-fusion additive manufacturing
problem: How can feedstock powder size control grain morphology and the columnar-to-equiaxed transition in metal AM.
mechanism_or_method: Powder-size driven melt pool engineering exploiting particle-size dependent powder-flow preheating and powder-bed thermophysical properties in DED and PBF.
limitation: Shown for 316L only; transfer to other alloys and machines unverified.
