decision_relevance: Choose powder size distribution to tune grain structure without added cost.

object: high-entropy alloy element selection via text mining
problem: How to select elements for new ultrahigh-entropy alloys using knowledge from scientific literature.
mechanism_or_method: Context similarity of chemical elements from text-mining models trained on 6.4 million abstracts, used to screen 2.6 million candidates.
limitation: Candidate alloys are not experimentally validated in the abstract.
decision_relevance: Prioritizes lightweight HEA compositions for experimental testing.

object: autonomous vehicle safety validation under rare events
problem: How to ensure deep-learning autonomous vehicle safety given rarity of safety-critical events in high-dimensional spaces.
mechanism_or_method: Perspective identifying three potential approaches to address the curse of rarity.
limitation: Perspective without new empirical validation.
decision_relevance: Guides choice of AV safety testing and training strategies.

object: cement carbonation CO2 uptake and radiative forcing
problem: How large is the true climate benefit of cement carbonation given slow uptake timing.
mechanism_or_method: Global carbonation modelling 1930-2015 combined with dynamic cumulative radiative forcing analysis and sensitivity to decarbonization strategies.
limitation: Relies on model assumptions about carbonation rates and uptake; no new measurements.
decision_relevance: Lowers credit assigned to carbonation in cement decarbonization planning.

problem: How to build ultrathin selective membranes combining precise molecular sieving and catalytic self-cleaning.
mechanism_or_method: Interfacial polymerization of porous organic cages into crosslinked polycage layers, impregnated with Pd nanoclusters.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; scalability and long-term fouling behavior not shown.

problem: How to raise the low fracture toughness of superhard high-entropy carbides.
mechanism_or_method: In-situ metastable tetragonal and monoclinic ZrO2 particles in (WTaNbZrTi)C matrix that toughen via transformation and crack shielding.
limitation: Toughness of 5.89 MPa m1/2 still modest; shown for one composition.
decision_relevance: Supports transformation toughening for ceramics in harsh mechanical service.

object: covalent adaptable network shape memory polymers for 4D printing
problem: How to get reconfigurable 4D printing with strong thermomechanical properties in CAN shape memory polymers.
mechanism_or_method: Mechanically robust CAN-SMP resin with high Tg and modulus, printed by DLP for multiple reconfigurations.
limitation: Lab demonstrations; reconfiguration fatigue limits and scale not detailed.

problem: How has climate change affected extreme power shortage events of wind-solar systems worldwide from 1980 to 2022.
mechanism_or_method: Hourly reanalysis climate data used to define and trend extreme shortage events and attribute them to compound wind and solar drought.
limitation: Uses reanalysis-derived simulated generation rather than measured grid outputs.
decision_relevance: Informs reliability planning and storage sizing for wind-solar systems.

problem: How to get high contraction ratio, force and dynamic response simultaneously in pneumatic artificial muscles.
mechanism_or_method: X-crossing mechanism directly converting linear actuator-axis motion, giving 92.9% contraction ratio and high specific power.
limitation: Bench characterization and demos only; fatigue life and control accuracy not detailed.
decision_relevance: Offers faster, stronger pneumatic actuator option for exoskeletons and jumping robots.

problem: How to embed shape actuation, sensing and locking in a robot body without bulky external equipment.
mechanism_or_method: Embedded morphing scheme with integrated actuation, sensing and locking, demonstrated in grippers, a quadruped and an amphibious robot.
limitation: Lab prototypes; robustness in uncontrolled environments not shown.

problem: How to combine strength, stiffness and toughness in hydrogels via high-precision structural design.
mechanism_or_method: Sequential self-assembly assisted salting out forming a crosslinked sheath and aligned nanofibril porous core.
limitation: Lab-scale specimens; durability in wet or loaded service environments not detailed.

problem: How to give wearable haptic feedback without bulky instruments and power modules.
mechanism_or_method: Triboelectric textile harvesting hand motion and driving gas breakdown discharge for localized electrical stimulation.
limitation: Prototype glove; stimulation comfort and reliability with many users not stated.

problem: How can a digital twin monitor and control a DC-DC converter and take over from a failed controller.
mechanism_or_method: Dynamic virtual replica tracking the physical converter, detecting controller failure and replacing it in real time.
limitation: Verified on a lab converter in four cases; industrial deployment untested.

object: surface charge density of triboelectric materials
problem: How to visualize and quantify surface charge on triboelectric materials in a standardized way.
mechanism_or_method: Kelvin probe surface potential with iterative regularization inversion, plus corona discharge charge tuning with a three-electrode design.
limitation: Demonstrated mainly on PTFE; generality to other materials unclear.

problem: How to achieve self-regulated continuous motion in soft robots using geometric topology.
mechanism_or_method: Knotted photo-responsive hydrogels where self-constraint prestress couples with photothermal strain and self-shadowing to drive rolling and spinning.
limitation: Small lab robots under controlled light; scalability and speed limited.

problem: How do dynamic curvature changes drive mechanotransduction and crypt morphogenesis in intestinal organoids.
mechanism_or_method: Photoinduced hydrogel cross-link exchange spatiotemporally alters curvature, revealing membrane tension, depolarization and delayed YAP localization.
limitation: In vitro organoid model; relevance to in vivo development not shown.

object: magnetic liquid metal miniature soft robot
problem: How to stably composite non-wettable Fe3O4 nanoparticles into gallium-indium liquid metal.
mechanism_or_method: Silver intermediate layer forms AgxIny intermetallics via reactive wetting, anchoring Fe3O4 for magnetic actuation.
limitation: Only ex vivo porcine stomach validation; in vivo safety unproven.

object: PBI proton exchange membranes for high-temperature fuel cells
problem: How to prevent membrane creep and phosphoric acid loss above 200 C in PBI fuel cell membranes.
mechanism_or_method: Gel-state PBI with double cross-linked 3D layered structure via polyphosphoric acid sol-gel process anchoring phosphoric acid.
limitation: Only 250-hour test at 220 C; stack-level durability unproven.

object: FDM printing of functional gradients with digital material filament
problem: How to create spatial gradients of properties using only a standard FDM printer and filaments.
mechanism_or_method: A 3D printed digital material filament of multiple base materials that blends homogeneously during extrusion to program properties.
limitation: Gradient resolution limited by extrusion blending; material pairs tested are limited.
decision_relevance: Allows low-cost functionally graded parts on commodity FDM printers.

object: triboelectric pressure sensor with water-containing elastomer
problem: How to combine high sensitivity with wide linear range in active pressure sensors.
mechanism_or_method: Water-containing triboelectric elastomer with gradient microchannels where water bridges modulate built-in field and ion-rich interface boosts sensitivity.
limitation: Liquid content stability over long use not stated in abstract.

object: eutectic high-entropy alloy under HPHT treatment
problem: How to overcome the strength-ductility trade-off in a strong but brittle eutectic high-entropy alloy.
mechanism_or_method: High-pressure high-temperature treatment forms hierarchical microstructure with coherent interfaces activating multiple deformation mechanisms.
limitation: HPHT processing limits specimen size and scalability.
decision_relevance: Suggests HPHT processing as a route to strong and ductile structural alloys.

problem: How to raise thermoelectric power conversion efficiency while suppressing brittle failure.
mechanism_or_method: Additively manufactured microlattices with cellular thermal impedance and ductile partially carbonized struts.
limitation: Efficiency described as potential; device-level durability and scale-up not shown.

object: lobed loops of liquid crystal elastomer fibers
problem: How to achieve autonomous untethered synchronized snap-through motion in soft robots.
mechanism_or_method: Curved LCE fibers buckle on a hot surface; geometrically constrained fibers in lobed loops synchronize at about 1.8 Hz.
limitation: Needs a hot surface; slow speed of about 2.4 mm/s.

problem: How to broaden reprogramming functions of mechanical metamaterials beyond mono-characteristic elements.
mechanism_or_method: Heterogeneous origami elements assembled into functional groups and rings that switch between positive and negative stiffness and Poisson's ratio.
limitation: Prototype-scale origami elements; actuation and cycling durability not addressed.

problem: How to make low-cost, drift-free, magnetically driven millirobots with high-throughput fabrication.
mechanism_or_method: Asymmetric light pattern distortion in laser-induced graphene conversion causes spontaneous twisting into helical scaffolds, nickel coated for magnetic drive.
limitation: Drug delivery shown only in simulated physiological environment, not in vivo.

problem: How to identify material type and softness with quantified modulus in one tactile sensor.
mechanism_or_method: Hemispherical triboelectric array inspired by insect campaniform sensilla producing unique output fingerprints per contacted material.
limitation: Tested on a limited set of materials in lab conditions.

problem: How to modulate ion migration in hydrogels to mimic synaptic learning and memory.
mechanism_or_method: Responsive supramolecular hybrid hydrogel where light releases mobile ions to tune conductivity, driving a robotic hand.
limitation: Proof of concept with a single device and simple optical stimuli.

problem: How can large robot swarms assemble complex shapes efficiently and adaptively.
mechanism_or_method: Mean-shift exploration where robots give up locations by moving toward the highest density of nearby unoccupied target locations.
limitation: Physical verification limited to 50 ground robots in a lab arena.

problem: How to build reconfigurable origami structures without facet deformation that depend heavily on material.
mechanism_or_method: Modular bistable rigid-origami units with elastic creases and switchable mountain-valley lines giving programmable multistable configurations.
limitation: Prototype units; actuation method for switching and load capacity not detailed.

problem: How to get an all-in-one artificial skin material with strong mechanics, self-healing, adhesion and sensing.
mechanism_or_method: Consolidated organic/metal bismuth ion architecture with hierarchical reversible noncovalent interactions.
limitation: Lab-scale sample; long-term stability and biocompatibility not detailed.

problem: How to make carbon aerogels that are both highly compressible and fatigue resistant.
mechanism_or_method: Synthesis assembling interconnected highly cross-linked carbon tubes giving near-zero Poisson's ratio and 99% recoverable strain.
limitation: Fatigue tested to 1000 cycles only; scale of production not addressed.

object: duplex stainless steel with non-metallic inclusions
problem: How to stop inclusion-induced corrosion failure in duplex stainless steels.
mechanism_or_method: Minor Nb addition forms inclusion@Z-phase core-shell structures that isolate inclusions from corrosive environments, selected by theoretical screening.
limitation: Long-term service corrosion performance in field conditions not reported.
decision_relevance: Adds Nb alloying to improve corrosion resistance of duplex steels in production.

object: China's coal chemical sector green hydrogen deployment
problem: What are the GHG mitigation potential and costs of onsite green H2 and O2 in China's coal chemical sector.
mechanism_or_method: Life-cycle assessment and techno-economic analysis of solar or wind electrolytic H2 and O2 replacing coal-based supply by province.
limitation: Projection to 2030 depends on assumed costs, technology and policy scenarios.
decision_relevance: Prioritizes provinces and power sources for green hydrogen pilot projects.

problem: How to give soft robots dynamic underwater adhesion and morphing capability.
mechanism_or_method: Resilin-like protein complexed with polyoxometalate switches between adhesive and stiff states with temperature; Fe3O4 adds photothermal and magnetic control.
limitation: Lab water tank demonstrations; protein production scale and durability not addressed.

problem: Which electronic structure features govern screw dislocation behavior and intrinsic ductility in bcc high-entropy alloys.
mechanism_or_method: First-principles calculations on nine compositions linking dislocation core, stacking fault and surface energies to bonding-state fraction and d-orbital bimodality.
limitation: Only nine compositions and ideal-supercell DFT models; no experimental validation in the abstract.
decision_relevance: Guides computational screening of ductile bcc HEA compositions.

object: zwitterionic fibrous membrane for solar desalination
problem: How to prevent salt accumulation in solar evaporators while also generating electricity.
mechanism_or_method: Aquaporin-inspired porous zwitterionic fibrous membrane with porphyrin conjugated microporous polymer photothermal layer coupled to a thermoelectric module.
limitation: Indoor simulated sunlight tests; outdoor long-term operation not shown.

problem: How to realize complete sense-decide-act loops within origami materials.
mechanism_or_method: Flexible bistable mechanisms combined with conductive thermal artificial muscles form multiplexed switches, logic gates and memory bits.
limitation: Thermal actuation is slow; demonstrations are small-scale prototypes.

object: helical fibrous muscle tubular soft actuators
problem: How to give tubular soft actuators many designable degrees of freedom and morphing modes.
mechanism_or_method: Programmable filament winding to build helical artificial fibrous muscle architectures with locally tunable orientation, giving 11 morphing modes.
limitation: Lab-scale photoresponsive demonstrations; force output and response speed not highlighted.

object: dielectric elastomer soft robots with chiral-lattice feet
problem: How to achieve dexterous locomotion with direction changes in small electrically driven soft robots.
mechanism_or_method: Dielectric elastomer artificial muscle with reconfigurable chiral-lattice foot enabling forward, backward and circular motion under a single voltage input.
limitation: Tethered high-voltage drive on flat lab surfaces.

object: end-linked star polymer elastomer with strain-induced crystallization
problem: How to raise strain-induced crystallinity and stretchability beyond limits set by trapped entanglements.
mechanism_or_method: End-linking and deswelling star polymers yields low-defect networks without trapped entanglements, reaching up to 50% crystallinity.
limitation: Lab synthesis of model networks; processability and cost at scale not addressed.

problem: How to make flexible, large-aperture, lead-free ultrasound probes cheaply for medical use.
mechanism_or_method: Transducer-on-foil technology from thermal embossing of a piezoelectric polymer, integrated in an endoscope probe and blood pressure sensor.
limitation: Imaging shown on tissue-mimicking phantom, not clinical patients.

problem: How to combine exceptional mechanical properties with dexterous actuation in artificial muscles.
mechanism_or_method: Phase-change polymer with ferromagnetic particles allowing stiffness switching and multimodal motion by laser heating and magnetic field.
limitation: Needs external laser and magnetic field; response speed and cycle life not stated.

problem: How to form percolated MOF pathways in mixed matrix membranes without losing mechanical properties.
mechanism_or_method: Demixing two immiscible polyimides so MOF particles partition into one domain, creating a percolated network at 19 wt% loading.
limitation: Pure-gas lab tests; mixed-gas, aging and scale-up behavior not reported.

problem: How can plant proteins be made to lubricate well and reduce astringent friction.
mechanism_or_method: Physically cross-linked plant protein microgels tested by biomimetic tongue-like tribology, AFM, rheology and numerical modelling.
limitation: Biomimetic surface tribology only; no sensory panel validation in the abstract.

problem: How to weld AA2024 without hot cracking while keeping high joint strength.
mechanism_or_method: Zr-core-Al-shell filler wire with laser beam oscillation to promote fine equiaxed grains during solidification.
limitation: Demonstrated on AA2024 lab welds; fatigue and corrosion of joints not reported.
decision_relevance: Use Zr-core filler wire to weld crack-prone 2000-series aluminium.

object: community V2X battery circular economy and lifecycle carbon
problem: How can battery lifecycle carbon intensity be quantified and driven to zero in electricity-driven communities.
mechanism_or_method: Lifecycle carbon quantification with V2X interaction, cascade utilization and circular economy scenarios across climate regions.
limitation: Scenario-based modelling of a community; results depend on assumed parameters.
decision_relevance: Informs battery reuse and V2X investment pathways for carbon-neutral communities.

object: pyrocarbon sorbent for gold recovery from e-waste leachate
problem: How to recover gold selectively and cheaply from e-waste leachate.
mechanism_or_method: Alginate-derived pyrocarbon whose aromatic structures donate electrons for stepwise reduction via gold-chlorine clusters.
limitation: Tested on CPU leachates at lab scale; industrial scale-up unproven.

object: ultra-thin multimodal dielectric elastomer soft robots
problem: How to build soft robots thin enough for narrow gaps that also move across solid, liquid and aerial domains.
mechanism_or_method: Dual-actuation sandwich structure with tunable Poisson's ratio tensioning mechanism driven by dielectric elastomers, giving linear and undulating gaits.
limitation: Slow speed and high-voltage tethered operation; field inspection not demonstrated.

object: Turing-structured COF membranes for organic solvent nanofiltration
problem: How to control stacking and sieving in covalent organic framework membranes.
mechanism_or_method: Tannic acid heterogeneous nucleation modifies reaction-diffusion assembly, forming labyrinthine Turing-patterned COF films with uniform pores.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; long-term stability and scale-up not shown.

object: dislocations in wire-laser DED 316L stainless steel
problem: How do dislocations evolve during rapid solidification and cooling in additive manufacturing.
mechanism_or_method: Operando synchrotron X-ray diffraction on wire-laser DED combined with multi-physics simulation, in-situ neutron diffraction and electron microscopy.
limitation: Semi-quantitative dislocation density; requires synchrotron access; one alloy and process.
decision_relevance: Informs process control and qualification of AM parts via dislocation evolution.

object: 3D transformable mechanical metamaterials with engineered zero modes
problem: How can zero modes be systematically engineered to give reversible transformation between solid-like and gas-like metamaterial states?
mechanism_or_method: 3D metamaterial design with engineered zero modes realizing seven extremal types, verified on 3D-printed TPU prototypes with tunable wave manipulation.
limitation: Only demonstrated on printed TPU prototypes; extension to other physical domains is speculative.
decision_relevance: Guides design of reconfigurable metamaterials with switchable stiffness and wave response.

problem: How can electroadhesives combine compliance, self-healing and strong adhesion for soft robot grippers?
mechanism_or_method: Dynamically crosslinked ionic organohydrogel electrodes with high-permittivity polyurethane dielectric, supramolecular bonding, additively manufactured into grippers.
limitation: Lab-scale grippers; durability and performance under varied environments not established.
decision_relevance: Informs material choice for low-voltage electroadhesive grippers.

problem: Which parameter controls fracture resistance in cubic-B1 refractory high-entropy carbides?
mechanism_or_method: Nanoindentation crack statistics combined with ab initio molecular dynamics under tension; VEC above about 9.4 activates transformation plasticity.
limitation: Limited to cubic-B1 carbide compositions; correlation validated on few compositions.
decision_relevance: Selects carbide compositions by VEC for toughness.

object: self-protecting soft fluidic robots with electrohydrodynamic pumps
problem: How can soft fluidic robots gain fast untethered actuation, self-healing and intelligent self-protection?
mechanism_or_method: Integrate soft electrohydrodynamic pumps, actuators, a healing electrofluid and multifunctional E-skins to trigger self-protection behaviors.
limitation: Lab prototypes; long-term healing cycles and operating voltage constraints not addressed.
decision_relevance: Informs integrated pump-actuator-skin design for damage-tolerant soft robots.

problem: How do multielement iron- and platinum-group HEA atomic layers perform for hydrogen evolution and oxidation?
mechanism_or_method: Synthesize ten quinary square-lattice HEA atomic layers; operando XAS, DFT and in situ electron microscopy reveal cocktail effect and phase transformations.
limitation: Catalyst stability tested only at lab scale; synthesis not shown scalable.

object: magnetic-driven folded diaphragm soft robot drivers
problem: How can a single-piece magnetic folded diaphragm give large bidirectional deformation under a low homogeneous field?
mechanism_or_method: One-piece-mold folded diaphragm with radial magnetization segments; applied to diaphragm pump, earthworm crawler and squid-like swimmer.
limitation: Needs external magnetic field generation; only laboratory-scale demonstrations.
decision_relevance: Offers magnetic diaphragm drivers for untethered soft robots and pumps.

object: Chlorella pyrenoidosa microalgae coated with metal-organic frameworks
problem: Can MOF assembly on microalgae surfaces raise photosynthetic CO2 fixation efficiency without genetic modification?
mechanism_or_method: Self-assemble MOFs on algae to concentrate CO2 and convert it to transportable HCO3- at the bio-organic interface.
limitation: Lab culture only; long-term algal viability and scale-up unaddressed.

object: soft self-contained grippers for UAV manipulation
problem: How can a lightweight self-adaptive voltage-driven soft gripper enable powerful UAV manipulation?
mechanism_or_method: U-shaped soft eccentric circular tube actuators driven by liquid-gas phase transition, cross-arranged into tendril- and hook-inspired grippers.
limitation: Phase-transition actuation likely slow and energy hungry; outdoor flight performance unclear.
decision_relevance: Guides gripper choice for aerial manipulation without precise positioning.

object: transparent glass surface integrating triboelectric nanogenerator and radiative cooler
problem: Can one glass surface harvest raindrop energy and radiatively cool in sunny weather?
mechanism_or_method: Transparent triboelectric layers doubling as thermal emitters, radiative cooling structure optimized with an evolutionary algorithm.
limitation: Small-scale device; outdoor durability and large-area manufacturing not demonstrated.
decision_relevance: Informs multifunctional window coatings for energy harvesting and cooling.

object: liquid-infused Cu nanowire array thermal interface material
problem: How can interface thermal resistance be pushed below 1 mm2 K/W while keeping reliability?
mechanism_or_method: Soft double-sided Cu nanowire scaffold infused with thermal-bridge liquid metal that suppresses contact resistance.
limitation: Tested on chip-cooling and thermal cycling benches, not long-term in deployed systems.
decision_relevance: Selects thermal interface materials for high-power chip cooling.

problem: How can multiple microjoints be integrated at micrometer scale for many deformation modalities?
mechanism_or_method: Two-in-one femtosecond laser writing of hydrogel and metal nanoparticle microjoints with independent and linked joint control.
limitation: Microscale proof of concept requiring femtosecond laser fabrication; payload and throughput small.

object: continuous fiber reinforced liquid crystal elastomer composites
problem: Can 4D printing of LCE with continuous fibers give aligned actuation, high force and energy absorption?
mechanism_or_method: Fiber-resin relative motion during printing creates shear that aligns mesogens; printing path programs folding and electrically driven morphing.
limitation: Thermal actuation needs elevated temperature; fatigue life not reported in abstract.
decision_relevance: Selects printing parameters for programmable actuating composite structures.

problem: How can wearable haptics stay accurate and comfortable despite sweat and moisture accumulation?
mechanism_or_method: Fully integrated stretchable breathable bioadhesive textile with 128 actuation pixels across the palm.
limitation: Small-scale user validation; long-term wear durability not established.

problem: How can hydrogels reach tendon-surpassing strength and toughness with swelling resistance?
mechanism_or_method: Carbon dots act as nanofillers and nucleating agents inducing crystalline domains and oriented dense networks via pinning effect.
limitation: Underwater long-term mechanical stability and fatigue not shown; mechanism inferred indirectly.

object: freestanding 4D printed continuous fiber LCE composites
problem: How can freestanding 3D deformable load-bearing LCE structures be printed rather than planar ones?
mechanism_or_method: Direct ink writing with continuous fibers supporting freestanding structure; off-center fiber distribution programs bending deformation.
limitation: Actuation requires heating to about 150 C; cyclic durability unreported.
decision_relevance: Guides fiber placement to program spatial deformation and load capacity.

problem: How can light-driven microrobots self-assemble reversibly and degrade pesticide pollutants?
mechanism_or_method: Hydrothermal hematite microparticles coated by ALD TiO2; phoretic attraction under light and H2O2, magnetic dipole chaining in dark.
limitation: Requires H2O2 fuel and lab conditions; real water matrices untested.

problem: How can erythritol supercooling be stabilized for long-term seasonal solar thermal storage?
mechanism_or_method: Add carrageenan to raise solid-liquid interfacial energy, locking latent heat below -30 C; ultrasonication releases it.
limitation: Small-sample lab tests; storage durations and cycling over seasons not demonstrated.
decision_relevance: Selects stabilized PCM formulations for seasonal heat storage in cold regions.

problem: Can contact electrification drive CO2 reduction to CO from ambient air at high efficiency?
mechanism_or_method: TENG of electrospun PVDF with Cu single-atom carbon nitride and quaternized cellulose nanofibers capturing CO2 for electron transfer.
limitation: Low absolute yield and lab-scale conditions; practical air-flow operation untested.

object: atomically thin high-entropy oxide anode catalysts for PEM electrolysis
problem: Can naked metal ion self-assembly yield stable Ru-based high-entropy oxide anodes for acidic water electrolysis?
mechanism_or_method: Air-molten salt interface assembly and oxidation of 1 nm RuIrFeCoCrO2; Cr weakens Ru-O covalency improving stability.
limitation: Stability shown for hundreds of hours only, below commercial lifetimes; scale-up unaddressed.

problem: How can adhesives adapt to surfaces and switch attachment/detachment at millisecond speed?
mechanism_or_method: Contact-state sensing triggers magnetorheological stiffness tuning for conformal contact, shape locking and active release.
limitation: Needs magnetic field and sensing hardware; performance on rough or wet surfaces unclear.
decision_relevance: Informs switchable adhesive design for high-speed robotic gripping.

problem: How can recrystallized Mo achieve room-temperature superplasticity despite grain boundary brittleness?
mechanism_or_method: Ultralow grain boundary oxygen, soft texture and low angle boundaries via powder metallurgy, Y-type hot rolling and annealing, enabling dislocation transmission.
limitation: Single processing route and material; transfer to other refractory metals only proposed.
decision_relevance: Guides processing of ductile refractory metals by controlling grain boundary oxygen.

problem: Can degraded NCM and LMO cathodes be upcycled to low-cobalt 5 V cathodes without extra precursors?
mechanism_or_method: Subtractively extract equal Co and Ni, convert remaining metals to carbonate precursor for LiNi0.5Mn1.5O4-like spinel with in-situ Co doping.
limitation: Lab-scale recycling of model materials; real black mass heterogeneity only briefly addressed.

object: transition metal sulfide sorbents for elemental mercury
problem: How can the mercury accommodation capacity of non-CuS transition metal sulfides be raised?
mechanism_or_method: In situ acid etching creates defective surfaces and pore structure promoting Hg0 adsorption and diffusion, giving over 100-fold enhancement.
limitation: Lab sorbent tests; performance in real flue gas conditions not shown.

object: soft robotic shape display with electrohydraulic cells
problem: How can a shape display combine high-speed actuation, embedded sensing and control at scale?
mechanism_or_method: 10x10 array of cells integrating electrohydraulic soft actuators, magnetic sensing and control circuitry reaching 50 Hz morphing.
limitation: Requires high-voltage drive and complex fabrication; resolution limited to 10x10 cells.
decision_relevance: Informs integration of actuators and sensors in soft shape-morphing arrays.

problem: How can self-healing ion-based skins achieve very high fracture strength and toughness?
mechanism_or_method: Orthogonal dynamic crosslinks, aromatic disulfide and UPy moieties, in polymer and ionic conductor giving 34 MPa strength and autonomous healing.
limitation: Long-term healing cycles and environmental stability of ionic liquid not reported in abstract.

problem: How do support acidity and topology govern Cu redox and transfer in low-temperature NH3-SCR?
mechanism_or_method: Operando EPR, kinetic measurements and DFT show weaker Bronsted acidity hinders Cu(NH3)4 hydrolysis and Cu migration between cages.
limitation: Limited to a few zeolite topologies and lab conditions.

problem: How can an adhesive build strong underwater adhesion spontaneously without external pressing?
mechanism_or_method: Amphiphilic copolymer swollen with hydrophobic ionic liquid; water-induced functional group rearrangement raises adhesion energy to 458 J/m2.
limitation: Tested on PET substrate; 24 h build-up time and other substrates unclear.
decision_relevance: Informs adhesive selection for underwater bonding without clamping.

object: perfluorinated covalent triazine framework proton conductors
problem: Can low-temperature synthesis give CTFs with high proton conductivity?
mechanism_or_method: Direct cyclotrimerization of aromatic aldehyde with ammonium iodide; fluorine hydrogen-bonding with H3PO4 gives 0.182 S/cm at 150 C.
limitation: Relies on H3PO4 loading; durability in operating fuel cells not shown.

object: modular uniformly thick origami-inspired deployable structures
problem: How can metre-scale deployable origami structures be made adaptable and capable of carrying large loads?
mechanism_or_method: Derive conditions for flat-foldable, developable, uniformly thick degree-N vertices; build modular structures with multi-path folding.
limitation: Prototype demonstrations; long-term civil deployment, joints durability and cost not established.
decision_relevance: Enables adaptable load-carrying deployable structures in civil design.

object: ultramicroporous 3D covalent organic frameworks for ethylene purification
problem: Can tuning pore environment improve C2H6/C2H4 separation in 3D COFs?
mechanism_or_method: Isostructural pyridine-containing 3D-TPP-COF adds C-H...N interactions with ethane, giving 110.4 cm3/g uptake and selectivity 1.8.
limitation: Selectivity is modest at 1.8; cycling and humid stability not discussed.

problem: How can metamaterial cells be designed to program crack paths and toughen like natural materials?
mechanism_or_method: Machine-learning design engine generates cells with microfibers producing crack bowing, deflection, shielding and bridging, raising fracture energy up to 1235%.
limitation: Abstract does not state experimental validation; training data generated by simulation.
decision_relevance: Guides cell design for damage-tolerant lightweight lattice structures.

object: Drosophila wing imaginal disc and its extracellular matrix
problem: How does differential growth anisotropy between epithelium and ECM shape a developing organ?
mechanism_or_method: Mechanical bilayer model capturing elasticity and ECM growth anisotropy; MMP2 expression controls ECM growth anisotropy.
limitation: Specific to Drosophila wing disc; generality to other organs not shown.

object: liquid crystal elastomer vitrimers with tunable actuation temperature
problem: How can the actuation temperature of a fully crosslinked LCE be tuned after synthesis?
mechanism_or_method: Dynamic covalent bond exchange in covalently adaptable LC networks preserves annealing-set isotropization temperatures reversibly.
limitation: Demonstrated on specific LC vitrimer chemistry; actuator cycling stability not described.

problem: How does inorganic surface chemistry change epoxy structure and fracture behavior near adhesive interfaces?
mechanism_or_method: Sub-nm smooth Si surfaces with OH or H terminations; probe amine-to-epoxy ratio, crosslinking and adhesion energy at the interface.
limitation: Model smooth silicon substrates; real rough or metal adherends may differ.
decision_relevance: Guides surface treatment choice to control adhesive failure mode.

problem: Can ML using fuel, ignition and observed fire data predict actual fire activity better than fire-weather danger indices?
mechanism_or_method: Data-driven models trained on global fuel evolution and fire detection datasets reduce false alarms of high-danger forecasts.
limitation: Skill depends on quality of input fuel and fire-detection data.

problem: How can text-derived processing descriptions plus alloy descriptors improve deep-learning prediction of pitting potential?
mechanism_or_method: Automated NLP converts textual experimental descriptions into network inputs; physics-based elemental descriptors replace compositions to identify key features.
limitation: Accuracy limited by literature-derived, heterogeneous data; no new alloys tested in abstract.
decision_relevance: Prioritizes alloy descriptors for corrosion-resistant composition screening.

problem: How can mechanical computing avoid inefficient memory access and signal propagation limits?
mechanism_or_method: Computing within an interaction network of mechanical memory units; 3D printed binary neural network, self-learning perceptron and all 16 two-input logic gates.
limitation: Small-scale printed demonstrators; speed and scalability of mechanical computation unaddressed.

object: magnetic Janus origami robot for droplets
problem: How can one robot manipulate droplets across nanoliter to microliter scales?
mechanism_or_method: Magnetically actuated Janus origami robot with photothermal property for transport, splitting, dispensing, stirring, heating and PCR nucleic acid extraction.
limitation: Requires external magnetic actuation setup; throughput and robustness for real samples unclear.

problem: Can an azole bearing seven nitro groups be synthesized with high density and positive oxygen balance?
mechanism_or_method: Stepwise nitration of 3,5-dimethylpyrazole yields 4-nitro-3,5-bis(trinitromethyl)-1H-pyrazole with density 2.04 g/cm3.
limitation: Thermal stability is a known concern; performance values partly calculated.

problem: Can electrohydraulic artificial muscles reach mammalian-muscle performance at much lower driving voltage?
mechanism_or_method: Hydraulically amplified low-voltage electrostatic (HALVE) actuators reach 50.5 W/kg and 971 %/s at 1100 V, waterproof and self-clearing.
limitation: Still needs about 1100 V; lifetime and integrated untethered power not fully shown.
decision_relevance: Informs actuator choice and driver electronics for untethered soft robots.

object: polymer robotic fiber for minimally invasive surgery
problem: Can a thin scalable fiber robot give precise flexible-tool steering for endoscopic surgery?
mechanism_or_method: Thermally actuated fiber by local side heating, made by fiber drawing; control algorithms with endoscopic instruments tested in porcine laparoscopy.
limitation: Single porcine in vivo demonstration; thermal safety margins and human translation remain open.

problem: What physically drives solvent flow through OSN membranes: diffusion or pressure-driven flow?
mechanism_or_method: Extended Flory-Rehner theory, nonequilibrium molecular dynamics and solvent transport experiments show pressure-driven cluster migration through pores.
limitation: Validated for limited membranes and solvents; generality across polymers uncertain.
decision_relevance: Shifts OSN membrane design from diffusion models to solvent affinity and pore structure.

object: graphite nanosheets at cryogenic temperature friction interfaces
problem: Can molecular rolling lubrication be realized through self-curling of graphite nanosheet edges?
mechanism_or_method: Cryogenic edge self-curling from uneven atomic shrinkage stress forms nanorollers under shear, observed experimentally and explained by simulations.
limitation: Requires cryogenic temperature and vacuum; relevance to ambient engineering contacts unclear.
decision_relevance: Suggests graphite lubrication strategy for cryogenic vacuum tribological components.

object: laser powder bed fusion NiTi shape memory alloys
problem: How can additively manufactured NiTi gain simultaneous strength, ductility and stable superelasticity?
mechanism_or_method: Tailored heat treatment creates high-density Ni-rich local chemical inhomogeneity entities in B2 matrix that resist slip and relieve stress at pores.
limitation: Specific alloy and process window; fatigue life and geometry dependence not detailed.
decision_relevance: Guides heat treatment for printed superelastic NiTi components.

object: soft robotic hand with tactile palm
problem: How can high-density palm tactile sensing coordinate with soft fingers to improve grasping and perception?
mechanism_or_method: Compact visual-tactile palm with fiber-reinforced two-segment pneumatic fingers and palm-finger feedback strategies, augmented by AI.
limitation: Laboratory tasks only; robustness in unstructured environments not shown.
decision_relevance: Guides sensor placement and palm-finger coordination in soft hand design.

problem: What determines columnar-to-equiaxed grain transition on solute addition in AM titanium alloys?
mechanism_or_method: Computational scheme comparing growth restriction factor with freezing range under rapid cooling; the freezing range mechanism predicts morphology more reliably.
limitation: Tested on limited Ti alloy systems and two AM approaches.
decision_relevance: Selects solute additions to obtain equiaxed grains in printed Ti alloys.

problem: Can homogeneous hydrogels self-reverse deformation under constant light illumination?
mechanism_or_method: Two coexisting spiropyrans with sequential descending-ascending charge variation drive macroscopic contraction then expansion, enabling self-regulated rolling.
limitation: Transient reversal in small films; slow hydrogel response and reproducibility over cycles unclear.

object: Sn-Ag-Cu solder joints in BGA packages
problem: How does solder microstructure control thermal fatigue damage in electronic joints?
mechanism_or_method: EBSD mapping of thermally cycled joints interpreted with multi-scale modelling linking package-scale continuum to crystal plasticity finite element models.
limitation: Accelerated thermal cycling on specific alloy and package geometry; field service lives not compared.
decision_relevance: Guides solder joint microstructure design for thermal fatigue resistance.

problem: Can COF membranes with solvent-responsive flexibility give precise molecular sieving in organic solvents?
mechanism_or_method: Interlayer shifting in polar organic solvents creates selective sub-nanopores, giving over 99% rejection and permeance above 15 kg/m2/h/bar.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; long-term fouling and scale-up not addressed.

problem: How can strength and uniform ductility both be doubled in a maraging alloy?
mechanism_or_method: Deformable semi-coherent matrix precipitates plus grain-boundary precipitates dynamically transforming into matrix-type precipitates for work hardening.
limitation: Demonstrated on one model alloy; scalability and fatigue or fracture toughness not discussed.
decision_relevance: Guides alloy design for ultrahigh strength with retained ductility.

problem: How can vibrational imaging sensitivity be pushed beyond the millimolar shot-noise limit of SRS?
mechanism_or_method: Probe refractive index change from vibrational relaxation heating with a laser beam, giving over 500-fold modulation depth boost.
limitation: Requires custom optical setup; quantitative sensitivity limits across samples not specified.

object: global steel and cement supply under carbon budgets
problem: Can steel and cement supply within Paris-compliant carbon budgets meet expected 2050 demand given infrastructure deployment uncertainty?
mechanism_or_method: Scenario analysis of feasible supply with uncertain deployment of CCS, renewable electricity and green hydrogen infrastructure.
limitation: Results depend on scenario assumptions about infrastructure deployment and baseline demand.

object: waffle-shaped solar evaporator for seawater desalination
problem: How can interfacial solar evaporators avoid salt crystallization fouling during long-term operation?
mechanism_or_method: Waffle sidewalls trigger convection via solute and thermal Marangoni effects for spontaneous salt rejection; zinc-assisted pyrolysis of biomass carbon.
limitation: Tested in lab brine for 60 days; outdoor variable sunlight and scale-up untested.
decision_relevance: Informs evaporator geometry for salt-rejecting solar desalination.

problem: Can template-free synthesis give 2D single-crystal mesoporous HEOs for efficient HMF electrooxidation?
mechanism_or_method: Template-free synthesis of SC-MHEO nanoplates giving 99.3% HMF conversion and 97.7% FDCA selectivity, coupled with nitrate reduction.
limitation: Lab-scale electrolysis; long-term stability and cost not addressed in abstract.

object: hydrogel-based flexible sensors with lipid bilayer coating
problem: How can hydrogel sensors retain water under dynamic deformation without losing conductivity and flexibility?
mechanism_or_method: Adaptive lipid-integrated bilayer coating anchored with amphiphilic molecules; spare lipids migrate to the surface during deformation.
limitation: Long-term dynamic sensing durability beyond lab tests not detailed.

problem: Can entropy engineering create unsaturated metal sites in UiO-66 to boost catalytic transfer hydrogenation?
mechanism_or_method: Synthesize ZrHfCeSnTi HE-UiO-66 with lattice distortion and 322.4 umol/g coordination unsaturated sites, lowering hydrogen transfer barrier.
limitation: Single reaction class tested; catalyst recyclability and scalability not addressed in abstract.

object: laser powder bed fusion melting regimes
problem: Can acoustic emission signatures detect conduction-keyhole regime transitions during laser melting?
mechanism_or_method: Operando synchrotron X-ray imaging synchronized with acoustic recording; a simple filtering algorithm predicts regimes at 100 microsecond resolution.
limitation: Thin-wall remelting at synchrotron; transfer to full builds and industrial machines unverified.
decision_relevance: Enables acoustic in-process monitoring to detect keyhole instability in LPBF.

problem: How can structural foams reach ultrahigh specific strength while remaining recyclable?
mechanism_or_method: Core-shell nanostructured liquid metals linked by metal-ligand coordination and hydrogen bonds, foamed at subzero temperatures, reprocessed with water.
limitation: Lab-scale foam samples; creep, fatigue and scale-up not reported in abstract.
decision_relevance: Offers recyclable lightweight foam option for structural applications.

object: orthogonally light- and magnetic-responsive photonic gels
problem: How can gels respond independently to light and magnetic fields without mutual interference?
mechanism_or_method: Semi-interpenetrating network of photoswitchable azobenzene organogelator and Fe3O4@SiO2 nanoparticles forming magnetically controlled photonic chains.
limitation: Lab demonstrations of smart windows and labels; durability and response speed not quantified.

object: freestanding quasi-BCC gold and copper nanolattices
problem: Can nanolattices achieve strength above bulk with ultrahigh energy absorption at scalable production?
mechanism_or_method: Quasi-BCC nanolattices with 34 nm beams; finite element simulation shows nanobeam bending dominance, giving about 100 MJ/m3 absorption.
limitation: Nanoscale samples; macroscale scalability claimed but mechanical behavior at scale not shown.
decision_relevance: Informs lattice architecture choice for high energy absorption materials.

object: soft self-sensing tensile valve for soft robots
problem: Can sensing and control valve functions be integrated in one fully soft, electronics-free element converting tensile strain to pressure states?
mechanism_or_method: Helical pinching mechanism shares sensing and valve structure, mapping applied strain to steady-state output pressure from a single constant source.
limitation: Demonstrated only at bench-scale prototypes; durability and scaling to complex robots not established.
decision_relevance: Enables electronics-free pneumatic perception in soft robot design.

problem: How can fatigue crack initiation and propagation both be suppressed in a metallic structure?
mechanism_or_method: Gradient structure with nacre-like surface nanolaminates over twinned layer; boundary decohesion causes frequent crack deflection and delays surface roughening.
limitation: Demonstrated on pure titanium lab samples; scalability and other alloys not verified.
decision_relevance: Surface structuring route for fatigue-resistant alloy components.

problem: Can a metallic scaffold be both very soft and strong to induce higher tissue strain and better bone regeneration?
mechanism_or_method: Two-stage deformation metamaterial decouples modulus and strength, giving 13 MPa effective modulus then a stiff stage for load bearing.
limitation: Animal ulnar defect model at 4 weeks; human translation and long-term outcomes unproven.
decision_relevance: Favors strain-driven rather than modulus-matched scaffold design.

object: high-entropy alloy nanopatterns on DNA origami
problem: How can multimetallic nanopatterns with controlled morphology and composition be patterned in a general way?
mechanism_or_method: Protruding clustered DNA on origami concentrates metal ions as nucleation sites for metal plating of up to five elements.
limitation: Elemental uniformity at nanoscale remains hard to control; only demonstrated for selected metals.

object: radial bimetallic structures by wire arc additive manufacturing
problem: Can a radial bimetallic interface be built by wire arc AM to improve compressive response over monolithic parts?
mechanism_or_method: Stainless core within mild steel casing deposited incrementally; thermal expansion mismatch creates interlocking and prestressed compressive effect.
limitation: Only one steel pair and compressive loading characterized; residual stress not fully quantified.
decision_relevance: Supports radial bimetallic design in arc-based metal AM parts.

problem: Can HOFs be processed in solution to yield continuous, highly crystalline membranes for propylene/propane separation?
mechanism_or_method: HOF fragments into colloidal particles retaining assemblies in solvent, enabling solution-casting onto substrates such as AAO.
limitation: Selectivity of 14 modest; long-term stability and scale-up untested.

problem: How does irregularity of architected materials relate to stress modulation, and can it be designed to target stress fields?
mechanism_or_method: Generative computational framework optimizes spatial distribution of few building blocks into disordered microstructures that match target stress distributions.
limitation: Validated on 3D printed samples and a femur case only; fatigue and in vivo behavior untested.
decision_relevance: Allows stress-programmed lattice implants instead of uniform periodic supports.

problem: Can a high-strength, deformable aluminum alloy be made printable without solidification cracking?
mechanism_or_method: Custom Al92Ti2Fe2Co2Ni2 selective laser melting forms heterogeneous nanoscale medium-entropy intermetallic lamellae giving back stress strengthening.
limitation: Compression-only macroscale tests; tensile, fatigue and build scalability not reported.
decision_relevance: Suggests printable alloy chemistry for lightweight high-strength parts.

object: amino acid salt CO2 capture and conversion system
problem: Can integrated capture and electroconversion of dilute CO2 to CO reach higher energy efficiency?
mechanism_or_method: Amino acid salt capture solution with single-atom catalyst operated at elevated temperature and pressure for CO production.
limitation: Lab electrolyzer scale; abstract gives little stability or scale-up evidence.

problem: Can an expected-versus-actual perception loop let a soft robot sense shape and contact simultaneously?
mechanism_or_method: Compare expected shape from actuation with sensed actual shape to detect contact, direction and distinguish internal versus external deformation.
limitation: Tested on one robot in lab; unstructured environments and long-term drift not examined.
decision_relevance: Informs sensor-based contact detection design for soft manipulators.

problem: How can C3F6 be selectively separated from C3F8 despite similar physicochemical properties?
mechanism_or_method: Thermoregulatory gate opening of flexible-robust MOF gives temperature-dependent molecular sieving, verified by breakthrough tests and crystal structures.
limitation: Lab-scale breakthrough tests; cost and cycling stability in industrial streams unclear.

problem: How to detect infinitesimal strains where conventional crack sensors lose sensitivity?
mechanism_or_method: Cracks on negative Poisson's ratio substrate show orientation-independent gap widening; parallel mechanical circuits trade off resolution and range.
limitation: In vivo demonstration limited to cerebrovascular monitoring in animal; long-term reliability not shown.
decision_relevance: Guides sensor architecture choice for micro-strain biomechanical monitoring.

problem: How can moisture-based power generation sustain continuous current output for long durations?
mechanism_or_method: Photocatalytic hydrogen evolution layer consumes accumulated ions, restoring ion concentration gradient in the hydrovoltaic device.
limitation: Lab-scale device; power level small and requires light and humidity control.

object: liquid crystal elastomer self-rolling soft robot
problem: Can a soft robot escape complex mazes without onboard brain by exploiting geometry and material intelligence?
mechanism_or_method: Asymmetric twisted-helical LCE body gives sustained self-turning; self-snapping reflects motion, producing curved zigzag paths powered by ambient heat.
limitation: Tested in lab mazes with controlled thermal environment; speed and payload limited.

problem: Can one continuum model describe boiling from stochastic nucleation to macroscopic bubbles and explain low onset temperatures?
mechanism_or_method: Fluctuating hydrodynamics with diffuse interface model; nanometric hydrophobic spots on heterogeneous wall trigger nucleation at low superheat.
limitation: Comparison with experiments is qualitative; idealized surfaces and fluid model.
decision_relevance: Guides surface wettability design to control boiling onset temperature.

problem: Can a single material integrate rewritable 2D fluorescent and 3D shape encoding for secure information carriers?
mechanism_or_method: Anthracene reversible photo-crosslinking gives fluorescence shifting; thermadapt EVA network gives reconfigurable shape memory.
limitation: Lab demonstration; fatigue over many rewrite cycles and decoding robustness not detailed.

object: active ice for methane hydrate formation
problem: How can slow, heat-generating gas hydrate formation be accelerated for gas storage?
mechanism_or_method: Porous ice with unfrozen surfactant solution layer enables rapid hydrate formation, cycling ice-hydrate-ice with high uptake.
limitation: Lab-scale reactor; industrial scale-up and cycling durability not demonstrated.

object: electrochemical leaching of lithium from spodumene
problem: Can lithium be directly leached from hard-rock ores electrochemically with lower energy and environmental footprint?
mechanism_or_method: H2O2 promoter lowers leaching potential; catalyst-modified high-throughput current collector holds suspended spodumene achieving 92.2% efficiency.
limitation: Small leaching current of 18 mA; scale-up economics unproven.

object: covalent organic framework membranes with aligned nanorods
problem: How can COF membranes separate rare metal ions both fast and selectively?
mechanism_or_method: Interfacial synthesis of asymmetric COF layer: vertically aligned nanorods on ultrathin dense layer, using quaternary ammonium monomer.
limitation: Lab single and binary salt systems only; real mixed waste streams untested.

problem: Can machine learning plus simulation guide design of refractory alloys combining high strength and ductility?
mechanism_or_method: High-throughput ML with Monte Carlo and ab initio calculations select single-phase B2 compositions; valence electron count maps ductility.
limitation: Tensile ductility only 9% for B2 ordering; room-temperature focus with limited high-temperature data.
decision_relevance: Guides composition screening for high-temperature structural alloys.

problem: Can one robotic skin switch adhesion from minimal to ultrastrong for both delicate and heavy handling?
mechanism_or_method: Shape memory polymer with tunable rubber-to-glass transition changes adhesion from about 1 kPa to over 1 MPa.
limitation: Thermal switching speed and durability over repeated cycles on varied surfaces unclear.
decision_relevance: Supports switchable-adhesion end effectors for grasping varied payloads.

problem: How to get ultrahigh strength and ductility together in coherent precipitation-hardened alloys?
mechanism_or_method: Multicomponent L12 precipitates with high antiphase boundary energy switch deformation from dislocation shearing to stacking fault shearing.
limitation: Uniform elongation about 10%; high-temperature, fatigue and processing scale-up not covered.
decision_relevance: Guides precipitate chemistry choice for ultrastrong ductile alloys.

problem: What governs the conformability of flat flexible sheets on spheres, and how do slits improve it?
mechanism_or_method: Thin film buckling analysis yields scaling law; experiments, analytics and numerics quantify radial slit effects.
limitation: Idealized circular sheets and spheres; real electronics layers and friction effects not covered.
decision_relevance: Gives slit design guideline to raise sheet conformability from 40% to over 90%.

problem: How to obtain multifunctional ultrasoft, stretchable, self-healing cryogels despite uncontrolled freezing?
mechanism_or_method: Antifreezing salt lowers freezing point, suppressing ice growth and giving amorphous polymer chains with tunable hydrogen bonding.
limitation: Lab characterization only; long-term stability and device integration not detailed.

problem: Which geometric strategies produce strong and tough interfaces between soft and hard materials?
mechanism_or_method: Interface designs from triply periodic minimal surfaces, triple helices and particles evaluated by simulation and tensile and quad-lap shear tests.
limitation: Specific polymer pair printed; fatigue and other loading modes not examined.
decision_relevance: Informs interface geometry choice for multimaterial 3D printed parts.

problem: Do new polar lamellar liquid states exist beyond ferroelectric nematic phases?
mechanism_or_method: Synthesis of novel molecules showing helical polar tilted SmC_P^H and antiferroelectric SmA phases, plus room-temperature mixtures.
limitation: Phase characterization of new compounds only; device or application relevance not shown.

problem: Can waste cathodes be restored without destroying their morphology using a solvent-free fast process?
mechanism_or_method: Flash Joule heating with magnetic separation recovers about 98% metals, followed by solid-state relithiation.
limitation: Lab-scale batches; life-cycle analysis rests on assumptions about scaled process.

problem: Can grain boundary segregation and solute nano-clustering together give near-theoretical strength with deformability?
mechanism_or_method: Ni solutes with large negative mixing enthalpy create local chemical inhomogeneity and segregate to boundaries, impeding dislocations and enhancing cohesion.
limitation: Compression tests of a model small-scale alloy; tensile ductility and scale-up unaddressed.
decision_relevance: Guides solute design to strengthen nanostructured alloys.

problem: What are the actual active sites and mechanisms for hydrogen evolution on high-entropy metallenes across pH?
mechanism_or_method: One-pot wet-chemical synthesis of PdRhMoFeMn metallenes, with operando X-ray absorption spectroscopy and theory identifying multi-site mechanisms.
limitation: Precious-metal catalyst tested in lab cells; scale and cost not addressed.

problem: How to overcome the stiffness-toughness trade-off in polymer gels without special structural design?
mechanism_or_method: Synergy of crystal-domain crosslinking and metal-ion chelation crosslinking raises modulus 366-fold and toughness 104-fold.
limitation: Quasi-static lab mechanical tests; fatigue and environmental stability not detailed.

problem: Can fiber-reinforced thermoset composites be printed tool-free with instantaneous in-situ curing?
mechanism_or_method: Thermoresponsive resin cured by photothermal heating of carbon fibers right after robotic deposition, avoiding support materials.
limitation: Lab robotic platform; mechanical performance relative to autoclave composites and void content unclear.
decision_relevance: Enables mold-free composite manufacturing and on-demand structural repair.

problem: How to raise mid-infrared photothermal imaging speed to video rate for living systems?
mechanism_or_method: Lock-in free single-pulse photothermal detection with high-speed digitization and synchronized galvo scanning of IR and probe beams.
limitation: Bespoke optical setup; sensitivity and generality across samples not detailed.

problem: Can a green, stable, heavy-metal-free primary explosive with strong ignition performance be made?
mechanism_or_method: Aqueous room-temperature one-pot synthesis of double perovskite framework with periodate, giving ignition on par with leading primary explosives.
limitation: Small-scale synthesis and sensitivity testing; application-scale handling not shown.

problem: What descriptor better correlates polyamide network crosslinking with desalination performance?
mechanism_or_method: Harmonic amide bond density computed from XPS data using comprehensive segmentation of polyamide structure.
limitation: Correlation validated on lab-made membranes; causal link to performance not established.

problem: Can matrix imaging be extended to 2D transducer arrays to correct aberration and multiple scattering in 3D?
mechanism_or_method: Response matrix recorded by 2D probe gives sharper transmission matrix estimation per voxel for aberration compensation.
limitation: Proof of concept on phantom and ex-vivo tissue; in vivo transcranial use only suggested.

problem: Can gamma-lactams be synthesized using impure CO2 exhaust streams instead of purified CO2?
mechanism_or_method: Catalytic coupling of alkenes and amines with CO2 from car exhaust, with broad scope and late-stage functionalization.
limitation: Laboratory-scale synthesis; effect of exhaust contaminants at scale not assessed.

object: porous coordination networks for ethylene purification
problem: Can hydrogen bond control of pore structure shift C2H4 separation from ternary to quaternary mixtures?
mechanism_or_method: Different amino groups on triazolate ligands alter network hydrogen bonding, pore shape and chemistry, enhancing CO2 uptake over C2 hydrocarbons.
limitation: Lab breakthrough tests; long-term cycling and industrial gas impurities not addressed.

problem: Can a membrane reach practical water flux in vacuum-driven nanofiltration at below 1 bar?
mechanism_or_method: Silk-based membrane with crumpled defect-free rejection layer yields 96.2 L/m2/h/bar permeance with 96% Na2SO4 rejection.
limitation: Lab membranes; energy and emissions savings estimated by analysis, not pilot operation.

object: direct liquid cooling for hypersonic vehicle surfaces
problem: Can direct liquid cooling mitigate the hypersonic heat barrier by inhibiting the Leidenfrost effect?
mechanism_or_method: Blunt-sharp structured thermal armor elevates Leidenfrost point; fiber-metal nano/micro surface tested under butane and acetylene flames up to 3000 C.
limitation: Flame tests only simulate hypersonic heating; no real flow, pressure or flight conditions.
decision_relevance: Supports direct liquid cooling over indirect thermal protection for hypersonic skins.

problem: How can strength and electrical conductivity be improved simultaneously in bimetallic W-Cu composites?
mechanism_or_method: Alternating Cu layers and dislocation-rich W lamellae give stress partitioning, hetero-deformation strengthening, crack buffering and continuous conducting channels.
limitation: Lab-made samples; manufacturing scale-up and high-temperature performance not addressed.
decision_relevance: Architecture route to strong conductive electrical contact and heat-sink materials.

object: precious metal recovery from spent catalysts
problem: Can Pd and Au be recovered selectively without strong acids or cyanide?
mechanism_or_method: Peroxydisulfate advanced oxidation (photochemical or Fe(II) Fenton-like) generates radicals and Fe(IV)=O dissolving metals, then electrodeposition.
limitation: Lab-scale leaching of spent catalysts; economics and waste stream handling not covered.

problem: How can a fast biodegradable polymeric nanomotor be built and what causes its motion?
mechanism_or_method: Au nanoparticles on bowl-shaped stomatocytes; cryo-ET shows nonuniform axial Au distribution drives motion up to 125 um/s.
limitation: In vitro cell delivery only; in vivo propulsion and biocompatibility not shown.

object: power grid cascading outages under climate extremes
problem: How do hurricanes and renewable integration jointly affect cascading power outage risk?
mechanism_or_method: Coupled climate-energy cascading failure model for renewables, transmission and distribution, validated on Hurricane Fiona Puerto Rico blackout.
limitation: Validated on a single event and system; generality to other grids unknown.
decision_relevance: Sets solar integration level needing paired storage for grid resilience.

object: freestanding PZT thin film piezoelectric harvester
problem: Can ferroelectric oxide films be made both highly piezoelectric and flexible for energy harvesting?
mechanism_or_method: Water-soluble sacrificial layer releases (111)-oriented PZT single crystalline membranes, relieving substrate clamping and boosting piezoresponse.
limitation: Lead-containing thin films by costly epitaxy; large-area manufacturing and real use untested.

problem: Can organic crystals be made to bend collectively under infrared light for flexible waveguides?
mechanism_or_method: MXene-polymer multilayers on crystals act as photothermal absorbers, giving controllable bending of individual crystals and ordered arrays.
limitation: Lab-scale crystal arrays; actuation force and long-term durability not quantified.

problem: Can hydrogels be degraded wavelength-selectively by low-energy visible light, avoiding UV?
mechanism_or_method: Three photolabile crosslinkers (ruthenium polypyridyl and oNB-based) in PEG networks degrade with distinct visible wavelengths, deep in tissue.
limitation: In vitro cell work; in vivo performance of degradation not shown.

problem: Can a thin attachable metamaterial give visible absorption and low infrared emissivity for dual-band camouflage?
mechanism_or_method: Template-assisted self-assembly of Au nanoparticle hollow pillars with periodic through-holes, giving 0.947 visible absorptivity and low IR emissivity.
limitation: Gold-based small samples; cost and scale-up not addressed.

problem: How do dynamic hydrogels dehydrate differently from covalent hydrogels, and what drives their structural reorganization?
mechanism_or_method: Dehydration-induced stress reorganizes dynamic networks; competition between polymer cohesion and substrate adhesion gives anisotropic dehydration and hollow xerogels.
limitation: Qualitative observation on specific gel systems; quantitative stress model absent.

object: multimaterial cryogenic printing of hydrogel machines
problem: How can complex multimaterial 3D hydrogel architectures for soft machines be fabricated with robust interfaces?
mechanism_or_method: All-in-cryogenic printing: instant ink solidification then in-situ synchronous solvent melting and cross-linking.
limitation: Lab printer prototypes; functional lifetime of hydrogel machines in operation not addressed.
decision_relevance: Enables printed all-hydrogel actuators and sensing valves instead of molded assemblies.

object: long-chain polymer network with physical-bond domains
problem: Can a network achieve high modulus, high fatigue threshold and low hysteresis together?
mechanism_or_method: Unusually long chains crosslinked by physical-bond domains act as hard particles at moderate stress; at crack tips chains slip without pull-out.
limitation: Specific polymer network demonstrated; generality and processing of long chains unclear.
decision_relevance: Guides elastomer network design avoiding modulus-fatigue-hysteresis trade-off.

problem: Can a membrane selectively recover HCl from waste streams containing mixed ions?
mechanism_or_method: Angstrom-sized channels screen protons from hydrated cations; built-in charge-assisted hydrogen bond donors filter anions.
limitation: Lab-scale ionic selectivity tests; real waste stream fouling and scale not examined.

object: polyampholyte self-healing hydrogels under cyclic stretching
problem: How does hierarchical structure govern mechanical adaptation of self-healing hydrogels to cyclic stretching training?
mechanism_or_method: Cyclic stretching of polyampholyte hydrogel reveals mesoscale hard/soft bicontinuous phase networks control long-term memory and training dynamics.
limitation: Single model hydrogel system; transferability to other adaptive materials uncertain.
decision_relevance: Informs training protocols and hierarchy design for adaptive soft materials.

problem: What happens to HEA lattices at the elastic limit, and why does amorphization occur?
mechanism_or_method: In situ TEM tensile tests with atomic-resolution imaging, first-principles calculations and chemical mapping reveal amorphization near 10% elastic strain.
limitation: Nanoscale in situ samples; relevance to bulk deformation is unclear.

problem: Can a hydrogel dissipate mechanical energy rapidly and recover within seconds, unlike sacrificial-bond viscoelastic gels?
mechanism_or_method: Network with chain walker motion dissipates energy through molecular friction, giving fast damping recovery and protecting encapsulated cells.
limitation: Damping shown in lab compression tests; long-term cycling and load range limited.
decision_relevance: Offers recoverable damping material option for dynamic load absorbers.

object: MOF/polymer mixed matrix membrane for CO2 separation
problem: How does interfacial pore geometry between MOF and polymer affect gas transport in mixed matrix membranes?
mechanism_or_method: Molecular dynamics predicts expanding pore from MOF entrance to interface accelerates transport; oriented AlFFIVE-1-Ni/PIM-1 membrane fabricated to confirm.
limitation: Lab membranes; long-term plasticization and real gas mixtures not covered.

object: co-pyrolysis of spent battery oxides and waste LDPE
problem: Can waste batteries and plastics be co-processed to separate lithium and make an H2O2 electrocatalyst?
mechanism_or_method: Sealed-reactor co-pyrolysis separates Li from transition metals and yields NiCo alloy@CNT catalyst with about 90% H2O2 selectivity.
limitation: Lab-scale pyrolysis; real mixed waste feeds and economics not assessed.

object: positronium lifetime imaging in the human brain
problem: Can positronium lifetime be imaged in vivo to distinguish tumor from healthy tissue?
mechanism_or_method: Jagiellonian PET detects prompt gamma plus annihilation photons, reconstructing positronium formation and decay time per voxel.
limitation: Single patient case study; diagnostic value requires larger cohorts.

object: pH-resistant nanofiltration membrane for battery leachate
problem: Can a nanofiltration membrane resist concentrated acid and base while separating cations for lithium recovery?
mechanism_or_method: Interfacial quaternization of TAD and TBMB forms stable C-N bonds, giving size sieving and charge repulsion; stable 70 days in 3 M acid or base.
limitation: Lab-scale membrane coupons; module scale-up and fouling in real leachate not shown.

object: MOF composite pellets for SF6/N2 separation
problem: Can low-cost robust adsorbents with a VTSA process recover low-concentration SF6 from N2 efficiently?
mechanism_or_method: Al(fum) composite pellets with binders and two-stage vacuum temperature swing adsorption; NMR, FTIR and DFT reveal multi-site binding and fast diffusion.
limitation: Fixed-bed lab tests; process verified at small scale with idealized feed gas.
decision_relevance: Supports adsorption-based SF6 recovery instead of cryogenic distillation.

problem: What quantifiable mechanism predicts good strength-ductility combinations in FCC high-entropy alloys?
mechanism_or_method: Parameter kappa, ratio of short-range interactions between close-packed planes, promotes nanoscale stacking sequences and work hardening; used for alloy design.
limitation: Validated on CoCrNi-based family; predictive generality to other alloy systems unproven.
decision_relevance: Provides a composition design criterion for strong ductile alloys.

object: fluorinated diamond-like carbon hydrophobic condenser coatings
problem: Can a durable hydrophobic coating sustain dropwise condensation for years in steam power plant condensers?
mechanism_or_method: Multilayer pinhole-free F-DLC deposition with tailored substrate adhesion giving low surface energy and metal-like modulus.
limitation: Lab steam condensation test only; scale-up and cost of coating deposition on industrial condensers unproven.
decision_relevance: Supports coating choice for power plant condenser surfaces.

object: elastomer-based tough hydrogel for artificial skin
problem: How to make a hydrogel with skin-like modulus, friction and load capacity for bionic robot skin?
mechanism_or_method: Radiation-induced penetrating polymerization grafts hydrophilic chains onto elastomer networks, mimicking collagen fibers in water-rich matrix.
limitation: Only lab mechanical and friction tests; long-term durability and hydration stability not shown.

object: interfacial solar evaporators and vaporization enthalpy measurement
problem: Is dark-environment evaporation testing valid for claiming reduced water vaporization enthalpy in solar evaporators?
mechanism_or_method: Theory and experiments showing evaporative cooling alters environmental energy input, explaining rate differences without enthalpy reduction.
limitation: Does not rule out all possible enthalpy-reduction mechanisms under other conditions.
decision_relevance: Changes how evaporator performance and enthalpy claims should be characterized.

object: triboelectric self-powered sensing platform for underground mines
problem: Can battery-free TENG modules power wireless wind and gas sensing in underground mines?
mechanism_or_method: Non-contact TENG wind turbine for sensing plus hybrid-mode TENG array with power management, powering sensor node and LoRa transmitter.
limitation: Low harvested power density; operation demonstrated for about 3 months in limited mine tunnels.
decision_relevance: Informs battery-free sensor power design for ventilation monitoring in mines.

problem: Can a regenerable filter remove PM and VOCs simultaneously with long lifetime?
mechanism_or_method: Ceramic filter channels coated with inorganic membrane (inner) and Cu2O/TiO2 photocatalyst (outer), regenerated by water washing.
limitation: 20-year lifetime is extrapolated from ten regeneration cycles, not directly measured.
decision_relevance: Favors regenerable ceramic filters over disposable filters for air purification.

object: chemically fixed bovine pericardium for heart valve leaflets
problem: Why is bovine pericardium fatigue resistance insensitive to flaws such as suture holes?
mechanism_or_method: Cyclic stretch tests with cuts; strong collagen fibers in soft matrix transmit tension over long lengths and dissipate energy upon breakage.
limitation: Single tissue type and TPU comparison; in vivo conditions and calcification not addressed.
decision_relevance: Guides leaflet material choice and design for flaw-tolerant fatigue resistance.

problem: Does lower-purity lithium with Mg impurity harm cathode performance and can it cut cost and emissions?
mechanism_or_method: Cathode synthesis with 1% Mg-containing lithium precursor, plus industrial-scale cost and CO2 assessment.
limitation: Only Mg impurity studied; industrial savings are modeled estimates rather than plant data.

object: high-entropy alloy nanoparticles via thermal plasma
problem: Can HEA nanoparticles be synthesized continuously and scalably from elemental metal powders?
mechanism_or_method: In-flight alloying in a thermal plasma jet with rapid heating and cooling, supported by thermofluid simulation.
limitation: Conversion efficiency only 42%; only one alloy composition demonstrated.

problem: How to achieve spider-silk-like strength and toughness in artificial fibers?
mechanism_or_method: Ion-controlled chain dissociation and evaporation-induced self-assembly under stress to form superfine nanofibrils.
limitation: Strength-toughness trade-off remains; small-scale lab spinning only.

object: crown-ether polymer nanofilm membranes for organic solvent separation
problem: Can crosslinked crown ether nanofilms give higher selectivity for pharmaceutical separations in organic solvents?
mechanism_or_method: Interfacial polymerization of fully crosslinked crown ethers into 24 nm films on porous supports.
limitation: Tested on model mixtures; long-term stability and scale-up not demonstrated.

object: supercapacitor electrodes for electrochemical CO2 capture
problem: How do electrode structure and charging protocol affect supercapacitor CO2 capture performance?
mechanism_or_method: Structure-property-performance correlations across activated carbons under varied charging protocols, including positive charging mode.
limitation: Lab-scale cell tests; real flue gas contaminants and scale-up not addressed.

problem: Can a self-powered sensor give visualized tactile and acoustic perception with high sensitivity?
mechanism_or_method: Triboelectrification-induced electroluminescence unit converting sliding and sound into light signals.
limitation: Lab demonstrations only; brightness modest and robustness under real use unproven.

problem: Can self-generated internal convection raise interfacial solar evaporation rates without external power?
mechanism_or_method: Spherical evaporator geometry that drives internal airflow, trading 36% of light energy for vapor removal.
limitation: Indoor simulated-sun tests; outdoor performance and salt fouling not reported.
decision_relevance: Suggests evaporator design should allocate energy between evaporation and vapor-removing convection.

problem: How to make lightweight aerogels both tough and shape-editable?
mechanism_or_method: Twice-coagulated strategy: flexible PVA network first, then ANF network locks the edited configuration.
limitation: Proof of concept with one material pair; scalability not shown.

object: soft textile robots made by encoded sewing
problem: How to build programmable 3D soft textile robots through a simple 2D sewing process?
mechanism_or_method: Encoding heterogeneous stretching constraints into seams so bladder inflation follows prescribed shape and actuation sequence.
limitation: Textile durability and precision of programmed motions under repeated cycling not detailed.
decision_relevance: Guides low-cost design of pneumatic soft robot shells.

problem: How does stitch topology determine the emergent elasticity of knitted fabrics?
mechanism_or_method: Experiments and simulation to build a constitutive model for nonlinear bulk response, enabling composite fabrics independent of yarn.
limitation: Limited to several stitch types; model validated on lab-scale fabrics.
decision_relevance: Lets designers specify fabric stiffness by stitch pattern.

object: mechanical metamaterials for cascaded logic computing
problem: How can solitary waves compute multi-level cascaded logic in mechanical metamaterials without dissipation?
mechanism_or_method: Bistable chain units with heterogeneous design and an energy-potential analytical framework to control soliton profile and logic elements.
limitation: Prototype-scale logic circuits; speed and reconfigurability limited.

object: melt-quenched porous MOF glasses from ZIF-8
problem: How to obtain highly porous MOF liquids and glasses from a non-meltable MOF?
mechanism_or_method: Solvent-assisted linker exchange introduces two extra linkers into ZIF-8, creating high-entropy derivatives that melt and vitrify.
limitation: Pore volume of glasses still modest, about 0.2 cm3 per g.

problem: How to obtain ultrahigh strength with good ductility in medium-entropy alloys?
