limitation: Applications such as artificial muscles and implants are only suggested; biocompatibility untested.

problem: Which start-up trajectories minimize fatigue damage in hydraulic turbines?
mechanism_or_method: Machine learning model trained on experimental stress data from reduced-scale model turbines is used to optimize start-up trajectory.
limitation: Validated on reduced-scale model turbines; transfer to full-size field machines not shown.
decision_relevance: Changes hydropower start-up trajectory scheduling to reduce fatigue damage.

problem: How do liquid-like and stress-driven atomic motions combine across the glass transition in a metallic glass?
mechanism_or_method: Temperature-scanning X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy at a fourth-generation synchrotron probes dynamics over six orders of timescale.
limitation: Single alloy composition and requires synchrotron beamtime; interpretation is a superposition model.

problem: What controls the acidification of lithium brines during evaporative concentration?
mechanism_or_method: Geochemical and boron isotope data from Salar de Uyuni combined with speciation modeling show boric acid dissociation dominates alkalinity and pH.
limitation: Primary data from one salar; global extension relies on compiled brine compositions.

problem: Can pore-surface fluorination in mesoporous COFs improve capture and separation of polarized perfluorinated gases?
mechanism_or_method: Isostructural fluorinated vs non-fluorinated mesoporous COFs; fluorine-induced gradient electric field exploits polarizability differences of guest molecules.
limitation: Ambient-condition adsorption only; regeneration cycling and industrial gas mixtures not detailed.

object: swarm cooperation model for multi-agent optimization and control
problem: Can a decentralized swarm model with few parameters perform reliably with small swarms for optimization and vehicle control?
mechanism_or_method: Combines meta-heuristic and consensus theory into a Swarm Cooperation Model balancing social, cognitive and stochastic terms; tested on 33 landscapes and simulated AUV contaminant search.
limitation: Computational proof of concept only; no physical vehicle validation, and wins on 22 of 33 landscapes.

problem: How to manage interfacial water to achieve robust underwater adhesion without sacrificing bulk cohesion?
mechanism_or_method: Water penetration confined to sub-8 micrometer depth: hydration-activated hydrogen bonds at interface and hydrophobic nanodomains maintain bulk integrity.
limitation: Lab peel tests on selected substrates; long-term marine durability not reported.
decision_relevance: Choice of adhesive design for water-resistant bonding in harsh wet environments.

object: zwitterionic bottle-brush grafted reverse osmosis membranes
problem: How to prevent mineral scaling in high-recovery brackish water desalination?
mechanism_or_method: Two-step grafting of high-density zwitterionic pseudo-bottle-brushes onto polyamide RO membranes; molecular dynamics shows surface screening of silica aggregation.
limitation: Long-term tests limited to specific brackish water; scale-up of grafting not addressed.

object: earthquake frequency-magnitude b-value and fault criticality
problem: What controls b-value variations in natural seismicity, and does b-value decrease near critical failure?
mechanism_or_method: Analysis of small earthquake sequences using a high-precision focal mechanism dataset relating b-value to stress criticality.
limitation: Relies on specific regional sequences; predictive skill for large earthquakes not demonstrated.
decision_relevance: Informs earthquake early-warning and hazard assessment using b-value monitoring.

problem: How does the free water surface assist ice nucleation?
mechanism_or_method: Brute-force molecular dynamics shows surface-induced negative pressure promotes Ice 0-like ring-topology precursors slightly below the surface.
limitation: Simulation only with a classical water model; no experimental confirmation of the proposed precursors.

object: global HCFC and HFC banks and emissions
problem: How large are time-lagged fluorocarbon emissions and what abatement potential exists after the Kigali Amendment?
mechanism_or_method: Dynamic material flow analysis of global stocks and flows 1986-2060 with business-as-usual and best-practice abatement scenarios.
limitation: Projections depend on scenario assumptions and bank estimates with uncertainty (about 3.7 Gt CO2-eq).
decision_relevance: Prioritises refrigerant bank recovery and destruction policies in developed economies.

problem: How to design alloys with temperature- and time-independent resistivity that are also strong and ductile?
mechanism_or_method: Multicomponent alloy design with lattice distortion, chemical short-range order and coherent nanoprecipitates promotes temperature-independent inelastic electron scattering.
limitation: Resistivity invariance shown only up to 723 K; single composition family.
decision_relevance: Material choice for precision resistors under high mechanical load and temperature swings.

object: stabilized nanocrystalline Cu-Ta alloys under shock
problem: Can nanocrystalline Cu-Ta resist damage accumulation under repeated shock loading?
mechanism_or_method: Repeated shock loading up to 12 GPa with microstructural characterization shows reversal or recovery of dislocation structure.
limitation: Tested up to 12 GPa on one alloy system; behaviour at higher pressures or other alloys unknown.
decision_relevance: Material selection for components facing repeated shock or impact loading.

problem: How to extend switching endurance of phase change memory and what causes stuck-RESET failure?
mechanism_or_method: Nano-confined cell with carbon-doped GeSbTe relocates melt-quench region to dielectric, lowering RESET energy; failure attributed to carbon accumulation.
limitation: Single device architecture and material; array-level reliability not discussed.

problem: Can pneumatic coding blocks implement If, If-break and For control statements in electronics-free soft robots?
mechanism_or_method: Nonlinear mechanical components form analog pneumatic coding blocks that combine into programs controlling an autonomous soft gripper.
limitation: Demonstrated on a single gripper; program complexity and scalability remain limited.
decision_relevance: Offers pneumatic logic design choice for autonomous soft robots without electronics.

problem: How to raise oscillation frequency and versatility of non-electrical pneumatic oscillators for robotic locomotion?
mechanism_or_method: Snap-through buckling beam, fabric chambers and switch valve create stiffness gradient, reaching 51 Hz and driving jumping, crawling and swimming robots.
limitation: Prototype robots tested in lab; endurance and operation in actual extreme environments not shown.
decision_relevance: Informs stiffness-gradient design of fast pneumatic oscillators for untethered robots.

object: oxide scale spalling on heat-resistant alloys
problem: What atomistic mechanism causes alumina oxide scale to spall from alloy matrix at high temperature?
mechanism_or_method: Trace sulfur segregates to scale-matrix interface forming weak S-rich layer, confirmed by atomistic simulation; microalloying removes segregation and improves adhesion.
limitation: Demonstrated on a model alloy at 900 C; generality to commercial alloys and conditions untested.
decision_relevance: Control sulfur impurity or microalloy to improve oxide scale adhesion in high-temperature alloys.

problem: How to locally reorient magnetic particles to give reprogrammable magnetoactuated deformation in soft actuators?
mechanism_or_method: Localized laser heating reduces viscoelastic pinning force of Fe3+-coordinated gel network, allowing NdFeB particle reorientation under modest field.
limitation: Lab demonstrations of sheets; reprogramming resolution and cycle durability not detailed.

problem: How to build a durable, moisture-permeable fabric with active thermoregulation that avoids heat and cold irritation?
mechanism_or_method: Hierarchical structural engineering reduces polymer chain aggregation and builds stress-dissipative networks in phase-change composite fibrous membranes.
limitation: Durability shown only to 50 washes and 500 rubs; wearer trials not reported.

object: disordered multilayer graphene reinforced copper composites
problem: How to break the strength-plasticity trade-off in nanograined metals?
mechanism_or_method: Plasma-assisted ball milling disperses sp2-sp3 disordered multilayer graphene; interlayer sliding and interface lattice strain promote dislocation accumulation.
limitation: Compressive properties only; tensile behavior and scalability of plasma ball milling not shown.
decision_relevance: Guides reinforcement design for strong yet plastic metal matrix composites.

object: flexible Zn-based MOF films for CO2 capture
problem: How much low-pressure CO2 can flexible MOF films reversibly capture and release under temperature and light stimuli?
mechanism_or_method: Quartz crystal microbalance, synchrotron infrared spectromicroscopy and GIWAXS track CO2 uptake as stimuli change framework pore environment.
limitation: Thin-film uptake at low pressure; capacity and cycling relevant to real carbon capture not quantified.

object: poly(ionic liquid) electrode for dielectric elastomer actuators
problem: How to make ultrasoft, rapidly self-healing electrodes that increase actuation strain of dielectric elastomer actuators?
mechanism_or_method: Ionic interaction regulation yields PIL electrode with 3.4 kPa modulus and 10 s self-healing, in air and underwater.
limitation: Lab-scale actuators; long-term electrical breakdown and cycling durability not detailed.
decision_relevance: Electrode material choice for self-healing soft grippers working in air or underwater.

object: photothermal liquid crystal elastomer underwater actuators
problem: How to manage heat dissipation to enhance photothermal actuation of soft robots in water?
mechanism_or_method: Superhydrophobic candle soot coating traps air plastron for insulation, raising work output 282-fold and enabling total-internal-reflection self-oscillation.

object: multistage air-gap membrane distillation for DMF recovery
problem: Can waste-heat-driven membrane distillation recover high-value DMF solvent usable in perovskite solar cell manufacturing?
mechanism_or_method: Multistage air-gap membrane distillation enriches DMF from 0.3 to 94.2 wt%; recovered solvent used for perovskite minimodules.
limitation: Stable operation shown for only 60 hours at lab scale; industrial integration untested.
decision_relevance: Supports solvent recycling using waste heat in perovskite module manufacturing.

object: traffic crash prediction with large language models
problem: Can fine-tuned LLMs improve crash prediction and identify contributing risk factors from multimodal crash records?
mechanism_or_method: Textualize 58,903 crash reports into a dataset, fine-tune LLMs, and apply sentence-level feature attribution for conditional risk analysis.
limitation: Depends on crash report quality and region; causal interpretation of attributions is not established.
decision_relevance: Prioritises traffic safety interventions such as impaired driving and work zone countermeasures.

object: chemical short-range order in metallic alloys during processing
problem: How does chemical short-range order evolve during solidification and thermomechanical processing of alloys?
mechanism_or_method: High-fidelity atomistic simulations track SRO, revealing nonequilibrium steady states driven by an inherent ordering bias in nonequilibrium events.
limitation: Simulated rates exceed real processing; no direct experimental verification of nonequilibrium SRO states.
decision_relevance: Processing route can tune short-range order beyond equilibrium alloy design.

problem: How to achieve single-species K+/Na+ selective sieving in biomimetic membranes mimicking KcsA channels?
mechanism_or_method: In situ growth of carboxyl-rich 1D MOF inside 2D COF narrows pores and weakens K+-wall interaction, giving heterogeneous channels.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; operation in real mixed-ion streams and long-term stability not stated.

problem: How to recover uranium efficiently from concentrated nitric acid under intense radiation in spent fuel reprocessing?
mechanism_or_method: Metal-free g-C3N4 polymer with unsaturated nitrogen sites and pyrophosphate groups coordinates uranyl ions, stable in 12 M HNO3 and 500 kGy.
limitation: Proof-of-concept adsorption capacity 75.3 mg/g; real reprocessing streams and regeneration not tested.

object: slippery liquid-infused surfaces with hydrophilic bumps
problem: How to resolve the capture versus transport dilemma to achieve high-efficiency fog collection?
mechanism_or_method: Underwater infusion preserves hydrophilic bumps on SLIPS, combining beetle and pitcher-plant features; TiO2 bumps add photocatalytic purification.
limitation: Lab fog chamber tests; outdoor durability and lubricant retention not reported.

problem: How to make synthetic hydrogels as strong, stiff and tough as ligaments?
mechanism_or_method: Fiber-shaped polymer-particle hybrid agglomerates in a continuous matrix give efficient load transfer and energy dissipation, assembled into parallel bundles.
limitation: Fatigue and long-term in-vivo performance not reported; hydrogel fibers made at lab scale.

problem: How to integrate conformal actuation, sensing and electronics into autonomous soft robots using automated fabrication?
mechanism_or_method: Integrated digital light processing and direct ink writing printing, with lattice metamaterials, wavy interconnects and discretized printed circuit boards for stability.
limitation: Lab prototypes; electrical durability under repeated large deformation and printing throughput not quantified.

problem: How to raise piezoionic flex-sensitivity and resolve multi-DoF body motions with a single self-powered sensor?
mechanism_or_method: Zwitterionic dipole-ion interactions and steric hindrance amplify ion transport imbalance; square-prism fiber with two nanomesh electrode pairs decouples joint flexion.
limitation: Demonstrated on limited motions and users; long-term stability under humidity and wear not detailed.

problem: Can overtone photothermal imaging combine chemical specificity, sensitivity and spatial resolution for vibrational imaging?
mechanism_or_method: Visible probe detects local heating from C-H overtone absorption, imaging polymers, cancer cells, C. elegans and brain tissue.
limitation: Restricted to C-H overtone region; imaging depth in scattering tissue is limited.

object: air-to-air heat pumps in urban space heating
problem: What energy, CO2 and local climate impacts would a switch to air-to-air heat pumps have in a mid-latitude city?
mechanism_or_method: Urban climate and building energy simulation of heat pump adoption in Toulouse, comparing electric and gas heating baselines.
limitation: Single city with a specific heating mix; results may not transfer to fossil-heavy grids.
decision_relevance: Informs urban heat pump transition policy and grid planning.

problem: Can pore size and silanol groups in a zeolite jointly separate benzene from cyclohexane to ultrapure levels?
mechanism_or_method: Ordered silanols in -SVR zeolite bind benzene reversibly via SiOH...pi interactions, shown by breakthrough tests, in situ FTIR, DFT and AIMD.
limitation: Lab-scale breakthrough tests under ambient conditions; scale-up and long-term stability not addressed.

object: social impacts of materials in green energy technologies
problem: Which critical materials in green energy technologies bring the greatest social benefits and risks?
mechanism_or_method: Dynamic material-energy flow model integrating system dynamics, social life cycle assessment and geometallurgical approaches.
limitation: Depends on social indicator databases and scenario assumptions; limited indicator set.
decision_relevance: Guides material choice and sourcing policy for energy transition.

object: EGF-domain proteins and chitosan underwater adhesion
problem: How do EGF domains in byssal proteins bind GlcNAc-based polysaccharides to give underwater adhesion?
mechanism_or_method: Surface forces apparatus measurements of EGF-protein adhesion to chitosan of varying acetylation on mica.
limitation: Model-surface measurements on mica; real tissue or marine conditions not tested.

problem: Can a catheter change stiffness instantly without heating to speed minimally invasive surgery?
mechanism_or_method: Hundreds of ultrathin fibers in a 2.3 mm catheter jam under vacuum, giving up to 6.5-fold stiffness change in under 300 ms.
limitation: Bench-level prototype; in vivo performance and clinical validation not reported.
decision_relevance: Favors jamming over phase-change stiffening in catheter design.

problem: What governs how long an object stays adhered to a surface before sudden detachment?
mechanism_or_method: Rheological theory combining bulk rheology and interfacial viscoelasticity, with lifetime predictions validated by adhesion experiments.
limitation: Validated on model viscoelastic materials; generality to other interfaces untested.
decision_relevance: Enables adhesive lifetime prediction for design of bonded joints.

object: spatiotemporal acoustic vortices with oriented orbital angular momentum
problem: Can acoustic vortices be generated with arbitrarily oriented orbital angular momentum?
mechanism_or_method: A 2D acoustic phased array rotates vortices in 3D space or intersects vortices carrying different OAM types.
limitation: Demonstrated in lab acoustic fields; particle manipulation applications only suggested.

problem: How to hydrogenate liquid organic hydrogen carriers with CO-containing crude H2 without catalyst poisoning?
mechanism_or_method: Pd/alpha-MoC with water solvent uses low-temperature water gas shift to remove CO; positively charged Pd suppresses H2 release.
limitation: Lab reactor tests with model crude H2 gas mixtures; long-term stability not shown.

object: HiPIMS thin film deposition on insulators
problem: How to accelerate metal ions onto insulating substrates at low temperature without damaging films?
mechanism_or_method: Synchronized floating-potential HiPIMS times ion arrival with the substrate's transient negative floating potential during discharge.
limitation: Proof of concept on AlScN films; other materials only claimed to work.
decision_relevance: Enables low-temperature crystalline film growth on insulators in standard PVD tools.

problem: How large is the scientific literature on carbon dioxide removal and where is it concentrated?
mechanism_or_method: AI-enhanced systematic mapping to classify tens of thousands of studies by method, research type and region.
limitation: Mapping depends on search strategy and classifier accuracy; no assessment of study quality.

problem: How do by-product and host metal markets interact in price and production at the mine level?
mechanism_or_method: Multicommodity supply curve model of jointly produced commodities applied to the copper-cobalt-nickel system.
limitation: Relies on mine-level cost data and assumptions; not validated against realized market outcomes.

object: thin film nanocomposite cation exchange membrane for lithium
problem: How to selectively extract Li+ over Na+ and Ca2+ with a scalable membrane?
mechanism_or_method: Polyamide layer with amine-functionalized lithium titanium oxide nanoparticles by interfacial polymerization gives Li+-exclusive pathways; MD shows dehydration.
limitation: Lab-scale electrodialysis with synthetic solutions; real brine performance and durability unclear.

problem: What are the atomic-scale steps and optimal pH for CO2 mineralization on wet mineral surfaces?
mechanism_or_method: Reactive and non-reactive molecular simulations with well-tempered metadynamics map five-step pathway in a water-filmed portlandite mesopore.
limitation: Simulation only on one idealized mineral surface; no experimental validation.

object: soft robotic hand with visual-tactile sensing
problem: How to give soft grippers full-coverage multimodal haptic perception with high compliance?
mechanism_or_method: FlexiRay combines a Fin Ray soft gripper, multi-mirror optics, single camera and decoupled deep learning to sense force, texture and temperature.
limitation: Tested on lab benches; durability and complex real-world grasping scenarios are limited.
decision_relevance: Supports using compliant Fin Ray fingers for visual-tactile sensing designs.

object: anti-Janus nanofiltration membrane for lithium recovery
problem: How to raise Li+/divalent cation selectivity without sacrificing permeability in nanofiltration?
mechanism_or_method: Quaternary ammonium electrolyte forms discrete micro-nano islands giving a mosaic-like charge structure that avoids electrostatic shielding.
limitation: Lab-scale tests with model Li/Co/Mn solutions; scale-up and fouling not shown.

problem: How to selectively recover Li, Mn, Ni and Co from battery leaching solutions at scale?
mechanism_or_method: Electro-membrane crystallization process integrating selective membranes, bipolar membranes, metal complexing and extracting, with techno-economic analysis.
limitation: Lab-scale demonstration; Co and Ni recovery and purity lower than Li and Mn.

problem: How does cation site occupancy in high-entropy spinels control oxygen evolution activity?
mechanism_or_method: Adding a sixth cation (Zn) shifts Co to octahedral sites, confirmed by DFT, synchrotron XAS and magnetic circular dichroism.
limitation: Small set of dopants tested; long-term device-level stability not demonstrated.

problem: Can distribution grids be mapped at scale from publicly available multi-modal data?
mechanism_or_method: Machine-learning framework combining street view images, road networks and building maps, benchmarked against California utility grid maps.
limitation: Precision about 80%; underground line fraction estimated only at aggregate level with R2 of 0.63.
decision_relevance: Enables grid planning and wildfire exposure assessment where utility maps are unavailable.

object: CO2-loaded polyethylenimine and nanoparticle organic hybrid electrolytes
problem: What carbon species and transport properties arise in polymer electrolytes after CO2 capture?
mechanism_or_method: Quantitative variable-temperature 13C NMR and pulsed-field-gradient 1H NMR combined with molecular dynamics.
limitation: Characterizes materials only; electrochemical conversion performance not tested.

problem: How does a radially symmetric epithelial dome transform into a curved fold shape during eversion?
mechanism_or_method: Cell-behavior mapping on 3D surfaces feeds a shape-programmability model; active spontaneous strains reproduce eversion, validated by MyoVI knockdown.
limitation: Single tissue and developmental stage; generality to other morphogenesis not shown.

problem: Can phase engineering push gold beyond the ideal strength limit of the FCC phase?
mechanism_or_method: Thickness-dependent FCC-HCP transformation in nanoflakes, AFM suspended nanoindentation, with first-principles and MD calculations.
limitation: Only ultrathin nanoflakes under 10 nm reach peak strength; scalability unclear.

problem: How can a system store multiple memories under asymmetric one-sided driving?
mechanism_or_method: Two hysterons with frustrated interaction violate return-point memory, forming a hysteron latch with multiple memories.
limitation: Abstract-level model with two hysterons; no experimental realization reported.

object: Frank dislocation loops in fcc irradiated alloys
problem: Can loop morphology reveal whether radiation-induced dislocation loops are interstitial or vacancy type?
mechanism_or_method: Correlate circular versus segmented loop shapes with nature, explained by dissociation into Shockley partial and stair-rod dislocations.
limitation: Rule varies for low-SFE and high-entropy alloys; relies on irradiation and microscopy experiments.

problem: How to wirelessly power implants independent of the intervening medium, unlike ultrasound?
mechanism_or_method: Oscillating magnetic field moves elastomeric magnets into contact with electrodes, producing contact electrification output.
limitation: Bench demonstration through tissue and materials; output power and in vivo operation not established.

problem: Can a membrane switch its molecular sieving cutoff depending on the solvent?
mechanism_or_method: Porous graphene in GO membrane changes dominant nanochannel from GO-GO to GO-PG in methanol, expanding interlayer spacing.
limitation: Lab-scale small membranes; stability over long cycling and scale-up not shown.

problem: How to overcome nanoparticle agglomeration to raise energy release efficiency of nanothermite?
mechanism_or_method: V2C MXene templates ordered self-assembly of Al and CuO nanoparticles via electrostatic and Cu-O-V bonding, tuning combustion.
limitation: Lab-scale synthesis and tests; microinitiator integration only proposed.

problem: How to break the strength-ductility tradeoff in an ultrafine-grained medium entropy alloy?
mechanism_or_method: Activate non-basal slip in ordered HCP superlattice nanoprecipitates within a fully recrystallized FCC/HCP architecture.
limitation: Lab-scale processed samples; fatigue, cost and scale-up not addressed.

problem: How to achieve fatigue-resistant, functional adhesion between hydrogels and tissues?
mechanism_or_method: Rigid chitosan nanowhiskers form an interpenetrated interface layer that kinks and arrests cracks, delivered via enhancers, microneedles or ultrasound.
limitation: Tested on ex vivo tissue and hydrogels; long-term in vivo performance not shown.

problem: Can H2S in natural gas be electrochemically converted to sulfate under mild conditions?
mechanism_or_method: Cathodically generated in-situ H2O2 drives deep oxidation of H2S in flow reactors, with life-cycle and techno-economic analysis.
limitation: Tested up to 100 cm2 flow reactor and 100 h; industrial scale unproven.

object: acoustic emission signals from deforming metals
problem: How to identify co-existing deformation mechanisms such as dislocation slip and cracking from acoustic emission?
mechanism_or_method: Knowledge-driven unsupervised learning aggregates gradient-driven base learners with knowledge-infused loss, linked to avalanche theory.
limitation: Tested on tensile tests of porous 316L; transfer to other materials shown only briefly.
decision_relevance: Supports real-time early failure warning from acoustic emission monitoring.

problem: How to give hydrogel microrobots multimodal locomotion with faster, lower-energy light actuation?
mechanism_or_method: Truncated octahedron lattice of PNIPAM-SWNT hydrogel lowers density; sequential laser scanning drives peristalsis, rotation and hopping.
limitation: Needs external laser setup; speeds remain slow and operation is only shown in lab media.

problem: Can structure, manufacturing, material and stimuli be co-designed autonomously for target shape morphing?
mechanism_or_method: Generalized topology optimization with hybrid data-physics differentiable simulation, realized by multimaterial 3D printing of liquid crystal elastomers.
limitation: Demonstrated on network-like systems with a specific printing process and LCE materials.
decision_relevance: Automates design of shape-morphing structures under heat and light.

problem: How to get ultrafast transport of both polar and non-polar solvents through polyamide membranes?
mechanism_or_method: Non-planar diphenyl ether amine monomer interfacial polymerization at deep eutectic solvent/alkane interface yields thin microporous Janus-like layer.
limitation: Lab-scale coupons; scale-up and long-term solvent exposure not detailed.

object: photovoltaic waste and secondary materials supply
problem: How much can anthropogenic mineral circularity supply global photovoltaic material demand and cut waste?
mechanism_or_method: Global material flow modeling of five PV technologies under energy scenarios, with criticality, economic and emissions assessment.
limitation: Scenario-dependent projections to 2050 with assumed recycling rates and lifetimes.
decision_relevance: Guides PV recycling capacity and material circularity policy planning.

object: European green steel markets and carbon policy
problem: When does hydrogen-based steelmaking become cost-competitive under EU ETS and carbon border adjustment?
mechanism_or_method: Techno-economic and policy analysis of EU climate policy revisions, including relocation of ironmaking and trade of hot briquetted iron.
limitation: Depends on projected policy, energy prices and technology costs; commercial deployment still unproven.

object: aluminum matrix composites with rebar-concrete-inspired structure
problem: How to improve mechanical performance of aluminum matrix composites via a rebar-reinforced concrete-inspired architecture?
mechanism_or_method: Multiscale reinforcing architecture combined with anomalous temperature-dependent deformation of Ti-containing reinforcement; abstract is truncated.
limitation: Abstract is incomplete; scalability and detailed property trade-offs are unclear.

problem: Can additive manufacturing give a commercial titanium alloy high strength together with strong strain hardening?
mechanism_or_method: AM martensite with triple-twinned substructure progressively detwins into single-twinned lamellae during tension, raising flow stress.
limitation: Lab-scale specimens; fatigue and build-geometry sensitivity not reported in abstract.
decision_relevance: Supports AM process choice for tougher, work-hardening titanium parts.

problem: Can scattering by obstacles be suppressed across an ultra-broad acoustic bandwidth?
mechanism_or_method: Subwavelength tunnels with crafted internal structure guide waves around obstacles and recreate the incoming wavefront at the exit surface.
limitation: Works below a frequency limit set by tunnel width; lab-scale samples only.

problem: Can direct air capture be coupled with methane production at lower energy and cost?
mechanism_or_method: Bipolar membrane electrodialysis co-generates CO2 and H2 in one compartment, followed by thermochemical methanation.
limitation: Proof-of-concept scale with high energy per mole of methane; techno-economics are predictions.

problem: Where and with what material properties do thermo-responsive windows save the most building energy globally?
mechanism_or_method: Over 2.8 million building simulations across 2000+ locations feed neural network models to produce world heatmaps and an open mapping tool.
limitation: Simulation-based with assumed building models; no field validation of window performance.
decision_relevance: Guides climate-specific selection of window material transition temperatures.

object: Ti-Cr-Mo quinary out-of-plane ordered MAX phases
problem: Can solid solutions of two o-MAX phases yield multicomponent o-MAX with preserved chemical ordering?
mechanism_or_method: Mix Cr2.5Ti1.5AlC3 and Mo2Ti2AlC3 at set ratios; DFT analyses bonding and predicts mechanical properties.
limitation: Only three compositions studied; mechanical data limited to compressive strength and energy dissipation.

problem: How to build a fast insect-scale robot that can actively morph and self-recover?
mechanism_or_method: Arc-heating actuator provides kinetic and thermal energy to deform shape memory alloy wires, coupling actuation and morphing.
limitation: Tethered lab prototype; energy supply and autonomous operation not addressed in abstract.

object: pneumatic torsion strips for soft robot shape morphing
problem: How to bend soft bodies locally over large curvature without in-plane strain or stiffness change?
mechanism_or_method: Bent and twisted bladder ribbons (Mobius-inspired) on braided bodies exert bending torque; a mathematical model of geometry and elastic energy.
limitation: Demonstrated in prototype case studies; control precision and durability not quantified.
decision_relevance: Offers strain-free bending actuators for transformable soft structures.

object: high-speed railway infrastructure monitored by telecom fiber
problem: Can existing trackside telecom fibers inspect high-speed railway health through daily train-induced vibrations?
mechanism_or_method: Laser interferometer distributed vibration sensing with an average power spectral density indicator, observed over one year.
limitation: Few infrastructure types and one maintenance case; no direct comparison with inspection vehicle quantified.
decision_relevance: Supports fiber-based continuous monitoring as supplement to track recording vehicles.

object: net-zero pathways with separate removal targets
problem: What are the cost impacts of separating CO2 emission reduction targets from removal targets?
mechanism_or_method: Scenario analysis with the REMIND integrated assessment model comparing integrated and separated emission and novel CDR targets.
limitation: Single integrated assessment model with assumptions on CDR costs and potentials.

object: adaptive electronics for wearable sensor power harvesting
problem: How to cut battery needs of skin-interfaced wireless sensors using ambient light?
mechanism_or_method: Tri-modal harvesting with photometric sensing, multijunction photovoltaics and photoluminescent packaging, plus in-sensor computation and RF charging.
limitation: Depends on ambient light availability; abstract gives no quantitative power or long-term wear results.

problem: How to remove small neutral organic contaminants while keeping water permeance high in RO membranes?
mechanism_or_method: Self-assembled amphiphilic CdII/L-cysteine nanowire interface shuttles MPD monomers, giving a defect-suppressed ultraselective polyamide layer.
limitation: Lab-scale coupons; cadmium use and long-term stability raise scale-up concerns.

object: silicon nanocolumn capacitive ultrasound transducer patch
problem: Can a lead-free, flexible, disposable ultrasound patch support wearable imaging and blood pressure monitoring?
mechanism_or_method: Silicon nanocolumn CMUT array enhances displacement efficiency, giving thin flexible patch with 8.9 VPP operation.
limitation: Small human demonstration on carotid arteries; long-term wear and reliability not shown.

problem: How to raise water and solvent permeance while keeping selectivity and low fouling in polyamide membranes?
mechanism_or_method: Nanomolding phase inversion makes pillar-array patterns on Kevlar hydrogel supports guiding interfacial polymerization of textured polyamide layers.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; large-area nanoimprinting manufacturing feasibility not demonstrated.

problem: Can high-entropy ceramic nanolattices achieve simultaneous high strength and energy absorption?
mechanism_or_method: Transparent metal-salt precursors with two-photon polymerization and two-step sintering make dense nanolattices; high-entropy effect raises dislocation density.
limitation: Nanoscale specimens fabricated by slow two-photon printing; scalability to bulk parts is limited.

object: polymer nanocomposites with bound polymer loops
problem: How to keep high-filler nanocomposite melts flowing while improving toughness and strength?
mechanism_or_method: Bound polymer loops on particle surfaces relax freely, forming a dynamic loose particle network instead of a quasi-permanent bridged network.
limitation: Specific polymer-particle systems in lab; generality across fillers and matrices unverified.

problem: How to match evaporation and condensation capacity to maximize passive solar water production?
mechanism_or_method: Asymmetric tapered eight-stage still with tunable mass transfer gap optimizes condensation-to-evaporation area ratio.
limitation: Outdoor tests are short; long-term fouling and scale-up costs are not detailed.
decision_relevance: Guides condensation-to-evaporation area ratio in multistage solar still design.

problem: How to retain strength of aluminum alloys at elevated temperatures using additive manufacturing?
mechanism_or_method: Near-eutectic AlLaScZr printed by laser powder bed fusion forms thermally stable nanoscale eutectic cellular network that cages dislocation motion.
limitation: Contains costly Sc and La; creep, fatigue and large-part performance not reported.
decision_relevance: Supports printed Al alloys for components at about 300 C.

problem: How to replicate spider silk's hierarchical structure and properties in scalable synthetic fibers?
mechanism_or_method: Wet-spinning with antisolvent-induced microphase separation followed by post-drawing strain programming aligns microfibrils and forms crystallites.
limitation: Lab wet-spinning; moisture sensitivity and long-term durability limit applications.

problem: Can a lightweight, load-bearing, conformable skin deliver ultrabroadband radar absorption?
mechanism_or_method: Chain-mail-inspired topologically interlocked units combine mechanical robustness with electromagnetic absorption from 2 to 40 GHz.
limitation: Demonstrated on a drone wing prototype; harsh-environment durability and large-scale manufacture untested.
decision_relevance: Supports interlocked metastructures for conformal load-bearing stealth skins.

problem: How to overcome the activity-selectivity trade-off in selective catalytic oxidation of ammonia?
mechanism_or_method: Ir sites oxidize NH3 to NO, which reacts with NH3 on adjacent W sites via SCR to N2, shown by operando studies and DFT.
limitation: Powder catalyst lab tests; durability, water tolerance and practical exhaust conditions not shown.

problem: How to make scalable, durable radiative coolers with low filler loading and architected forms?
mechanism_or_method: Rheology-optics coupling links polymer viscoelasticity to particle dispersion and scattering; direct ink writing prints daylight-regulating architectures.
limitation: Pilot-scale tests only; long-term outdoor aging and cost versus paint not fully established.
decision_relevance: Favors printable low-filler PDMS coatings for building cooling load reduction.

problem: How to separate propylene from propane with both high capacity and fast diffusion in a molecular sieve?
mechanism_or_method: Gate-channel-cavity MOF architecture combines sieving gates, wide diffusion channels and central cavities, tested by adsorption and breakthrough experiments.
limitation: Lab-scale single-cycle breakthrough tests; scale-up and long-term cycling stability unclear.

problem: Can friction of graphene be controllably and reversibly reduced by high-stress pre-rubbing?
mechanism_or_method: Pre-rubbing lowers sliding barrier and raises contact stiffness via stronger substrate adhesion from interfacial charge transfer, shown by DFT.
limitation: Nanoscale friction measurements on atomically thin films; macroscale lubrication relevance unclear.

problem: How to achieve multi-axis force sensing and decoupled gripping for delicate cochlear implant microsurgery?
mechanism_or_method: Pneumatic gripper with fiber Bragg grating 6-axis force sensing on a spherical parallel mechanism and robotic arm.
limitation: Validated only on cadaveric temporal bone and head; no live patient trials.

problem: Can a liner adapt its stiffness and volume in real time to body shape changes for amputees?
mechanism_or_method: Silicone elastomer with embedded pressurizable millifluidic channels giving spatiotemporally tunable stiffness and volume.
limitation: Only preclinical studies; long-term durability and clinical outcomes unclear.
decision_relevance: Supports adaptive pneumatic liners over fixed-stiffness prosthetic interfaces.

problem: How to efficiently find active and stable high-entropy OER electrocatalyst compositions in a vast compositional space?
mechanism_or_method: Batch-alloy targeting: fuse elements into rough-guess multiphase alloy library and use surface restructuring extent as activity indicator.
limitation: Restructuring as activity proxy validated on a limited system; generality unclear.

object: thermally cross-linked perfluorinated polymer gas separation membranes
problem: How to make microporous membranes resistant to plasticization and aging with high CO2 permeability?
mechanism_or_method: Defluorination-induced thermal cross-linking of perfluorinated aryl-ether-free polymers generates extrinsic micropores and larger intersegmental distances.
limitation: Lab-scale testing; long-term industrial stability under real feeds not shown.

object: peptoid crystalline nanomaterials as carbonic anhydrase mimics
problem: Can assembled peptoid crystals mimic carbonic anhydrase to promote CO2 hydration and sequestration?
mechanism_or_method: Self-assembly of ligand-bearing peptoids coordinated with Zn2+ into nanosheets and nanotubes with controlled active-site microenvironment.
limitation: Comparable only to natural bovine CA; scale-up and real flue gas performance not shown.

problem: Can clothing thickness adapt automatically to sweating to widen thermal regulation range?
mechanism_or_method: Bacterial cellulose membrane filling that thins from 13 mm to 2 mm with humidity and sweat.
limitation: City-level benefit is modeled; wearer trials and durability under washing not reported.
decision_relevance: Favors humidity-responsive fillings over fixed-thickness insulation for cold-climate clothing.

object: Pickering emulsion solvent extraction of lithium from brine
problem: How to raise lithium recovery and Li-Mg selectivity while preventing extractant dissolution?
mechanism_or_method: Amphipathic SiO2 nanoparticles confine TBP in O/W Pickering emulsion; interparticle gaps act as Li+ transport channels.
limitation: Lab-scale extraction; mechanism proposed rather than directly proven; long-term emulsion stability unclear.

object: copper-containing mordenite adsorbent for N2/CH4 separation
problem: How to tune zeolite pore size at 0.1-0.2 Angstrom resolution to sieve nitrogen from methane?
mechanism_or_method: In situ high-temperature crystallization shifts copper position in mordenite, enlarging pore volume and improving N2 uptake kinetics.
limitation: Absolute N2 capacity is low; testing on pure gases and breakthrough only at lab scale.

object: amino acid-modified ice for methane hydrate storage
problem: Can amino acid-modified ice rapidly form methane hydrate with high storage capacity for solidified natural gas?
mechanism_or_method: Amino acids promote hydrate nucleation and growth on ice, tracked with in situ Raman for cage occupancy.
limitation: Lab-scale reactors; scalability only assessed preliminarily and cyclic reuse unclear.
decision_relevance: Suggests additive-modified ice as a faster route to solidified natural gas storage.

object: Ni-V and Ni-Pd single-phase solid solution alloys
problem: Is atomic volume or electronegativity difference the dominant factor in solid solution strengthening of FCC alloys?
mechanism_or_method: Designed Ni-V and Ni-Pd alloys isolating each variable and comparing strengthening versus grain size effects.
limitation: Only two binary Ni-based FCC systems; extension to multicomponent alloys not tested.
decision_relevance: Guides solute selection toward atomic size mismatch in strengthening models.

problem: How to map inner canthi temperature accurately, non-contact, with better pixel allocation than camera thermography?
mechanism_or_method: Single-pixel infrared imaging with cyclic S-matrix transmissive encoding masks and non-iterative reconstruction.
limitation: Small human measurement scale; clinical diagnostic validity not demonstrated.
decision_relevance: May refine fever screening criteria using inner canthi temperature.

problem: How to keep an anti-fog coating effective long-term against cyclic drying, contaminants and weak interfaces?
mechanism_or_method: Twisted non-coplanar phthalazinone structures raise free volume and moisture absorption, combined with photothermal fog removal.
limitation: Laboratory durability tests; outdoor real-world aging not shown.

problem: Can light control redox switching of hydrogels to give spatiotemporal precision for actuation?
mechanism_or_method: Bisthioxanthylidene switch in hydrogel whose two-electron oxidation potential is modulated by light, patterned by photo-masking.
limitation: Proof-of-principle; actuation forces and speeds modest and long-term cycling unclear.

problem: How to increase TENG output when densifying triboelectric layers despite charge cancellation and shielding?
mechanism_or_method: Charge dispatch strategy via path diversion and mode transformation, laser etching, contact push pins, and magnetic repulsion pendulum.
limitation: Lab-scale wave excitation; long-term wear and marine durability not reported.
decision_relevance: Guides layer-density and pendulum design for low-frequency wave energy harvesters.

problem: How to synthesize monodisperse multicomponent HEO hollow nanocubes despite disparate nucleation and growth kinetics?
mechanism_or_method: Template-assisted coordinating etching with selected etchant at room temperature to build ternary to octonary libraries.
limitation: Applications only implied; functional performance not evaluated in the abstract.

problem: How do gradient microstructures around dendrites affect strength-ductility, and can they be programmed?
mechanism_or_method: Unified trigonometric function describing gradient microstructures, with high-throughput simulations linking gradient intensity to properties.
limitation: Trigonometric gradient description tied to specific AM single-crystal alloys; wider validation unclear.
decision_relevance: Guides tuning of AM process gradients to tailor strength and ductility.

problem: Can mechanical vibration replace heat to extract water from sorbents at lower energy than evaporation enthalpy?
mechanism_or_method: Ultrasonic vibrational actuation extracts adsorbed water from moisture harvesting materials without thermal evaporation.
limitation: Bench-scale extraction; system-level energy including adsorption and ultrasound hardware at scale unproven.
decision_relevance: Suggests ultrasonic extraction over thermal desorption for low-energy water harvesting.

object: laser-induced melting of tungsten and gold nanofilms
problem: How does extreme electron-ion non-equilibrium change melting mechanisms in ultrafast laser-excited metals?
mechanism_or_method: Neural network-enhanced multiscale simulation showing electronic pressure relaxation drives surface-initiated heterogeneous melting.
limitation: Purely simulated; awaits time-resolved X-ray diffraction experimental confirmation.

problem: Can oxygen clusters avoid inverse Hall-Petch softening in nanograined metals while retaining plasticity?
mechanism_or_method: O-rich clusters at grain boundaries stabilize them and clusters in grains promote dislocation multiplication and strain hardening.
limitation: Micropillar compression on a thin-film model alloy; bulk scalability unclear.
decision_relevance: Suggests solute clustering for nanocrystalline strength design.

object: 3D-printed CoCrNi medium-entropy alloy with TiC precipitates
problem: How to introduce controlled nano-precipitates in AM alloys despite the narrow laser thermal window?
mechanism_or_method: CoCrNi core powders decorated with TiC shell nanoparticles dissolve at first laser pulse and reprecipitate in situ on cyclic reheating.
limitation: Demonstrated for one alloy system; fatigue and large part build quality not reported.
decision_relevance: Favors composite powder feedstock for precipitation strengthening in laser AM.

object: shape-memory hydrogel substrates for implantable bioelectronics
problem: How to program trigger-free shapeshifting with predefined onset times in hydrogel substrates?
mechanism_or_method: Digital light 4D printing with spatiotemporal exposure creating heterogeneous networks and thermally induced phase separation delays.
limitation: Mouse in-vivo only for biocompatibility; implantation shape recovery in tissue not shown.

problem: How to morph closed surfaces in shape, size and topology with programmed bistability?
mechanism_or_method: Balanced integration of origami crease rotation and kirigami hinge rotation in panel assemblages.
limitation: Prototype-scale demonstrations; actuation and load-bearing capability not addressed in the abstract.

problem: How to get high EMI shielding and load-bearing in a lightweight magnesium composite?
mechanism_or_method: Preconstructed 3D pristine graphene@pyrocarbon skeleton infiltrated with molten AZ91D and retained by liquid-solid infiltration extrusion.
limitation: Lab-scale samples; fatigue, corrosion and scalability not addressed.

object: MOF-LiCl composite sorbent for solar atmospheric water harvesting
problem: How to lower desorption temperature and use nighttime humidity better in solar atmospheric water harvesting?
mechanism_or_method: Composite of LiCl with Ni2Cl2(BTDD) MOF combining low vaporization enthalpy and high stable capacity.
limitation: Field tests short; MOF cost and long-term salt leakage stability unclear.
decision_relevance: Supports hybrid salt-MOF sorbents for lower-temperature desorption devices.

problem: How much warming do air-conditioning related emissions cause, and how do climate and income drive them?
mechanism_or_method: Scenario-based global quantification of AC emissions and temperature impact, separating climate and socio-economic contributions.
limitation: Scenario-dependent projections with uncertain AC ownership and use assumptions.
decision_relevance: Argues for prioritizing low-carbon, efficient cooling policy as incomes rise.

object: ZSM-5 nanorod array films on monoliths
problem: How to speed propene sorption kinetics without losing capacity in porous materials?
mechanism_or_method: Oriented single-crystalline ZSM-5 nanorod arrays on monoliths, optionally combined with Co3O4 nanoarrays for removal.
limitation: Lab-scale simple gas tests; realistic exhaust conditions with water and poisons not shown.

object: vacancy-rich titania monolayers for proton transport
problem: Can 2D titania monolayers deliver high proton conductivity while blocking other species?
mechanism_or_method: Dense titanium vacancies (about one per square nm) make the monolayer an angstrom-scale proton sieve.
limitation: Monolayer devices at small scale; large-area membranes and long-term durability not shown.

problem: How to design a light, strong alloy with high He-ion irradiation resistance?
mechanism_or_method: High-throughput design producing high-content beta-Nb5Si3 phase with prefabricated lattice distortion and semi-coherent interfaces, supported by DFT.
limitation: Ion irradiation is a surrogate for neutron damage; room-temperature ductility not highlighted.

object: silica precipitation in a granite fracture
problem: How does silica precipitation alter permeability and fluid pressure in fractures relevant to earthquake cycles?
mechanism_or_method: Hydrothermal flow-through experiments at constant flow rate recording inlet-outlet pressure oscillations from repeated blockage and failure of sealed layers.
limitation: Small laboratory slit with high supersaturation; link to natural earthquake rupture inferred.

problem: How to combine rigid inorganic and ductile organic components in bulk materials with switchable stiffness and elasticity?
mechanism_or_method: Inorganic nanoparticles trapped in long-chain polymer networks and anchored by short-chain organic crosslinkers.
limitation: Clinical suitability only tested in small rat and in vitro studies; long-term behavior unclear.

object: nanoscale friction between Ir AFM tip and graphene
problem: Can alternating electric current reduce nanoscale friction and wear by modulating interfacial electronic properties?
mechanism_or_method: 1 kHz alternating current induces dynamic electron density redistribution, quantified by an electronic-level friction model (PTT-E).
limitation: Single AFM tip-graphene system at nanoscale; macroscale transferability unproven.
decision_relevance: Suggests current modulation as a friction-control option in nanomechanical devices.

object: battery-grade nickel and cobalt sulfate production from sulfide resources
problem: Can nickel and cobalt sulfates be produced from complex sulfide resources without acid leaching?
mechanism_or_method: Acid-free process for processing complex sulfide resources with technoeconomic and carbon emission analysis.
limitation: Abstract truncated; process details and pilot-scale validation unclear.

problem: How to automatically design wireframe DNA nanostructures without a scaffold strand and its size limits?
mechanism_or_method: BRAIDS pipeline generating short intertwined oligonucleotide designs from 2D and 3D mesh models.
limitation: Experimental folding yield and structural precision of designs not quantified in the abstract.

object: 3D hydrogel platform for mechanical stimulation of cancer cells
problem: How do force magnitude, frequency and duration through specific integrins affect cancer spheroid migration and invasion?
mechanism_or_method: Near-infrared-responsive macromolecular actuators in a 3D hydrogel apply integrin-specific forces, supported by molecular simulations.
limitation: In vitro ovarian cancer spheroids only; in vivo relevance not shown.

problem: Can functional ceramics be made foldable while keeping high permittivity?
mechanism_or_method: Crystalline/amorphous microstructure in high-entropy ceramic film enabling 180 degree folding and flexible capacitors.
limitation: Abstract truncated; fatigue over many folds and large-area processing unclear.

problem: How to make muscle rings generate sustained high contractile force under tetanus for biohybrid robots?
mechanism_or_method: Stiffer pillar supports and denser myoblasts with less extracellular matrix, plus C-shaped anchors converting force into bending.
limitation: Cultured muscle requires medium and electrical stimulation; endurance and untethered operation limited.

object: insect-scale soft robots with electromagnetic muscle-like actuators
problem: Can a low-voltage muscle-like actuator power onboard autonomous insect-scale soft robots?
mechanism_or_method: Elasto-electromagnetic mechanism using structured elastomers with magnetic forces, holding states without continuous power.
limitation: Small-scale prototypes; payload, endurance and onboard battery life limited.
decision_relevance: Favors elasto-electromagnetic actuators for small untethered low-voltage robots.

object: magnetically actuated fiberbot for knee laser surgery
problem: Can a flexible magnetic fiber deliver steerable mid-infrared laser ablation in minimally invasive knee surgery?
mechanism_or_method: Multicore fiber for mid-infrared laser delivery encased in magnetic elastomer, steered by external magnetic field.
limitation: Tested on phantom, isolated pig joint and rat bone; human surgical feasibility unproven.

object: imaging Mueller matrix spectroscopic ellipsometer for wafer metrology
problem: How to measure semiconductor structures densely across a whole wafer with high throughput?
mechanism_or_method: Ultra-wide-field 20x20 mm imaging ellipsometry with signal correction and machine learning for spatially dense metrology.
limitation: Needs custom optical system; accuracy relative to reference methods only shown for DRAM structures.
decision_relevance: Supports wafer-wide optical metrology over point-based SEM sampling for yield monitoring.

object: ionic covalent organic framework membranes with Turing patterns
problem: How to get self-standing COF membranes that are both highly crystalline and mechanically strong?
mechanism_or_method: Inorganic ion regulation of interfacial polymerization giving reaction-diffusion Turing architecture, studied by MD, DFT and experiments.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; separation performance and scalability not quantified in the abstract.

problem: Can lithium be separated from ore in one acid-free, alkali-free step within seconds?
mechanism_or_method: Flash Joule heating of alpha-spodumene under Cl2 distills LiCl away from non-volatile aluminum and silicon oxides.
limitation: Small-batch lab reactor with chlorine handling; scale-up and process economics not demonstrated.

problem: How to program toughness and stiffness in hydrogels in space and time?
mechanism_or_method: Latent ionic cross-linking from printed CaCO3 microparticles, triggered on demand by glucono-delta-lactone acidifier.
limitation: Demonstrations are lab-scale; long-term stability of calcium-crosslinked gels and fatigue not addressed.

problem: How to miniaturize fully soft steering for everting robots with multiple large bends?
mechanism_or_method: Robot skin functionalized with liquid crystal elastomer actuators controlled by internal pressure and actuator temperature.
limitation: Thermal actuation response is slow and surgical or inspection use only demonstrated in lab.

object: carbon nanofiber air filters for direct air capture
problem: Can distributed CO2 capture filters in ventilation systems remove CO2 cheaply with low-energy regeneration?
mechanism_or_method: Carbon nanofiber adsorbent filters regenerated by solar thermal or electrothermal heating, evaluated with life cycle and techno-economic analysis.
limitation: Global removal potential is modeled; cost range is wide and real building trials absent.
decision_relevance: Supports integrating DAC filters into building ventilation rather than centralized plants.

problem: Can temporal refraction and reflection of flexural waves be realized experimentally in an elastic beam?
mechanism_or_method: Array of piezoelectric patches switching effective elastic properties in time, verified against temporal Snell's law and Fresnel equations.
limitation: Laboratory beam with limited modulation speed and bandwidth; practical phononic devices not shown.

problem: How does cation size mismatch govern oxygen vacancy formation in high-entropy perovskites?
mechanism_or_method: Measured vacancy concentrations in fourteen perovskites plus machine-learned interatomic potential simulations and statistical thermodynamics of vacancy energy distributions.
limitation: Limited to A-site compositions studied; electrode performance in devices not tested.

problem: How to build flexible sensing elastomers stable and sensitive at cryogenic temperatures?
mechanism_or_method: Fluorine-rich supramolecular polyurethane with electrostatic crosslinks and fluorine-dipole interactions with ionic liquid stabilizing ion transport.
limitation: Long-term durability and ionic liquid leakage under extreme cycling not reported.

problem: Why does GRX-810 show exceptional tensile, creep and oxidation performance above 1100 C?
mechanism_or_method: High-temperature tensile, creep and thermal cycling tests with atomic-scale characterization and atomistic modeling of fine trigonal yttrium oxides.
limitation: Single alloy; creep lives and oxidation over long service durations not covered.
decision_relevance: Supports ODS additive alloys for service above 1100 C.

object: nanosheet-bridged ZIF-8 membranes for propylene/propane separation
problem: How to make MOF membranes mechanically robust at high pressure without cracking at grain boundaries?
mechanism_or_method: Graphene oxide nanosheets bridge soft MOF grains like a cuttlebone wall, dispersing stress at grain boundaries.
limitation: Tested to 300 hours at lab scale; long-term industrial stream performance not proven.

object: COF-PEEK nanofiber membranes for oily water separation
problem: How to raise strength, stability and hydrophilicity of polymeric nanofiber membranes under harsh conditions?
mechanism_or_method: Sequential crystallization inserts a COF nanoarray layer into PEEK nanofibers forming a mechanical interlocking structure.
limitation: Lab-scale emulsions; tensile strength modest at 16.2 MPa and scale-up unclear.

problem: How to optimize fracture toughness and high-temperature strength simultaneously in Nb-Si alloys?
mechanism_or_method: Machine learning with three-step feature screening, SHAP analysis and NSGA-II multi-objective optimization, followed by alloy synthesis and microstructure analysis.
limitation: Only as-cast properties reported; heat-treated and oxidation performance not covered.
decision_relevance: Supports ML-guided composition selection for as-cast Nb-Si alloys.

problem: Can sound achieve displacement resolution far below the half-wavelength diffraction limit?
mechanism_or_method: Topological pairs in spiral-twisted orbital meta-atoms produce interference giving an acoustic analogue of Malus's law.
limitation: Prototype at audible frequency with large 100 mm wavelength; robustness in real environments untested.

problem: Can a soft device achieve autonomous snapping and environmental sensing under constant light?
mechanism_or_method: Elastic snap-through instability embedded in a liquid crystalline network driven out of equilibrium by continuous light energy transfer.
limitation: Laboratory light source needed; sensing demonstrated for simple cues only.

problem: How to explore centimeter-scale cavities of varying shapes with a simple adaptive soft robot?
mechanism_or_method: Inflatable pufferfish-inspired skin with flexible spikes creating asymmetric friction under vibration, propelling without feedback control.
limitation: Tested in laboratory pipe mockups; fouled or live pipelines and tethering not addressed.
decision_relevance: Favors simple vibration-driven morphing robots for inspecting variable-diameter small pipes.

problem: How to get high-capacity hysteresis-free water sorption under very dry conditions?
mechanism_or_method: Post-synthetic cation exchange in SU-102 with trends probed by vibrational Stark spectroscopy following a Hofmeister-type series.
limitation: 500 cycles at lab scale; cost of zirconium ellagic acid MOF and device performance unclear.

object: water-soluble polyacrylamide precursor for carbon fibre
problem: Can carbon fibre be made from an aqueous precursor with lower energy and emissions than PAN?
mechanism_or_method: Aqueous polyacrylamide dry-spun fibres with phosphoric acid shortening thermal stabilisation and raising carbon yield.
limitation: Lab-scale fibre spinning; strength matches PAN-CF only at comparable level and industrial scale-up unproven.
decision_relevance: May favor aqueous precursors to cut solvent use and stabilisation energy in carbon fibre production.

problem: Can a tough underwater soft robot navigate by light without photo-mechanically responsive materials?
mechanism_or_method: Polymer gel not photo-responsive itself, powered by ambient fluid effects under light, enabling phototactic 3D multimodal locomotion.
limitation: Mechanism of fluid-powered propulsion and efficiency not detailed in abstract; lab tank demonstrations only.

object: photoresponsive organic crystals forming quasicircular microcrystals
problem: How to obtain elastic circular organic microcrystals in a controllable way?
mechanism_or_method: Light-induced bending, photosalient effect and delamination of a parent organic crystal, tuned by wavelength and power.
limitation: Single crystalline material; optical properties of resulting crystals not yet explored.

problem: How do curing time and temperature control interfacial adhesion and failure mode in silicone elastomers?
mechanism_or_method: Dimensionless reaction coordinate coupling time and temperature predicts adhesion strength and transition from bulk fracture to adhesive failure.
limitation: Shown for silicone elastomers only; other chemistries and long-term adhesion aging not addressed.
decision_relevance: Sets cure time and temperature windows for robust interfaces in cast and printed soft devices.

problem: How to combine dynamic and static tactile sensing with rapid mode switching and wide pressure range?
mechanism_or_method: All-in-one structure switching modes in 1 ms by light modulation, with closed-loop feedback and deep learning for haptic Morse code.
limitation: Demonstrations are prototype-level; robustness and user studies are limited.

object: multistable thin-shell metastructures for reconfigurable robots
problem: Can multistable thin-shell metastructures create highly reconfigurable adaptive robots?
mechanism_or_method: Developable surface thin polymer sheets with patterned cutouts storing elastic energy, giving up to 20 stable states per unit, combined with magnetic and electroactive actuators.
limitation: Prototype-scale grippers and crawlers; payload and cycle life not reported.

object: oriented Zr-MOF membranes for helium separation
problem: How to fabricate {001}-oriented MOF membranes that achieve precise He/CH4 separation with high permeance and robustness?
mechanism_or_method: Metal-organic polyhedra fragments act as metallocene anchors inducing c-axis oriented growth of Zr-MOF, raising CH4 transition energy barrier.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; scalability and performance with real natural gas feeds not established.

object: electrochemical CO2 capture reactor with porous solid electrolyte
problem: Can a modular electrochemical reactor continuously capture CO2 from air and flue gas with long-term stability?
mechanism_or_method: Porous solid electrolyte reactor using OER/ORR with sodium bicarbonate as cyclic mediator in a recirculation mode regenerating pure CO2.
limitation: Bench-scale reactor tested about 2000 hours; energy consumption and scale-up costs not detailed in abstract.

problem: How to dissipate condensation heat to raise solar freshwater production efficiency?
mechanism_or_method: Latent heat-assisted evaporative cooling using delignified wood substrate to remove condensation heat and speed vapor diffusion.
limitation: Lab demonstration under controlled illumination; outdoor performance not reported.
decision_relevance: Guides condenser design in passive solar stills.

object: hindered urea bond polyurethane thermoset networks
problem: How can crosslinked thermosets be decrosslinked and upcycled without performance loss on recycling?
mechanism_or_method: Dynamic polyurethane with hindered urea bonds undergoing amine-triggered exchange to give reprocessable thermoplastics used in composites and shielding.
limitation: Lab-synthesized small samples; long-term recycling cycles and cost at scale not shown.

problem: Can one learning controller adapt across diverse soft arms, tasks and perturbations with stability guarantees?
mechanism_or_method: Neuron-inspired offline structural and online plastic synapses with error-gated updates and a learned contraction metric as stability constraint.
limitation: Validated on two arm types in laboratory; unstructured real-world deployment untested.
decision_relevance: Supports adaptive control choice for soft manipulators under payload and actuator faults.

problem: Can mechanochemical treatment with CO2 recover lithium and upgrade transition metals in one process?
mechanism_or_method: Mechanochemical micro-segregation creates Li-rich surface; CO2 leaching forms lithium bicarbonate; residual metals become OER catalysts.
limitation: Lab-scale batches; scalability and economics not demonstrated in abstract.

problem: How to assemble macrocycles into loose interconnected membranes for dye/salt separation in high-salinity wastewater?
mechanism_or_method: Unidirectional diffusion assisted interfacial polymerization positioning tetra-aldehyde calixarene at the organic boundary on a hydrogel surface.
limitation: Lab-scale films; fouling and long-term operation with real wastewater limited.

problem: Can transient entanglements resolve the strength-toughness trade-off in single-covalent-network hydrogels?
mechanism_or_method: Networks with abundant dangling chains forming transient entanglements that slip and disentangle on loading, dissipating energy and homogenizing stress.
limitation: Mechanism inferred from mechanical tests; only polyacrylamide chemistry shown.
decision_relevance: Suggests simpler tough-hydrogel designs for wear-resistant soft devices.

problem: How to enhance elastocaloric entropy change in polymers for solid-state cooling?
mechanism_or_method: Inorganic nanofillers shear interlaminar chains, aggregating effective elastic chains and adding entropy contribution; large-deformation cooling prototype demonstrated.
limitation: Prototype-level cooling system; fatigue life and device scaling not reported.
decision_relevance: Informs material selection for elastocaloric refrigeration prototypes.

problem: How to make adhesives with high strength and toughness that retain performance at elevated temperature?
mechanism_or_method: Solution shearing forms ordered nanocrystals and aligned nanofibrils in bulk and hydrogen-bonded nanocrystals at the interface.
limitation: Lab lap-shear tests on metal and glass; long-term aging and humidity durability not shown.
decision_relevance: Could replace commercial structural adhesives in load-bearing joints up to 120 C.

problem: How to predict mixture self- and mutual diffusion coefficients with thermodynamically consistent entropy scaling?
mechanism_or_method: Entropy scaling framework using pure-component self-diffusion and infinite-dilution data with mixture entropy from molecular-based equations of state.
limitation: Requires pure-component and infinite-dilution inputs and a good equation of state.
decision_relevance: Improves transport property estimates for process design of fluid mixtures.

problem: What energy loss mechanisms limit a one-port SAW resonator?
mechanism_or_method: Stroboscopic full-field diffraction x-ray microscopy mapping spatiotemporal strain, with wave decomposition to extract device parameters.
limitation: Needs synchrotron x-ray facility; demonstrated on one prototypical resonator design.
decision_relevance: Guides SAW electrode and reflector design to reduce end and side leakage.

object: artificial water channel polyamide desalination membranes
problem: How to incorporate artificial water channels into defect-free polyamide membranes for brackish water desalination?
mechanism_or_method: Self-assembling imidazolylethyl-ureidoethyl-phenyl channels dispersed as colloids with SDS and embedded in polyamide layer during interfacial polymerization.
limitation: Lab-scale coupons; industrial scale claim not demonstrated; fouling and durability unclear.

object: biocrude upgrading catalysts for sustainable aviation fuel
problem: Can zeolite-supported Fe-Mo carbide nanocatalysts upgrade food-waste biocrude into jet-fuel-compliant SAF precursors?
mechanism_or_method: Hydrodeoxygenation of hydrothermal liquefaction biocrude over zeolite-supported molybdenum carbide nanocatalysts, with ASTM tier alpha and beta screening.
limitation: Only prescreening tiers passed; full ASTM certification and continuous operation not shown.

object: enamel-inspired ceramic coatings on metal foils
problem: How to raise stiffness-damping balance and corrosion resistance of metals without increasing density?
mechanism_or_method: Hydrothermal growth of vertically oriented ZrO2 nanorods with amorphous ZrO2 intergranular phase on Zr foil, extendable to Ti, Zn, Cu.
limitation: Thin foil coatings tested in lab; adhesion durability and large-part processing not addressed.

problem: Unclear from abstract; apparently how to reconcile hyperelasticity with adhesiveness via mechanical heterogeneities.
mechanism_or_method: In situ constructed mechanical heterogeneities; adhesion energy-thickness relation is nonlinear below a transition thickness.
limitation: Abstract truncated; evidence and scope unclear.

problem: How to generate multiple acoustic vortices with independent dynamic remote control?
mechanism_or_method: Metasurface encoding multiple topological charges whose features determine vortex singularities, tuned independently to move vortices.
limitation: Demonstrated in air-borne laboratory setups; practical acoustofluidic use not shown.

object: starfish-inspired hydrogel tube feet for underwater adhesion
problem: How to achieve temporary, switchable underwater adhesion for robotic manipulation?
mechanism_or_method: Serially bonded hydrogel mouth and rigid stem; swelling forms cupped pad, vacuum on detachment, pneumatic release.
limitation: Demonstrated on rocks in lab; swelling-time response and cyclic durability limited.

object: power outages from natural disasters in China
problem: Do natural disasters cause unequal power outage impacts in poverty versus non-poverty counties, and how will climate change affect this?
mechanism_or_method: Empirical panel analysis of point-level outage and disaster data 2019-2021 plus SSP-RCP long-term projections.
limitation: Only three years of data; outage dataset access may be restricted; projection assumptions uncertain.
decision_relevance: Targets grid resilience investment toward poverty counties.

object: 3D shrinking electronics from liquid metal on heat-shrinkable polymer
problem: How to fabricate conformal 3D electronics on freeform surfaces simply and at scale?
mechanism_or_method: Print liquid metal patterns on heat-shrinkable substrates; thermal actuation transforms 2D circuits into target 3D geometries.
limitation: Lab demonstrations of antenna and gesture interface; durability and reliability not reported.

problem: How to obtain macroscopic tensile plasticity with strain hardening in metallic glass?
mechanism_or_method: Non-affine thermal strain promotes chemical-fluctuation network of Fe-rich medium-range order, with stress-induced nanocrystallization turning softening into hardening.
limitation: Single Fe-based composition; small specimens and reproducibility across alloys uncertain.

object: soft magnetic microrobots with integrated antennas
problem: How can shape-reconfigurable microrobots communicate their state remotely?
mechanism_or_method: Photolithographed three-layer microrobot of thermoresponsive magnetic hydrogel, anisotropic support and flexible dipole antenna whose shape change is read by radio receivers.
limitation: Proof of concept in lab; in vivo or in-liquid signal range and robustness untested.

problem: How to rapidly prepare large-area, high-crystallinity COF membranes?
mechanism_or_method: Reverse-phase microemulsion interfacial polymerization with ionic liquid network pre-arranging monomers and encapsulating water byproducts, plus scraping-assisted coating.
limitation: Tested on protein desalination over six cycles; long-term stability and cost unclear.

object: grain boundary segregation in Fe-W alloy
problem: How do secondary grain boundary dislocations alter solute segregation energy spectra?
mechanism_or_method: Nanoscale correlative tomography combining crystallography and atom probe chemical analysis to quantify segregation energies at dislocation arrays.
limitation: Single model Fe-W alloy; generalization to other systems not shown.

problem: How to combine strong magneto-responsiveness with hyperelasticity and self-healing in soft materials?
mechanism_or_method: Magnetic ionic liquid [Emim][FeCl4] confined in a urethane polymer through hydrogen and metal-coordination bonds at 80 wt% loading.
limitation: Modest magnetization (2.6 emu/g); long-term ionic liquid leakage and stability unreported.

problem: How to create high-performance entangled hydrogels with long polymer chains compatible with additive manufacturing?
mechanism_or_method: Co-initiating thermal-light dual-initiation producing high-molecular-weight chains and rapid multinetwork formation.
limitation: Lab-scale hydrogels; sensing applications only demonstrated qualitatively.

object: resilient hydrogels with hierarchical sequentially swollen networks
problem: How to build synthetic hydrogels that store and release mechanical energy with low dissipation?
mechanism_or_method: Sequential swelling and photopolymerization steps create hierarchical networks with stretched chains, tuning resilience versus dissipation.
limitation: Lab tests of mechanical cycling only; speed of energy release and long-term fatigue unclear.

object: triazolate MOF [Mn(ta)2] for hydrogen isotope separation
problem: How do isotopologue-induced structural dynamics enable D2/H2 separation in a triazolate MOF?
mechanism_or_method: In situ neutron powder diffraction and cryogenic thermal desorption spectroscopy reveal lattice expansion and site occupancy differences.
limitation: Operates only at cryogenic 60 K; neutron facility needed; industrial upscaling speculative.

object: 3D network materials assembled by tensile buckling
problem: How to assemble 3D architected network materials with regular microstructures and tailorable J-shaped stress-strain response?
mechanism_or_method: Tensile buckling of stacked multilayer 2D precursors with data-driven topology optimization maximizing out-of-plane dimension.
limitation: Lab-scale precursors; biointegration and long-term mechanical reliability not demonstrated.

problem: Can designed complex concentrated alloys combine ultrahigh yield strength with high tensile ductility?
mechanism_or_method: Intelligent alloy design of complex concentrated alloys; details not given in the abstract.
limitation: Abstract gives no detail on composition, processing or scalability.

problem: How to achieve large programmable shape changes at low magnetic fields without continuous field?
mechanism_or_method: Hemispherical bistable shell embedded with magnetic microparticles switched by low-intensity pulsed magnetic torques below 20 mT.
limitation: Demonstrated on lab prototypes; reliability over many switching cycles not stated.
decision_relevance: Informs low-power bistable actuator design for pumps and grippers.

object: living liquid crystals with bacterial traveling waves
problem: How to control traveling waves in living liquid crystals and what breaks parity-time symmetry?
mechanism_or_method: Predefined patterned director fields guide bacterial waves; theory shows wave-induced director reorientation and symmetry breaking drive double waves.
limitation: Living bacterial system specific; applicability to engineered micromachines remains prospective.

object: stick-slip nanopositioner for atomic force microscopy
problem: Can a stick-slip nanopositioner give both high bandwidth and millimeter range for AFM scanning?
mechanism_or_method: Triple-phase controller using displacement accumulation in stepping mode to combine nano-precision scanning with a 3 mm by 3 mm range.
limitation: Bandwidth limited to about 363 Hz; line rate 40 Hz; single custom instrument.
decision_relevance: Supports choosing stick-slip stages for large-area high-speed AFM.

problem: How to make hydrogels with very high strength and tear resistance?
mechanism_or_method: Freeze-assisted bidirectional ion migration producing dense-porous-dense sandwich structure around a mineralized physical crosslinking center.
limitation: Lab-scale samples; long-term stability in wet harsh environments not detailed.

problem: How to extend contact-electro-catalysis to high temperatures using oxides?
mechanism_or_method: Grafting fluorinated functional groups onto SiO2, Al2O3, ZrO2, MgO to enhance contact electrification and electron transfer, applied to battery cathode leaching.
limitation: Lab-scale leaching; mechanical agitation energy cost and scale-up unclear.

problem: How to achieve ultra-low-frequency broadband vibration absorption at deep-subwavelength scale without stiffness loss?
mechanism_or_method: Power-law density-tailored composite (rho-ABH) compressing wavelength and amplifying energy density instead of thickness engineering.
limitation: Laboratory-scale specimens; integration into real structures and environmental durability not shown.
